name: EulersGem.affDim
statement:
/-- Affine dimension of a set, Isabelle-style:
* empty set ↦ `-1`
* otherwise ↦ `finDim` of its affine span (as `ℤ`).

Junk value `0` when the direction is infinite-dimensional (inherited from
`Module.finrank` / `AffineSubspace.finDim`). Prefer a `[FiniteDimensional ℝ E]`
context for Euler-characteristic arguments. -/
noncomputable def affDim (s : Set E) : ℤ :=
  match (affineSpan ℝ s).finDim with
  | ⊥ => -1
  | (n : ℕ) => n

name: EulersGem.affDim_univ

/-- On a finite-dimensional space, the whole space has affine dimension `finrank`. -/
lemma affDim_univ [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E] :
    affDim (univ : Set E) = Module.finrank ℝ E

name: EulersGem.affineHyperplane
statement:
/-- The set `{x | ⟪a, x⟫ = b}` as an affine subspace, given a witness point. -/
noncomputable def affineHyperplane (a : E) (b : ℝ) (p : E) (_hp : ⟪a, p⟫ = b) :
    AffineSubspace ℝ E :=
  mk' p (LinearMap.ker (innerₛₗ ℝ a))

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCell_singleton
statement:
/-- Singleton arrangement cells. Isabelle: `hyperplane_cell_singleton`. -/
lemma isHyperplaneCell_singleton (a : E) (b : ℝ) (C : Set E) :
    IsHyperplaneCell {(a, b)} C ↔
      if a = 0 then C = univ
      else C = {x | ⟪a, x⟫ = b} ∨ C = {x | ⟪a, x⟫ < b} ∨ C = {x | b < ⟪a, x⟫}

name: EulersGem.affineSpan_isOpen_inter
statement:
/-- Affine hull of a nonempty open∩affine set equals the affine subspace.
Isabelle helper: `affine_hull_affine_Int_open`. -/
lemma affineSpan_isOpen_inter {T : AffineSubspace ℝ E} {U : Set E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hne : (U ∩ (T : Set E)).Nonempty) :
    affineSpan ℝ (U ∩ (T : Set E)) = T

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCell_exists_isOpen_affine
statement:
/-- Every cell of a finite arrangement is the intersection of an open set and an
affine subspace. Isabelle: `hyperplane_cell_Int_open_affine`. -/
lemma isHyperplaneCell_exists_isOpen_affine {A : Set (Hyperplane E)}
    (hA : A.Finite) {C : Set E} (hC : IsHyperplaneCell A C) :
    ∃ U : Set E, ∃ T : AffineSubspace ℝ E, IsOpen U ∧ C = U ∩ (T : Set E)

name: EulersGem.affineSpan_eq_of_isHyperplaneCell
statement:
/-- The affine span of a cell equals the affine factor in its open∩affine
decomposition. -/
lemma affineSpan_eq_of_isHyperplaneCell {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {C : Set E}
    (_hA : A.Finite) (hC : IsHyperplaneCell A C)
    {U : Set E} {T : AffineSubspace ℝ E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hCeq : C = U ∩ (T : Set E)) :
    affineSpan ℝ C = T

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCell_isOpen_affineSpan

/-- Cells are open in the subspace topology of their affine hull.
Isabelle: `hyperplane_cell_relatively_open`. -/
lemma isHyperplaneCell_isOpen_affineSpan {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {C : Set E}
    (hA : A.Finite) (hC : IsHyperplaneCell A C) :
    ∃ U : Set E, IsOpen U ∧ C = U ∩ (affineSpan ℝ C : Set E)

/-- Relative (intrinsic) interior of a cell equals the cell.
Isabelle: `hyperplane_cell_relative_interior`. -/
lemma isHyperplaneCell_intrinsicInterior {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {C : Set E}

    intrinsicInterior ℝ C = C

lemma affDim_eq_finDim_affineSpan (s : Set E) :

name: EulersGem.affDim_isOpen_inter
statement:
/-- `affDim` of a nonempty open∩affine set equals `affDim` of the affine carrier. -/
lemma affDim_isOpen_inter {T : AffineSubspace ℝ E} {U : Set E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hne : (U ∩ (T : Set E)).Nonempty) :
    affDim (U ∩ (T : Set E)) = affDim (T : Set E)

name: EulersGem.affDim_cell_inter_halfSpace_lt
statement:
/-- Open half-space cut of a cell (when nonempty) preserves affine dimension.
Uses that the cut remains open∩affine with the same affine factor. -/
lemma affDim_cell_inter_halfSpace_lt {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {C : Set E}
    (hA : A.Finite) (hC : IsHyperplaneCell A C) (a : E) (b : ℝ)
    (hne : (C ∩ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ < b}).Nonempty) :
    affDim (C ∩ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ < b}) = affDim C

    affDim (C ∩ {x | b < ⟪a, x⟫}) = affDim C

name: EulersGem.affDim_coe_eq_finrank_direction
statement:
/-- Nonempty affine subspaces have `affDim` equal to `finrank` of the direction. -/
lemma affDim_coe_eq_finrank_direction {T : AffineSubspace ℝ E}
    (hne : (T : Set E).Nonempty) :
    affDim (T : Set E) = Module.finrank ℝ T.direction

name: EulersGem.kerCompSubtypeEquiv
statement:
/-- Linear equivalence identifying `ker (g ∘ subtype)` with `W ⊓ ker g`. -/
noncomputable def kerCompSubtypeEquiv (W : Submodule ℝ E) (g : E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) :
    LinearMap.ker (g.comp W.subtype) ≃ₗ[ℝ]
      (W ⊓ LinearMap.ker g : Submodule ℝ E) where
  toFun := fun x =>
    ⟨(x : E), x.1.2, by
      have hx : g (W.subtype x.1) = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp x.2
      exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hx⟩
  invFun := fun y =>
    ⟨⟨(y : E), y.2.1⟩, LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (by
      change g (W.subtype ⟨(y : E), y.2.1⟩) = 0
      exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp y.2.2)⟩
  left_inv := fun _ => rfl
  right_inv := fun _ => rfl
  map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
  map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl

name: EulersGem.affDim_affine_inter_hyperplane
statement:
/-- Isabelle-style: proper nonempty hyperplane slice of an affine set drops `affDim` by 1. -/
lemma affDim_affine_inter_hyperplane [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (T : AffineSubspace ℝ E) (a : E) (b : ℝ)
    (hne : ((T : Set E) ∩ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ = b}).Nonempty)
    (hnot : ¬ (T : Set E) ⊆ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ = b}) :
    affDim ((T : Set E) ∩ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ = b}) = affDim (T : Set E) - 1

name: EulersGem.affDim_cell_inter_hyperplane
statement:
/-- Hyperplane slice of a cell (nonempty, proper) drops `affDim` by 1.
Paulson cutting step for `Euler_characterstic_lemma`. -/
lemma affDim_cell_inter_hyperplane [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {C : Set E}
    (hA : A.Finite) (hC : IsHyperplaneCell A C) (a : E) (b : ℝ)
    (hne : (C ∩ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ = b}).Nonempty)
    (hnot : ¬ C ⊆ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ = b}) :
    affDim (C ∩ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ = b}) = affDim C - 1

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_univ
statement:
/-- For any finite arrangement, `eulerCharacteristic A univ = (-1)^{finrank}`. -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_univ [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} (hA : A.Finite) :
    eulerCharacteristic A (univ : Set E) = (-1 : ℤ) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_union_inter
statement:
/-- Soft inclusion-exclusion from disjoint additivity:
`EC(S ∪ T) = EC(S) + EC(T) - EC(S ∩ T)`. -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_union_inter {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {S T : Set E}
    (hA : A.Finite)
    (hS : IsHyperplaneCellComplex A S) (hT : IsHyperplaneCellComplex A T) :
    eulerCharacteristic A (S ∪ T) =
      eulerCharacteristic A S + eulerCharacteristic A T -
        eulerCharacteristic A (S ∩ T)

Special case of the cone step toward Paulson `Euler_polyhedral_cone`. -/

    eulerCharacteristic {(a, (0 : ℝ))} (closedHalfspace a 0) = 0

name: EulersGem.openPositive_two
EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_two_halfspace_cone
statement:
/-- Cell-complex Euler characteristic of the intersection of two nontrivial halfspace cones
is `0` when the open dual is nonempty. Stepping stone toward general
`Euler_polyhedral_cone` face sum (face↔cell still open; cell EC general is proved). -/
theorem eulerCharacteristic_two_halfspace_cone [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {a b : E} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hpos : ∃ x : E, ⟪a, x⟫ < 0 ∧ ⟪b, x⟫ < 0) :
    eulerCharacteristic (coneArrangement ({a, b} : Set E))
      (closedHalfspace a 0 ∩ closedHalfspace b 0) = 0

name: EulersGem.sum_powerset_filter_nonempty_neg_one_pow_card_add_one
statement:
/-- Alternating powerset sum over nonempty subsets equals `1` when `s` is nonempty. -/
lemma sum_powerset_filter_nonempty_neg_one_pow_card_add_one {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    {s : Finset α} (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    ∑ t ∈ s.powerset.filter (·.Nonempty), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (t.card + 1) = 1

name: EulersGem.cellsBelow
statement:
/-- Cells of `A` contained in `S`, as a finset. -/
noncomputable def cellsBelow (A : Set (Hyperplane E)) (S : Set E) (hA : A.Finite) :
    Finset (Set E) :=
  (finite_isHyperplaneCell_restrict hA (fun C => C ⊆ S)).toFinset

name: EulersGem.mem_cellsBelow_iff
statement:
lemma mem_cellsBelow_iff {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {S C : Set E} (hA : A.Finite) :
    C ∈ cellsBelow A S hA ↔ IsHyperplaneCell A C ∧ C ⊆ S

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_eq_sum_cellsBelow
EulersGem.cellsBelow_biUnion
statement:
lemma cellsBelow_biUnion {ι : Type*} {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} (hA : A.Finite)
    (s : Finset ι) (S : ι → Set E)
    (hS : ∀ i ∈ s, IsHyperplaneCellComplex A (S i)) :
    cellsBelow A (⋃ i ∈ s, S i) hA = s.biUnion fun i => cellsBelow A (S i) hA

name: EulersGem.biInter_cellsBelow
statement:
lemma biInter_cellsBelow {ι : Type*} {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} (hA : A.Finite)
    (t : Finset ι) (S : ι → Set E) (ht : t.Nonempty) :
    (t.inf' ht (fun i => cellsBelow A (S i) hA)) = cellsBelow A (⋂ i ∈ t, S i) hA

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_biUnion_inclusion_exclusion
statement:
/-- Indexed inclusion-exclusion for Euler characteristic of a finite union of cell complexes.
Paulson: `Euler_characteristic_inclusion_exclusion`. -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_biUnion_inclusion_exclusion {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} (hA : A.Finite) (s : Finset ι) (S : ι → Set E)
    (hS : ∀ i ∈ s, IsHyperplaneCellComplex A (S i)) :
    eulerCharacteristic A (⋃ i ∈ s, S i) =
      ∑ t ∈ s.powerset.filter (·.Nonempty),
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ (t.card + 1) * eulerCharacteristic A (⋂ i ∈ t, S i)

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_openPositive
statement:
/-- Open dual of a finite set of normals has cell Euler char `(-1)^{finrank}`,
relative to any larger cone arrangement. -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_openPositive [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_polyhedral_cone
statement:
/-- Cell-complex Euler characteristic of a proper full-dimensional polyhedral cone
(finite homogeneous H-rep with nonempty open dual) is `0`.
Generalises the 1- and 2-halfspace theorems via indexed inclusion-exclusion. -/
theorem eulerCharacteristic_polyhedral_cone [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {As : Set E} (hAs : As.Finite) (hneAs : As.Nonempty)
    (hpos : ({x : E | ∀ a ∈ As, 0 < ⟪a, x⟫}).Nonempty) :
    eulerCharacteristic (coneArrangement As) (⋂ a ∈ As, closedHalfspace a 0) = 0

EulersGem.closure_inter_closedOrthant_flat
statement:
/-- `closure (U ∩ H) = closure U ∩ H` for open orthant `U` and closed flat `H`. -/
lemma closure_inter_closedOrthant_flat {Neg Zero : Set E}
    (hNeg : Neg.Finite)
    (hne : ({x : E | (∀ a ∈ Neg, ⟪a, x⟫ < 0) ∧ (∀ a ∈ Zero, ⟪a, x⟫ = 0)}).Nonempty)
    (hZero : Zero.Finite) :
    closure ({x : E | ∀ a ∈ Neg, ⟪a, x⟫ < 0} ∩ ⋂ a ∈ Zero, {x : E | ⟪a, x⟫ = 0}) =
      closure {x : E | ∀ a ∈ Neg, ⟪a, x⟫ < 0} ∩ ⋂ a ∈ Zero, {x : E | ⟪a, x⟫ = 0}

name: EulersGem.closure_coneCell_eq_face
statement:
/-- Closure of a cone-arrangement cell inside the cone equals the supporting-hyperplane face
cut out by the cell's zero normals. Paulson `hyper2` (closure). -/
theorem closure_coneCell_eq_face {As : Set E} (hAs : As.Finite) {C : Set E}
    (hC : IsHyperplaneCell (coneArrangement As) C)
    (hsub : C ⊆ ⋂ a ∈ As, closedHalfspace a 0) :
    closure C =
      (⋂ a ∈ As, closedHalfspace a 0) ∩
        ⋂ a ∈ coneCellZeros As C, {x : E | ⟪a, x⟫ = 0}

name: EulersGem.isFaceOf_closure_coneCell
statement:
/-- Paulson `hyper2`: the closure of a cone-arrangement cell inside the cone is a face. -/
theorem isFaceOf_closure_coneCell {As : Set E} (hAs : As.Finite) {C : Set E}

name: EulersGem.hyper1_polyhedral_cone
statement:

with the same affine dimension, and its closure recovers the face. -/
theorem hyper1_polyhedral_cone {As : Set E} (hAs : As.Finite) {F : Set E}
    (hF : IsFaceOf (⋂ a ∈ As, closedHalfspace a 0) F) (hne : F.Nonempty)
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] :
    IsHyperplaneCell (coneArrangement As) (intrinsicInterior ℝ F) ∧
      intrinsicInterior ℝ F ⊆ ⋂ a ∈ As, closedHalfspace a 0 ∧
      affDim (intrinsicInterior ℝ F) = affDim F ∧
      closure (intrinsicInterior ℝ F) = F

name: EulersGem.faceEulerSum_of_height_one_polytope
statement:
/-- With homogenized equality, the cone is polyhedral so `faceEulerSum_polyhedral_cone`
applies; combined with the bijection this yields the slice Euler sum.

`hpos` is required only on nonzero homogenized normals (`0` arises harmlessly from
encoding a height hyperplane as a pair of opposite halfspaces). -/
theorem faceEulerSum_of_height_one_polytope [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {H : Set (Hyperplane E)} {i : E} {p : Set E}
    (hH : H.Finite)
    (hp : p = ⋂ h ∈ H, closedHalfspace h.1 h.2)
    (hht : ∀ x ∈ p, ⟪i, x⟫ = 1) (hpne : p.Nonempty) (hConv : Convex ℝ p)
    (h0sec : ∀ y, y ∈ (⋂ a ∈ homogenizeNormals H i, closedHalfspace a 0) →
      ⟪i, y⟫ = 0 → y = 0)
    (hpos : ({x : E | ∀ a ∈ homogenizeNormals H i \ ({0} : Set E), 0 < ⟪a, x⟫}).Nonempty)
    (hn : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E) :
    faceEulerSum p (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1) = 1

name: EulersGem.faceEulerSum_two_expand
statement:
lemma faceEulerSum_two_expand (p : Set E) :
    faceEulerSum p 2 =
      ({f : Set E | IsFaceOf p f ∧ affDim f = 0}.ncard : ℤ) -
        ({f : Set E | IsFaceOf p f ∧ affDim f = 1}.ncard : ℤ) +
        ({f : Set E | IsFaceOf p f ∧ affDim f = 2}.ncard : ℤ)

name: EulersGem.diskEuler_of_faceEulerSum
statement:
/-- **Disk Euler from the characteristic.** If a set has Euler characteristic `1`
through dimension `2` and a unique 2-face, then counting one exterior face as
well gives `V − E + F = 2`. -/
theorem diskEuler_of_faceEulerSum (p : Set E)
    (hsum : faceEulerSum p 2 = 1)
    (hTop : ({f : Set E | IsFaceOf p f ∧ affDim f = 2}.ncard) = 1) :
    ({f : Set E | IsFaceOf p f ∧ affDim f = 0}.ncard : ℤ) -
        ({f : Set E | IsFaceOf p f ∧ affDim f = 1}.ncard : ℤ) +
        (({f : Set E | IsFaceOf p f ∧ affDim f = 2}.ncard) + 1) = 2

name: EulersGem.triangle_disk_euler
statement:
/-- **A geometric triangle has disk Euler number `2`.** The triangle is a
2-simplex, so `faceEulerSum = 1` by `Euler_Poincare_full`. It has three
vertices, three edges, and one 2-face; the exterior face makes `3 − 3 + 2 = 2`. -/
theorem triangle_disk_euler (b : AffineBasis (Fin 3) ℝ E) :
    ((Platonic.facesOfDim (Simplex.body b) 0).ncard : ℤ) -
        (Platonic.facesOfDim (Simplex.body b) 1).ncard +
        ((Platonic.facesOfDim (Simplex.body b) 2).ncard + 1) = 2

name: EulersGem.exists_triangle
statement:
/-- Every 2-dimensional real inner product space contains a geometric triangle. -/
theorem exists_triangle {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (hE : Module.finrank ℝ E = 2) :
    Nonempty (AffineBasis (Fin 3) ℝ E)

name: EulersGem.Picks.FanDiskTriangulation.fan_eulerChar_succ
statement:
lemma fan_eulerChar_succ (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    ((fan (k + 1) (by omega)).planarCounts).eulerChar =
      ((fan k hk).planarCounts).eulerChar

name: EulersGem.Picks.FanDiskTriangulation.fan_eulerChar_from_characteristic
statement:
/-- **Every fan has disk Euler number `2`, from the characteristic.** The fan on
three vertices has the same `(V, E, F)` as a geometric triangle with its
exterior face, and that number is `2` by `triangle_disk_euler`. Adding a vertex
to a fan adds one vertex, two edges, and one face, which preserves the Euler
number. -/
theorem fan_eulerChar_from_characteristic (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ((fan n hn).planarCounts).eulerChar = 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.FanDiskTriangulation.fan_pick_count_from_characteristic
statement:
/-- **Pick's count for an empty fan, from the characteristic.** The fan is a
triangulation with `I = 0`, `B = n`, `T = n − 2`, and area `T/2`. Its
`V − E + F = 2` is `fan_eulerChar_from_characteristic`, so
`T/2 = n/2 − 1`. -/
theorem fan_pick_count_from_characteristic (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ((n - 2 : ℕ) : ℚ) / 2 = (n : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.eulerChar_add_diagonal
statement:
/-- Adding one diagonal: `E` and `F` each rise by `1`, so the disk Euler number
is unchanged. -/
theorem eulerChar_add_diagonal (V E F : ℕ) :
    ((V : ℤ) - ↑(E + 1) + ↑(F + 1)) = (V : ℤ) - ↑E + ↑F

name: EulersGem.Picks.eulerChar_insert_boundary
statement:
/-- Inserting one vertex in the interior of a boundary edge: `V` and `E` each
rise by `1`, `F` stays put. -/
theorem eulerChar_insert_boundary (V E F : ℕ) :
    (↑(V + 1) - ↑(E + 1) + (F : ℤ)) = (V : ℤ) - ↑E + (F : ℤ)

name: EulersGem.Picks.eulerChar_stellar
statement:
/-- Stellar subdivision at an interior lattice point of one triangle: that
triangle is replaced by three, so `V + 1`, `E + 3`, `T + 2`. -/
theorem eulerChar_stellar (V E T : ℕ) :
    (↑(V + 1) - ↑(E + 3) + ↑(T + 2 + 1)) = (V : ℤ) - ↑E + ↑(T + 1)

name: EulersGem.Picks.eulerChar_add_diagonal_iter
statement:
theorem eulerChar_add_diagonal_iter (d V E F : ℕ) :
    ((V : ℤ) - ↑(E + d) + ↑(F + d)) = (V : ℤ) - ↑E + ↑F

name: EulersGem.Picks.eulerChar_insert_boundary_iter
statement:
theorem eulerChar_insert_boundary_iter (k V E F : ℕ) :
    (↑(V + k) - ↑(E + k) + (F : ℤ)) = (V : ℤ) - ↑E + (F : ℤ)

name: EulersGem.Picks.eulerChar_stellar_iter
statement:
theorem eulerChar_stellar_iter (i V E T : ℕ) :
    (↑(V + i) - ↑(E + 3 * i) + ↑(T + 2 * i + 1)) = (V : ℤ) - ↑E + ↑(T + 1)

name: EulersGem.Picks.corner_cycle_euler_from_characteristic
statement:
/-- **Corner cycle, from the characteristic.** Deleting the `n − 3` diagonals of
a fan leaves the boundary `n`-cycle (`V = n`, `E = n`, one interior face and
the exterior face). Each deletion preserves the Euler number, which the fan
inherited from the triangle. -/
theorem corner_cycle_euler_from_characteristic (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    (n : ℤ) - ↑n + 2 = 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.triangulated_disk_euler_from_characteristic
statement:
/-- **Triangulated disk, from the characteristic.** Start from the corner
`n`-cycle, insert `B − n` boundary vertices, add `B − 3` diagonals, then perform
`I` stellar subdivisions. The Euler number stays `2`, so the classical counts
`V = I + B`, `T = 2I + B − 2`, `E = 3I + 2B − 3` satisfy `V − E + F = 2`. -/
theorem triangulated_disk_euler_from_characteristic
    (n B I : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hB : n ≤ B) :
    ((I + B : ℕ) : ℤ) - ↑(3 * I + 2 * B - 3) + ↑(2 * I + B - 2 + 1) = 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.pick_count_of_disk_from_characteristic
statement:
/-- **Pick's count for any triangulated disk with those counts.** Area `T/2`
and the Euler number from `triangulated_disk_euler_from_characteristic` give
`I + B/2 − 1`. -/
theorem pick_count_of_disk_from_characteristic
    (n B I : ℕ) (A : ℚ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hB : n ≤ B)
    (harea : A = ((2 * I + B - 2 : ℕ) : ℚ) / 2) :
    A = (I : ℚ) + (B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.latticeDet_plucker
statement:
lemma latticeDet_plucker (q a b c r : ℤ × ℤ) :
    latticeDet q a b * latticeDet q c r
      - latticeDet q a c * latticeDet q b r
      + latticeDet q a r * latticeDet q b c = 0

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.mem_edgeLatticePoints_of_mem_segment
statement:
lemma mem_edgeLatticePoints_of_mem_segment
    (a b p : ℤ × ℤ)
    (h : toReal p ∈ segment ℝ (toReal a) (toReal b)) :
    p ∈ edgeLatticePoints a b

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.latticeDet_eq_bary_mul_of_affine
statement:
/-- Barycentric area-weight identities (third-argument affinity + swap). -/
lemma latticeDet_eq_bary_mul_of_affine
    (q v w p : ℤ × ℤ) (α β γ : ℝ)
    (hsum : α + β + γ = 1)
    (heq : α • toReal q + β • toReal v + γ • toReal w = toReal p) :
    (latticeDet v w p : ℝ) = α * (latticeDet q v w : ℝ) ∧
      (latticeDet q p w : ℝ) = β * (latticeDet q v w : ℝ) ∧
      (latticeDet q v p : ℝ) = γ * (latticeDet q v w : ℝ)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.latticeDet_nonneg_of_memClosedTriangle
statement:
lemma latticeDet_nonneg_of_memClosedTriangle
    (q v w p : ℤ × ℤ) (hp : MemClosedTriangle q v w p)
    (hD : 0 < latticeDet q v w) :
    0 ≤ latticeDet v w p ∧ 0 ≤ latticeDet q p w ∧ 0 ≤ latticeDet q v p

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.mem_edgeLatticePoints_of_weight_zero_bc
statement:
lemma mem_edgeLatticePoints_of_weight_zero_bc
    (q v w p : ℤ × ℤ) (hp : MemClosedTriangle q v w p)
    (hD : 0 < latticeDet q v w) (hz : latticeDet v w p = 0) :
    p ∈ edgeLatticePoints v w

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.mem_edgeLatticePoints_of_weight_zero_ca
statement:
lemma mem_edgeLatticePoints_of_weight_zero_ca
    (q v w p : ℤ × ℤ) (hp : MemClosedTriangle q v w p)
    (hD : 0 < latticeDet q v w) (hz : latticeDet q p w = 0) :
    p ∈ edgeLatticePoints w q

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.mem_edgeLatticePoints_of_weight_zero_ab
statement:
lemma mem_edgeLatticePoints_of_weight_zero_ab
    (q v w p : ℤ × ℤ) (hp : MemClosedTriangle q v w p)
    (hD : 0 < latticeDet q v w) (hz : latticeDet q v p = 0) :
    p ∈ edgeLatticePoints q v

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.latticeDet_pos_of_memClosedTriangle_offBoundary
statement:
/-- `OffTriangleBoundary` ⇒ strict positive area weights. -/
theorem latticeDet_pos_of_memClosedTriangle_offBoundary
    (q v w r : ℤ × ℤ) (hr : MemClosedTriangle q v w r)
    (hD : 0 < latticeDet q v w) (hoff : OffTriangleBoundary q v w r) :
    0 < latticeDet v w r ∧ 0 < latticeDet q r w ∧ 0 < latticeDet q v r

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.latticeDet_swap_middle
statement:
lemma latticeDet_swap_middle (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    latticeDet a b c = -latticeDet a c b

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.false_of_vertex_mem_interiorFan_ear_ne_of_mem_interior
statement:
/-- Foreign vertex in an interior-fan ear contradicts supporting half-plane at that
vertex (works for any interior apex; not classical Pick). -/
lemma false_of_vertex_mem_interiorFan_ear_ne_of_mem_interior
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hq : q ∈ P.interiorLatticePoints) (i j : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hne_i : P.vertex j ≠ P.vertex i)
    (hne_n : P.vertex j ≠ P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))
    (hvj : MemClosedTriangle q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) (P.vertex j)) :
    False

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.false_of_vertex_mem_interiorFan_ear_ne
statement:
/-- Foreign-vertex / interior contradiction for a polygon vertex in an ear
under `TwoInterior` (delegates to the general half-plane form). -/
lemma false_of_vertex_mem_interiorFan_ear_ne
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q r : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h : TwoInterior P q r) (i j : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hne_i : P.vertex j ≠ P.vertex i)
    (hne_n : P.vertex j ≠ P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))
    (hvj : MemClosedTriangle q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) (P.vertex j)) :
    False

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_two_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_twoInterior_occupied_offBoundary
statement:
/-- **I = 2 shoelace Pick-form** without uniqueness hyp (still needs
`OffTriangleBoundary`; not classical Pick). -/
theorem shoelace_eq_two_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_twoInterior_occupied_offBoundary
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q r : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h : TwoInterior P q r) (i : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hr : MemClosedTriangle q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) r)
    (hoff : OffTriangleBoundary q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) r) :
    P.shoelace = (2 : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.exists_spanning_direction
statement:
/-- The affine direction of a `1`-dimensional set is spanned by one nonzero vector. -/
lemma exists_spanning_direction [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {e : Set E} (hne : e.Nonempty)
    (hdim : affDim e = 1) :
    ∃ d : E, d ≠ 0 ∧ (affineSpan ℝ e).direction = Submodule.span ℝ {d}

name: EulersGem.injOn_inner_of_affDim_eq_one
statement:
/-- On a `1`-dimensional set, the functional along its direction is injective. -/
lemma injOn_inner_of_affDim_eq_one {e : Set E} {d : E} (hdne : d ≠ 0)
    (hspan : (affineSpan ℝ e).direction = Submodule.span ℝ {d}) :
    Set.InjOn (fun x => ⟪d, x⟫) e

name: EulersGem.mem_extremePoints_of_isMaxOn
statement:
/-- The argmax of an injective supporting functional over the generators is an extreme
point of the hull. -/
lemma mem_extremePoints_of_isMaxOn {W : Set E} {d w : E}
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (fun x => ⟪d, x⟫) (convexHull ℝ W))
    (hwW : w ∈ W) (hmax : ∀ v ∈ W, ⟪d, v⟫ ≤ ⟪d, w⟫) :
    w ∈ (convexHull ℝ W).extremePoints ℝ

name: EulersGem.extremePoints_eq_pair
statement:
/-- **A one-dimensional V-polytope has exactly two extreme points:** the extremes of an
injective supporting functional. -/
theorem extremePoints_eq_pair [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {W : Set E} (hWfin : W.Finite)
    (hWne : W.Nonempty) (hdim : affDim (convexHull ℝ W) = 1) :
    ∃ u v : E, u ≠ v ∧ (convexHull ℝ W).extremePoints ℝ = {u, v}

name: EulersGem.ncard_vertices_of_edge
statement:
/-- **An edge of a polytope has exactly two vertices.** If `e` is a `1`-dimensional face of a
polytope `p`, exactly two `0`-dimensional faces of `p` are contained in `e`.

This discharges the `hedge_verts` hypothesis of the Platonic classification. -/
theorem ncard_vertices_of_edge [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {p : Set E} (hP : IsPolytope p)
    {e : Set E} (he : IsFaceOf p e) (hdim : affDim e = 1) :
    {w : Set E | (IsFaceOf p w ∧ affDim w = 0) ∧ w ⊆ e}.ncard = 2

name: EulersGem.ProdR
statement: abbrev ProdR := WithLp 2 (E × ℝ)

name: EulersGem.heightVec
statement: noncomputable def heightVec : ProdR (E := E) := toLp 2 ((0 : E), (1 : ℝ))

name: EulersGem.augmLinear
statement:
noncomputable def augmLinear : E →ₗ[ℝ] ProdR (E := E) :=
  (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℝ (E × ℝ)).symm ∘ₗ LinearMap.inl ℝ E ℝ

name: EulersGem.augmLinear_apply
statement: lemma augmLinear_apply (x : E) : augmLinear (E := E) x = toLp 2 (x, (0 : ℝ))

name: EulersGem.augmLinear_injective
statement: lemma augmLinear_injective : Function.Injective (augmLinear (E := E))

name: EulersGem.heightOneAffine
statement:
noncomputable def heightOneAffine : E →ᵃ[ℝ] ProdR (E := E) :=
  (AffineEquiv.constVAdd ℝ (ProdR (E := E)) (heightVec (E := E))).toAffineMap.comp
    augmLinear.toAffineMap

name: EulersGem.heightOneAffine_apply
statement:
lemma heightOneAffine_apply (x : E) :
    heightOneAffine (E := E) x = toLp 2 (x, (1 : ℝ))

name: EulersGem.heightOneAffine_injective
statement: lemma heightOneAffine_injective : Function.Injective (heightOneAffine (E := E))

name: EulersGem.heightOneAffine_inner
statement:
lemma heightOneAffine_inner (x : E) :
    ⟪heightVec (E := E), heightOneAffine x⟫ = 1

name: EulersGem.finrank_prodR
statement:
lemma finrank_prodR [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] :
    Module.finrank ℝ (ProdR (E := E)) = Module.finrank ℝ E + 1

name: EulersGem.isFaceOf_image_linear
statement:
lemma isFaceOf_image_linear {f : E →ₗ[ℝ] F} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    {S T : Set E} (h : IsFaceOf S T) :

name: EulersGem.isFaceOf_of_image_linear
statement:
lemma isFaceOf_of_image_linear {f : E →ₗ[ℝ] F} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    {S T : Set E} (h : IsFaceOf (f '' S) (f '' T)) :
    IsFaceOf S T

name: EulersGem.isFaceOf_vadd
statement:
lemma isFaceOf_vadd (v : E) {S T : Set E} (h : IsFaceOf S T) :
    IsFaceOf ((fun x => v + x) '' S) ((fun x => v + x) '' T)

name: EulersGem.isFaceOf_of_vadd
EulersGem.affineMap_eq_vadd_linear
statement:
lemma affineMap_eq_vadd_linear (f : E →ᵃ[ℝ] F) (x : E) :
    f x = f 0 + f.linear x

name: EulersGem.image_eq_vadd_linear_image
statement:
lemma image_eq_vadd_linear_image (f : E →ᵃ[ℝ] F) (U : Set E) :
    f '' U = (fun y => f 0 + y) '' (f.linear '' U)

name: EulersGem.isFaceOf_image_affine
statement:
lemma isFaceOf_image_affine {f : E →ᵃ[ℝ] F} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    {S T : Set E} (h : IsFaceOf S T) :
    IsFaceOf (f '' S) (f '' T)

name: EulersGem.isFaceOf_of_image_affine
statement:
lemma isFaceOf_of_image_affine {f : E →ᵃ[ℝ] F} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    {S T : Set E} (h : IsFaceOf (f '' S) (f '' T)) :
    IsFaceOf S T

name: EulersGem.affDim_image_affine
statement:
lemma affDim_image_affine (f : E →ᵃ[ℝ] F) (hf : Function.Injective f) (s : Set E) :
    affDim (f '' s) = affDim s

name: EulersGem.faces_image_affine
statement:
lemma faces_image_affine (f : E →ᵃ[ℝ] F) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (p : Set E) (d : ℤ) :
    {g : Set F | IsFaceOf (f '' p) g ∧ affDim g = d} =
      (fun F : Set E => f '' F) '' {F : Set E | IsFaceOf p F ∧ affDim F = d}

name: EulersGem.faceEulerSum_image_affine
statement:
lemma faceEulerSum_image_affine (f : E →ᵃ[ℝ] F) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (p : Set E) (n : ℕ) :
    faceEulerSum (f '' p) n = faceEulerSum p n

name: EulersGem.convex_heightOneAffine_image
statement:
lemma convex_heightOneAffine_image {p : Set E} (hp : Convex ℝ p) :
    Convex ℝ (heightOneAffine (E := E) '' p)

name: EulersGem.isPolytope_heightOneAffine_image
statement:
lemma isPolytope_heightOneAffine_image {p : Set E} (hP : IsPolytope p) :
    IsPolytope (heightOneAffine (E := E) '' p)

name: EulersGem.height_one_of_mem_image
EulersGem.inner_toLp
statement:
lemma inner_toLp (u v : E × ℝ) :
    ⟪toLp 2 u, toLp 2 v⟫ = ⟪u.1, v.1⟫ + u.2 * v.2

name: EulersGem.embedHyperplanes
statement:
noncomputable def embedHyperplanes (H : Set (Hyperplane E)) :
    Set (Hyperplane (ProdR (E := E))) :=
  (fun h : Hyperplane E => (toLp 2 (h.1, (0 : ℝ)), h.2)) '' H ∪
    {(heightVec (E := E), (1 : ℝ)), (-heightVec (E := E), (-1 : ℝ))}

name: EulersGem.embedHyperplanes_finite
statement:
lemma embedHyperplanes_finite {H : Set (Hyperplane E)} (hH : H.Finite) :
    (embedHyperplanes (E := E) H).Finite

name: EulersGem.mem_embedHalfspace_side
statement:
lemma mem_embedHalfspace_side (h : Hyperplane E) (x : E) :
    ⟪toLp 2 (h.1, (0 : ℝ)), heightOneAffine (E := E) x⟫ = ⟪h.1, x⟫

name: EulersGem.heightOneAffine_image_subset_iInter
statement:
lemma heightOneAffine_image_subset_iInter {H : Set (Hyperplane E)} {p : Set E}
    (hp : p = ⋂ h ∈ H, closedHalfspace h.1 h.2) :
    heightOneAffine (E := E) '' p ⊆
      ⋂ k ∈ embedHyperplanes (E := E) H, closedHalfspace k.1 k.2

name: EulersGem.iInter_subset_heightOneAffine_image
statement:
lemma iInter_subset_heightOneAffine_image {H : Set (Hyperplane E)} {p : Set E}
    (hp : p = ⋂ h ∈ H, closedHalfspace h.1 h.2) :
    (⋂ k ∈ embedHyperplanes (E := E) H, closedHalfspace k.1 k.2) ⊆
      heightOneAffine (E := E) '' p

name: EulersGem.heightOneAffine_image_eq_iInter
statement:
lemma heightOneAffine_image_eq_iInter {H : Set (Hyperplane E)} {p : Set E}
    (hp : p = ⋂ h ∈ H, closedHalfspace h.1 h.2) :
    heightOneAffine (E := E) '' p =
      ⋂ k ∈ embedHyperplanes (E := E) H, closedHalfspace k.1 k.2

name: EulersGem.affineSpan_eq_top_of_affDim_eq_finrank
statement:
lemma affineSpan_eq_top_of_affDim_eq_finrank [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {s : Set E} (h : affDim s = Module.finrank ℝ E) :
    affineSpan ℝ s = ⊤

name: EulersGem.interior_nonempty_of_affDim_eq_finrank
statement:
lemma interior_nonempty_of_affDim_eq_finrank [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {s : Set E} (hConv : Convex ℝ s) (h : affDim s = Module.finrank ℝ E) :
    (interior s).Nonempty

name: EulersGem.interior_closedHalfspace
statement:
lemma interior_closedHalfspace {a : E} (ha : a ≠ 0) (b : ℝ) :
    interior (closedHalfspace a b) = {x : E | ⟪a, x⟫ < b}

name: EulersGem.exists_openDual_embed
statement:
lemma exists_openDual_embed [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {H : Set (Hyperplane E)} {p : Set E}
    (hp : p = ⋂ h ∈ H, closedHalfspace h.1 h.2)
    (hConv : Convex ℝ p) (hdim : affDim p = Module.finrank ℝ E) :
    ({z : ProdR (E := E) |
        ∀ a ∈ homogenizeNormals (embedHyperplanes (E := E) H) (heightVec (E := E)) \
            ({0} : Set (ProdR (E := E))),
          0 < ⟪a, z⟫}).Nonempty

name: EulersGem.faceEulerSum_heightOneAffine_eq_one
statement:
lemma faceEulerSum_heightOneAffine_eq_one [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {H : Set (Hyperplane E)} {p : Set E}
    (hH : H.Finite)
    (hp : p = ⋂ h ∈ H, closedHalfspace h.1 h.2)
    (hP : IsPolytope p) (hConv : Convex ℝ p) (hpne : p.Nonempty)
    (hdim : affDim p = Module.finrank ℝ E)
    (_hn : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E) :
    faceEulerSum (heightOneAffine (E := E) '' p)
      (Module.finrank ℝ (ProdR (E := E)) - 1) = 1

name: EulersGem.Euler_Poincare_full
statement:
/-- Paulson `Euler_Poincare_full`. -/
theorem Euler_Poincare_full [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {H : Set (Hyperplane E)} {p : Set E}
    (hH : H.Finite)
    (hp : p = ⋂ h ∈ H, closedHalfspace h.1 h.2)
    (hP : IsPolytope p)
    (hdim : affDim p = Module.finrank ℝ E)
    (hn : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E) :
    faceEulerSum p (Module.finrank ℝ E) = 1

name: EulersGem.faces_dim_eq_finrank_eq_singleton
statement:
lemma faces_dim_eq_finrank_eq_singleton [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {p : Set E} (hConv : Convex ℝ p) (hdim : affDim p = Module.finrank ℝ E) :
    {f : Set E | IsFaceOf p f ∧ affDim f = Module.finrank ℝ E} = ({p} : Set (Set E))

name: EulersGem.euler_relation_convex_3polytope
statement:
theorem euler_relation_convex_3polytope [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {H : Set (Hyperplane E)} {p : Set E}
    (hH : H.Finite)
    (hp : p = ⋂ h ∈ H, closedHalfspace h.1 h.2)
    (hP : IsPolytope p)
    (hdim : affDim p = 3)
    (hE : Module.finrank ℝ E = 3) :
    ({f : Set E | IsFaceOf p f ∧ affDim f = 0}.ncard : ℤ) -
      ({f : Set E | IsFaceOf p f ∧ affDim f = 1}.ncard : ℤ) +
      ({f : Set E | IsFaceOf p f ∧ affDim f = 2}.ncard : ℤ) = 2

name: EulersGem.cellSign
statement:
/-- Sign of a cell in the combinatorial Euler sum: `(-1)^{affDim C}`. -/
noncomputable def cellSign (C : Set E) : ℤ :=
  (-1 : ℤ) ^ (affDim C).toNat

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic
statement:
/-- Combinatorial Euler characteristic of `S` relative to arrangement `A`.
Isabelle: `Euler_characteristic`. Returns `0` if there are infinitely many cells
(Paulson always assumes `finite A`). -/
noncomputable def eulerCharacteristic (A : Set (Hyperplane E)) (S : Set E) : ℤ :=
  if h : {C : Set E | IsHyperplaneCell A C ∧ C ⊆ S}.Finite then
    ∑ C ∈ h.toFinset, cellSign C
  else
    0

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_of_finite
EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_eq_sum
statement:
lemma eulerCharacteristic_eq_sum {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {S : Set E}
    (hA : A.Finite) :
    eulerCharacteristic A S =
      ∑ C ∈ (finite_isHyperplaneCell_restrict hA (fun C => C ⊆ S)).toFinset, cellSign C

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_empty
statement:
@[simp] lemma eulerCharacteristic_empty (A : Set (Hyperplane E)) :
    eulerCharacteristic A (∅ : Set E) = 0

name: EulersGem.cells_subset_cell
EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_cell
statement:
/-- Euler characteristic of a single cell is its sign. Isabelle: `Euler_characteristic_cell`. -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_cell {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {C : Set E}
    (hA : A.Finite) (hC : IsHyperplaneCell A C) :
    eulerCharacteristic A C = cellSign C

name: EulersGem.cells_subset_sUnion
statement:
/-- Cells contained in a union of `A`-cells are exactly those cells. -/
lemma cells_subset_sUnion {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {Cs : Set (Set E)}
    (hCs : ∀ C ∈ Cs, IsHyperplaneCell A C) :
    {D : Set E | IsHyperplaneCell A D ∧ D ⊆ ⋃₀ Cs} = Cs

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_cell_sUnion
statement:
/-- Euler characteristic of a union of cells is the sum of their signs.
Isabelle: `Euler_characteristic_cell_Union`. -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_cell_sUnion {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {Cs : Set (Set E)}
    (hA : A.Finite) (hCs : ∀ C ∈ Cs, IsHyperplaneCell A C) :
    eulerCharacteristic A (⋃₀ Cs) =
      ∑ C ∈ (show Cs.Finite from
        (finite_isHyperplaneCell hA).subset fun C hC => hCs C hC).toFinset,
        cellSign C

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_cellcomplex_union
statement:
/-- Additivity for a disjoint union of two cell complexes.
Isabelle: `Euler_characteristic_cellcomplex_Un`. -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_cellcomplex_union {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {S T : Set E}
    (hA : A.Finite) (hS : IsHyperplaneCellComplex A S) (hT : IsHyperplaneCellComplex A T)
    (hd : Disjoint S T) :
    eulerCharacteristic A (S ∪ T) =
      eulerCharacteristic A S + eulerCharacteristic A T

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_empty_arrangement_univ
statement:
/-- Empty arrangement: the only cell is `univ`, so Euler char of `univ` is
`(-1)^{finrank}`. -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_empty_arrangement_univ
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E] :
    eulerCharacteristic (∅ : Set (Hyperplane E)) (univ : Set E) =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_invariant_refl
statement:
/-- Trivial invariance: same arrangement. -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_invariant_refl {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {S : Set E} :
    eulerCharacteristic A S = eulerCharacteristic A S

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_eq_of_same_cells
statement:
/-- If `A ⊆ B` and every `A`-cell inside `S` remains an `A`-cell that is also a
`B`-cell (i.e. refining does not split those cells), Euler chars agree.
Special case of refinement invariance when the new hyperplanes do not cut `S`. -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_eq_of_same_cells {A B : Set (Hyperplane E)} {S : Set E}
    (hA : A.Finite) (hB : B.Finite)
    (hEq : {C : Set E | IsHyperplaneCell A C ∧ C ⊆ S} =
           {C : Set E | IsHyperplaneCell B C ∧ C ⊆ S}) :
    eulerCharacteristic A S = eulerCharacteristic B S

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_invariant_of_eq
statement:
/-- Refinement invariance when `A = B` as sets of hyperplanes (finite). -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_invariant_of_eq {A B : Set (Hyperplane E)} {S : Set E}
    (_hA : A.Finite) (_hB : B.Finite) (hEq : A = B) :
    eulerCharacteristic A S = eulerCharacteristic B S

name: EulersGem.cellSign_cell_inter_halfSpace_lt
statement:
lemma cellSign_cell_inter_halfSpace_lt {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {C : Set E}
    (hA : A.Finite) (hC : IsHyperplaneCell A C) (a : E) (b : ℝ)
    (hne : (C ∩ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ < b}).Nonempty) :
    cellSign (C ∩ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ < b}) = cellSign C

name: EulersGem.cellSign_cell_inter_halfSpace_gt
statement:
lemma cellSign_cell_inter_halfSpace_gt {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {C : Set E}
    (hA : A.Finite) (hC : IsHyperplaneCell A C) (a : E) (b : ℝ)
    (hne : (C ∩ {x | b < ⟪a, x⟫}).Nonempty) :
    cellSign (C ∩ {x | b < ⟪a, x⟫}) = cellSign C

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_insert_of_cells_preserved
statement:
/-- If every `A`-cell inside `S` remains a cell of `insert h A`, Euler chars agree.
Special case of insert when the new hyperplane does not cut any cell of `S`. -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_insert_of_cells_preserved {A : Set (Hyperplane E)}
    {h : Hyperplane E} {S : Set E}
    (hA : A.Finite)
    (hPres : {C : Set E | IsHyperplaneCell A C ∧ C ⊆ S} =
             {C : Set E | IsHyperplaneCell (insert h A) C ∧ C ⊆ S}) :
    eulerCharacteristic (insert h A) S = eulerCharacteristic A S

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_insert_mem
statement:
/-- Inserting a hyperplane already in the arrangement does nothing. -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_insert_mem {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {h : Hyperplane E}
    {S : Set E} (_hA : A.Finite) (hh : h ∈ A) :
    eulerCharacteristic (insert h A) S = eulerCharacteristic A S

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_insert_zero
statement:
/-- Degenerate hyperplane `(0, b)` does not refine the arrangement's cells
(singleton cell is `univ`), so Euler char is unchanged on any cell complex. -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_insert_zero {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {b : ℝ} {S : Set E}
    (hA : A.Finite) (_hS : IsHyperplaneCellComplex A S) :
    eulerCharacteristic (insert ((0 : E), b) A) S = eulerCharacteristic A S

name: EulersGem.toNat_affDim_sub_one
statement:
lemma toNat_affDim_sub_one {n : ℤ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    (n - 1).toNat = n.toNat - 1

name: EulersGem.sign_cut_identity
statement:
/-- Sign identity: `(-1)^{n-1} + 2(-1)^n = (-1)^n` for `n > 0`. -/
lemma sign_cut_identity {n : ℤ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    (-1 : ℤ) ^ (n - 1).toNat + 2 * ((-1 : ℤ) ^ n.toNat) =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ n.toNat

name: EulersGem.cellSign_cut_into_three
statement:
/-- When a cell is properly cut by a hyperplane (all three pieces nonempty), the
three signs sum to the original cell sign. -/
lemma cellSign_cut_into_three [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {C : Set E}
    (hA : A.Finite) (hC : IsHyperplaneCell A C) (a : E) (b : ℝ)
    (hlt : (C ∩ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ < b}).Nonempty)
    (heq : (C ∩ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ = b}).Nonempty)
    (hgt : (C ∩ {x | b < ⟪a, x⟫}).Nonempty) :
    cellSign (C ∩ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ < b}) +
      cellSign (C ∩ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ = b}) +
      cellSign (C ∩ {x | b < ⟪a, x⟫}) =
      cellSign C

name: EulersGem.cells_insert_subset_of_cell
EulersGem.isHyperplaneCell_insert_of_subset_side
statement:
/-- If `C` lies in one side of `(a,b)`, then `C` remains a single cell of `insert (a,b) A`. -/
lemma isHyperplaneCell_insert_of_subset_side {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {a : E} {b : ℝ}
    {C : Set E} (hC : IsHyperplaneCell A C) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hside : C ⊆ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ < b} ∨ C ⊆ {x | b < ⟪a, x⟫} ∨ C ⊆ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ = b}) :
    IsHyperplaneCell (insert (a, b) A) C

name: EulersGem.cells_insert_of_subset_side
EulersGem.cell_cut_meets_all_three
statement:
/-- Proper cut: if an `A`-cell is not contained in any singleton side, it meets all three. -/
lemma cell_cut_meets_all_three {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {C : Set E}
    (hA : A.Finite) (hC : IsHyperplaneCell A C) {a : E} {b : ℝ} (_ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hnot : ¬ (C ⊆ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ < b} ∨ C ⊆ {x | b < ⟪a, x⟫} ∨ C ⊆ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ = b})) :
    (C ∩ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ < b}).Nonempty ∧
      (C ∩ {x | ⟪a, x⟫ = b}).Nonempty ∧
      (C ∩ {x | b < ⟪a, x⟫}).Nonempty

name: EulersGem.nonempty_inter_comm
statement:
/-- Helper: nonempty of `C ∩ H` gives nonempty of `H ∩ C`. -/
lemma nonempty_inter_comm {α : Type*} {s t : Set α} (h : (s ∩ t).Nonempty) :
    (t ∩ s).Nonempty

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_insert_cell
statement:
/-- On a single `A`-cell, inserting `(a,b)` leaves the Euler characteristic unchanged. -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_insert_cell [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {a : E} {b : ℝ} {C : Set E}
    (hA : A.Finite) (hC : IsHyperplaneCell A C) :
    eulerCharacteristic (insert (a, b) A) C = cellSign C

name: EulersGem.Finset.sup_id_eq_sUnion
statement:
/-- `Finset.sup id` of sets is their `sUnion`. -/
lemma Finset.sup_id_eq_sUnion {α : Type*} (s : Finset (Set α)) :
    s.sup id = ⋃₀ (s : Set (Set α))

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_cellcomplex_finsetSum
statement:
/-- Euler characteristic of a finite pairwise-disjoint union of cell complexes. -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_cellcomplex_finsetSum {A : Set (Hyperplane E)}
    (hA : A.Finite) (Cs : Finset (Set E))
    (hCs : ∀ C ∈ Cs, IsHyperplaneCellComplex A C)
    (hdisj : ∀ C ∈ Cs, ∀ D ∈ Cs, C ≠ D → Disjoint C D) :
    eulerCharacteristic A (Cs.sup id) = ∑ C ∈ Cs, eulerCharacteristic A C

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_insert
statement:
/-- Isabelle: `Euler_characterstic_lemma`. -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_insert [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {h : Hyperplane E} {S : Set E}
    (hA : A.Finite) (hS : IsHyperplaneCellComplex A S) :
    eulerCharacteristic (insert h A) S = eulerCharacteristic A S

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_union_right
statement:
/-- Inserting all hyperplanes of a finite set `B`, one by one. -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_union_right [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {A B : Set (Hyperplane E)} {S : Set E}
    (hA : A.Finite) (hB : B.Finite) (hS : IsHyperplaneCellComplex A S) :
    eulerCharacteristic (A ∪ B) S = eulerCharacteristic A S

name: EulersGem.eulerCharacteristic_invariant
statement:
/-- Isabelle: `Euler_characterstic_invariant`. -/
lemma eulerCharacteristic_invariant [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {A B : Set (Hyperplane E)} {S : Set E}
    (hA : A.Finite) (hB : B.Finite)
    (hAS : IsHyperplaneCellComplex A S) (hBS : IsHyperplaneCellComplex B S) :
    eulerCharacteristic A S = eulerCharacteristic B S

name: EulersGem.conicHull
EulersGem.subset_conicHull
statement: lemma subset_conicHull (s : Set E) : s ⊆ conicHull s

name: EulersGem.isConic_conicHull
statement: lemma isConic_conicHull (s : Set E) : IsConic (conicHull s)

name: EulersGem.zero_mem_conicHull
statement: lemma zero_mem_conicHull {s : Set E} (hs : s.Nonempty) : (0 : E) ∈ conicHull s

name: EulersGem.conicHull_mono
statement: lemma conicHull_mono {s t : Set E} (h : s ⊆ t) : conicHull s ⊆ conicHull t

name: EulersGem.conicHull_inter_height_one
statement:
/-- Recovering a point of height `1` from its ray. -/
lemma conicHull_inter_height_one {s : Set E} {i : E}
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, ⟪i, x⟫ = 1) :
    conicHull s ∩ {y : E | ⟪i, y⟫ = 1} = s

name: EulersGem.ConeSliceFaceBijection
statement:
/-- Face bijection hypotheses for the Paulson cone→slice Euler identity. -/
structure ConeSliceFaceBijection (S p : Set E) (n : ℕ) : Prop where
  zero_face : {f : Set E | IsFaceOf S f ∧ affDim f = 0} = ({({0} : Set E)} : Set (Set E))
  faces_succ :
    ∀ d : ℕ, d < n →
      {f : Set E | IsFaceOf S f ∧ affDim f = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)} =
        conicHull '' {F : Set E | IsFaceOf p F ∧ affDim F = (d : ℤ)}
  conic_inj :
    ∀ d : ℕ, d < n →
      InjOn conicHull {F : Set E | IsFaceOf p F ∧ affDim F = (d : ℤ)}

name: EulersGem.faceEulerSum_slice_of_cone
statement:
/-- Cone Euler sum `0` + face bijection ⇒ slice Euler sum `1`.
Paulson `Euler_Poincare_lemma` bookkeeping. -/
theorem faceEulerSum_slice_of_cone {S p : Set E} {n : ℕ}
    (hBij : ConeSliceFaceBijection S p n)
    (hCone : faceEulerSum S n = 0)
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    faceEulerSum p (n - 1) = 1

name: EulersGem.homogenizeNormals
EulersGem.homogenizeNormals_finite
statement:
lemma homogenizeNormals_finite {H : Set (Hyperplane E)} (hH : H.Finite) (i : E) :
    (homogenizeNormals H i).Finite

name: EulersGem.faceEulerSum_simplex_faceCount
statement:
/-- `∑_{d=0}^{n} (-1)^d C(n+1, d+1) = 1`. -/
theorem faceEulerSum_simplex_faceCount (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ d ∈ range (n + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ d * (faceCount n d : ℤ) = 1

name: EulersGem.euler_relation_of_faceEulerSum
statement:
/-- If a 3-polytope has `faceEulerSum = 1` and a unique solid 3-face, then `V − E + F = 2`. -/
theorem euler_relation_of_faceEulerSum
    (p : Set E) (V E_ F : ℕ)
    (hsum : faceEulerSum p 3 = 1)
    (hV : ({f : Set E | IsFaceOf p f ∧ affDim f = 0}.ncard) = V)
    (hE : ({f : Set E | IsFaceOf p f ∧ affDim f = 1}.ncard) = E_)
    (hF : ({f : Set E | IsFaceOf p f ∧ affDim f = 2}.ncard) = F)
    (hSolid : ({f : Set E | IsFaceOf p f ∧ affDim f = 3}.ncard) = 1) :
    (V : ℤ) - E_ + F = 2

name: EulersGem.tetrahedron_euler_relation_from_faceCount
statement:
/-- Tetrahedron face counts: `V − E + F = 2`. -/
theorem tetrahedron_euler_relation_from_faceCount :
    (faceCount 3 0 : ℤ) - faceCount 3 1 + faceCount 3 2 = 2

name: EulersGem.EulerPoincareLemmaGoal
statement:
def EulerPoincareLemmaGoal : String :=
  "faceEulerSum (S ∩ {⟪i,·⟫ = 1}) (n-1) = 1 when ConeSliceFaceBijection holds"

name: EulersGem.EulerPoincareFullGoal'
statement:
def EulerPoincareFullGoal' : String :=
  "faceEulerSum p (finrank) = 1 for full-dimensional convex polytopes"

name: EulersGem.isFaceOf_singleton_zero_of_height
statement:
/-- If every nonzero point of a convex set `S` has strictly positive height `⟪i,·⟫`,
then `{0}` is a face of `S` (Paulson apex for cones over height-1 polytopes). -/
lemma isFaceOf_singleton_zero_of_height {S : Set E} {i : E}
    (_hConv : Convex ℝ S) (h0 : (0 : E) ∈ S)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ S, x ≠ 0 → 0 < ⟪i, x⟫) :
    IsFaceOf S ({0} : Set E)

name: EulersGem.faces_dim_zero_eq_singleton_zero
statement:
/-- Under strict positive height, every nonempty face of affine dimension `0` is `{0}`.
This discharges `ConeSliceFaceBijection.zero_face` once one knows all `0`-faces are singletons
(automatic for convex sets: `affDim = 0` ⇒ singleton). -/
lemma faces_dim_zero_eq_singleton_zero {S : Set E} {i : E}
    (hS : IsConic S) (hConv : Convex ℝ S) (h0 : (0 : E) ∈ S)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ S, x ≠ 0 → 0 < ⟪i, x⟫)
    (hSing : ∀ f, IsFaceOf S f → affDim f = 0 → ∃ a, f = {a}) :
    {f : Set E | IsFaceOf S f ∧ affDim f = 0} = ({({0} : Set E)} : Set (Set E))

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data
statement:
/-- Explicit polytope data. -/
structure Data where
  pts : List V
  facets : List (List ℕ)
  edges : List (List ℕ)
  certs : List ((ℕ × ℕ) × (Int × List (ℕ × ZPhi)))

name: EulersGem.Explicit.sumZ
statement:
/-- Sum of the weights of a certificate. -/
def sumZ : List (ℕ × ZPhi) → ZPhi
  | [] => 0
  | uc :: l => uc.2 + sumZ l

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.n
statement:
/-- Number of points. -/
def n : ℕ := D.pts.length

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.pt
statement:
/-- The `i`-th point. -/
def pt (i : ℕ) : V := D.pts.getD i 0

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.nrm
statement:
/-- Normal of the plane through points `i, j, k`. -/
def nrm (i j k : ℕ) : V := V.cross (D.pt j - D.pt i) (D.pt k - D.pt i)

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.side
statement:
/-- Side of point `u` relative to the plane through `i` with normal `w`. -/
def side (w : V) (i u : ℕ) : Int := sgn (V.dot w (D.pt u - D.pt i))

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.zeroSet
statement:
/-- Points on the plane. -/
def zeroSet (w : V) (i : ℕ) : List ℕ := (List.range D.n).filter fun u => D.side w i u == 0

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.hasPos
statement:
/-- Some point strictly on the positive side. -/
def hasPos (w : V) (i : ℕ) : Bool := (List.range D.n).any fun u => D.side w i u == 1

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.hasNeg
statement:
/-- Some point strictly on the negative side. -/
def hasNeg (w : V) (i : ℕ) : Bool := (List.range D.n).any fun u => D.side w i u == -1

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.noTwo
statement:
/-- No sign computation hit the impossible case. -/
def noTwo (w : V) (i : ℕ) : Bool := (List.range D.n).all fun u => D.side w i u != 2

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.tripleOk
statement:
/-- The triple `i < j < k` spans a plane that either separates points or is a listed facet. -/
def tripleOk (i j k : ℕ) : Bool :=
  sgn (V.dot (D.nrm i j k) (D.nrm i j k)) == 1 && D.noTwo (D.nrm i j k) i &&
    ((D.hasPos (D.nrm i j k) i && D.hasNeg (D.nrm i j k) i) ||
      D.facets.contains (D.zeroSet (D.nrm i j k) i))

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.checkTriples
statement:
/-- Every triple is fine. -/
def checkTriples : Bool :=
  (List.range D.n).all fun i => (List.range D.n).all fun j => (List.range D.n).all fun k =>
    !(decide (i < j) && decide (j < k)) || D.tripleOk i j k

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.vertexOk
statement:
/-- Point `i` is the unique maximiser of `⟪pᵢ, ·⟫`. -/
def vertexOk (i : ℕ) : Bool :=
  (List.range D.n).all fun u =>
    u == i || sgn (V.dot (D.pt i) (D.pt i) - V.dot (D.pt i) (D.pt u)) == 1

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.checkVertices
statement:
/-- Every point is a vertex. -/
def checkVertices : Bool := (List.range D.n).all D.vertexOk

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.edgeOk
statement:
/-- A listed edge `[i, j]` is exposed by `⟪pᵢ + pⱼ, ·⟫`. -/
def edgeOk : List ℕ → Bool
  | [i, j] => decide (i < j) && decide (j < D.n) &&
      (V.dot (D.pt i + D.pt j) (D.pt i) == V.dot (D.pt i + D.pt j) (D.pt j) &&
        (List.range D.n).all fun u => u == i || u == j ||
          sgn (V.dot (D.pt i + D.pt j) (D.pt i) - V.dot (D.pt i + D.pt j) (D.pt u)) == 1)
  | _ => false

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.facetOk
statement:
/-- A listed facet is the zero set of the plane through its first three points, and all
points lie on one side of that plane. -/
def facetOk : List ℕ → Bool
  | i :: j :: k :: rest =>
      sgn (V.dot (D.nrm i j k) (D.nrm i j k)) == 1 && D.noTwo (D.nrm i j k) i &&
        !(D.hasPos (D.nrm i j k) i && D.hasNeg (D.nrm i j k) i) &&
        D.zeroSet (D.nrm i j k) i == i :: j :: k :: rest
  | _ => false

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.sumV
statement:
/-- Weighted sum of points. -/
def sumV : List (ℕ × ZPhi) → V
  | [] => 0
  | uc :: l => V.smul uc.2 (D.pt uc.1) + sumV l

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.certOk
statement:
/-- A certificate that `[i, j]` is not an edge. -/
def certOk (i j : ℕ) : Bool :=
  match D.certs.lookup (i, j) with
  | some (d, ν) => decide (0 < d) &&
      ν.all (fun uc => decide (uc.1 < D.n) && uc.1 != i && uc.1 != j && sgn uc.2 != -1 &&
        sgn uc.2 != 2) &&
      sumZ ν == ofInt (2 * d) && V.smul (ofInt d) (D.pt i + D.pt j) == D.sumV ν
  | none => false

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.checkPairs
statement:
/-- Every pair is a listed edge or certified not to be one. -/
def checkPairs : Bool :=
  (List.range D.n).all fun i => (List.range D.n).all fun j =>
    !decide (i < j) || D.edges.contains [i, j] || D.certOk i j

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.solid
statement:
/-- Some point lies off the plane of the first facet: the body is solid. -/
def solid : Bool :=
  match D.facets with
  | (i :: j :: k :: _) :: _ => (List.range D.n).any fun u => D.side (D.nrm i j k) i u != 0
  | _ => false

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.checkAll
statement:
/-- Everything at once. -/
def checkAll : Bool :=
  D.checkVertices && D.checkTriples && D.checkPairs && D.edges.all D.edgeOk &&
    D.facets.all D.facetOk && D.solid

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.P
statement:
/-- The `i`-th point in `ℝ³`. -/
noncomputable def P (i : ℕ) : R3 := (D.pt i).toR3

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.verts
statement:
/-- The vertex set. -/
noncomputable def verts : Set R3 := D.P '' {i | i < D.n}

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.body
statement:
/-- The polytope. -/
noncomputable def body : Set R3 := convexHull ℝ D.verts

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.hull
statement:
/-- The hull of a list of points. -/
noncomputable def hull (s : List ℕ) : Set R3 := convexHull ℝ (D.P '' {i | i ∈ s})

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.verts_finite
statement: lemma verts_finite : D.verts.Finite

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.isPolytope_body
statement: lemma isPolytope_body : IsPolytope D.body

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.inner_P_sub
statement:
lemma inner_P_sub (w : V) (i u : ℕ) :
    ⟪w.toR3, D.P u - D.P i⟫ = toReal (V.dot w (D.pt u - D.pt i))

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Exposed
EulersGem.Explicit.Data.argmax_eq
statement:
lemma argmax_eq {a : R3} {c : ℝ} {S : List ℕ} (hS : ∀ u, u ∈ S ↔ u < D.n ∧ ⟪a, D.P u⟫ = c) :
    {v ∈ D.verts | ⟪a, v⟫ = c} = D.P '' {i | i ∈ S}

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.le_of_verts
statement:
lemma le_of_verts {a : R3} {c : ℝ} (hle : ∀ u < D.n, ⟪a, D.P u⟫ ≤ c) :
    ∀ v ∈ D.verts, ⟪a, v⟫ ≤ c

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Exposed.isFaceOf
statement:
/-- An exposed list spans a face, cut out by its functional. -/
theorem Exposed.isFaceOf {S : List ℕ} (h : D.Exposed S) : IsFaceOf D.body (D.hull S)

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Exposed.hull_eq
EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Exposed.P_mem_hull
statement:
/-- The vertices in the hull of an exposed list are exactly its points. -/
theorem Exposed.P_mem_hull {S : List ℕ} (h : D.Exposed S) {u : ℕ} (hu : u < D.n) :
    D.P u ∈ D.hull S ↔ u ∈ S

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Exposed.lt
statement: lemma Exposed.lt {S : List ℕ} (h : D.Exposed S) {u : ℕ} (hu : u ∈ S) : u < D.n

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Exposed.hull_subset_iff
statement:
/-- Inclusion of exposed hulls is inclusion of index lists. -/
theorem Exposed.hull_subset_iff {S T : List ℕ} (hS : D.Exposed S) (hT : D.Exposed T) :
    D.hull S ⊆ D.hull T ↔ ∀ u ∈ S, u ∈ T

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Exposed.hull_inj
statement:
theorem Exposed.hull_inj {S T : List ℕ} (hS : D.Exposed S) (hT : D.Exposed T) :
    D.hull S = D.hull T ↔ ∀ u, u ∈ S ↔ u ∈ T

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.checkAll_parts
statement:
lemma checkAll_parts (h : D.checkAll = true) :
    D.checkVertices = true ∧ D.checkTriples = true ∧ D.checkPairs = true ∧
      D.edges.all D.edgeOk = true ∧ D.facets.all D.facetOk = true ∧ D.solid = true

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.inner_P_P
statement: lemma inner_P_P (i u : ℕ) : ⟪D.P i, D.P u⟫ = toReal (V.dot (D.pt i) (D.pt u))

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.vertex_lt
statement:
lemma vertex_lt (h : D.checkVertices = true) {i u : ℕ} (hi : i < D.n) (hu : u < D.n)
    (hne : u ≠ i) : ⟪D.P i, D.P u⟫ < ⟪D.P i, D.P i⟫

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.P_inj
statement:
lemma P_inj (h : D.checkVertices = true) {i u : ℕ} (hi : i < D.n) (hu : u < D.n)
    (he : D.P u = D.P i) : u = i

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.exposed_vertex
statement:
theorem exposed_vertex (h : D.checkVertices = true) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < D.n) :
    D.Exposed [i]

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.hull_singleton
statement: lemma hull_singleton (i : ℕ) : D.hull [i] = {D.P i}

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.side_pos
statement: lemma side_pos {w : V} {i u : ℕ} (h : D.side w i u = 1) : 0 < ⟪w.toR3, D.P u - D.P i⟫

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.side_neg
statement: lemma side_neg {w : V} {i u : ℕ} (h : D.side w i u = -1) : ⟪w.toR3, D.P u - D.P i⟫ < 0

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.side_zero_iff
statement:
lemma side_zero_iff {w : V} {i u : ℕ} (h : D.side w i u ≠ 2) :
    ⟪w.toR3, D.P u - D.P i⟫ = 0 ↔ D.side w i u = 0

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.noTwo_spec
statement:
lemma noTwo_spec {w : V} {i : ℕ} (h : D.noTwo w i = true) {u : ℕ} (hu : u < D.n) :
    D.side w i u ≠ 2

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.mem_zeroSet
statement: lemma mem_zeroSet {w : V} {i u : ℕ} : u ∈ D.zeroSet w i ↔ u < D.n ∧ D.side w i u = 0

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.hasPos_spec
statement:
lemma hasPos_spec {w : V} {i : ℕ} (h : D.hasPos w i = true) :
    ∃ u < D.n, D.side w i u = 1

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.hasNeg_spec
statement:
lemma hasNeg_spec {w : V} {i : ℕ} (h : D.hasNeg w i = true) :
    ∃ u < D.n, D.side w i u = -1

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.nrm_toR3
statement:
lemma nrm_toR3 (i j k : ℕ) :
    (D.nrm i j k).toR3 = R3.crs (D.P j - D.P i) (D.P k - D.P i)

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.nrm_ne_zero
statement:
lemma nrm_ne_zero {i j k : ℕ} (h : sgn (V.dot (D.nrm i j k) (D.nrm i j k)) = 1) :
    R3.crs (D.P j - D.P i) (D.P k - D.P i) ≠ 0

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.edgeOk_spec
statement:
theorem edgeOk_spec {e : List ℕ} (h : D.edgeOk e = true) :
    ∃ i j, e = [i, j] ∧ i < j ∧ j < D.n ∧ D.Exposed [i, j]

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.facetOk_spec
statement:
theorem facetOk_spec {f : List ℕ} (h : D.facetOk f = true) :
    ∃ i j k rest, f = i :: j :: k :: rest ∧ D.zeroSet (D.nrm i j k) i = f ∧
      sgn (V.dot (D.nrm i j k) (D.nrm i j k)) = 1 ∧ D.noTwo (D.nrm i j k) i = true ∧
      ¬ (D.hasPos (D.nrm i j k) i = true ∧ D.hasNeg (D.nrm i j k) i = true)

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.exposed_facet
statement:
/-- The points of a listed facet are exactly the maximisers of `±⟪n, ·⟫`. -/
theorem exposed_facet {f : List ℕ} (h : D.facetOk f = true) : D.Exposed f

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.affDim_facet
statement:
/-- A listed facet has affine dimension `2`. -/
theorem affDim_facet {f : List ℕ} (h : D.facetOk f = true) : affDim (D.hull f) = 2

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.affDim_edge
statement:
/-- A listed edge has affine dimension `1`. -/
theorem affDim_edge (hv : D.checkVertices = true) {e : List ℕ} (h : D.edgeOk e = true) :
    affDim (D.hull e) = 1

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.solid_spec
statement:
lemma solid_spec (h : D.solid = true) : ∃ i j k rest restF,
    D.facets = (i :: j :: k :: rest) :: restF ∧ ∃ t < D.n, D.side (D.nrm i j k) i t ≠ 0

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.affDim_body
statement:
/-- The body is three-dimensional. -/
theorem affDim_body (h : D.checkAll = true) : affDim D.body = 3

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.toReal_sumZ
statement: lemma toReal_sumZ (ν : List (ℕ × ZPhi)) : toReal (sumZ ν) = (ν.map fun uc => toReal uc.2).sum

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.inner_sumV
statement:
lemma inner_sumV (a : R3) (ν : List (ℕ × ZPhi)) :
    ⟪a, (D.sumV ν).toR3⟫ = (ν.map fun uc => toReal uc.2 * ⟪a, D.P uc.1⟫).sum

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.sum_le_of_forall
statement:
lemma sum_le_of_forall {c : ℝ} (ν : List (ℕ × ZPhi)) (f : ℕ → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ uc ∈ ν, 0 ≤ toReal uc.2 ∧ f uc.1 ≤ c) :
    (ν.map fun uc => toReal uc.2 * f uc.1).sum ≤ (ν.map fun uc => toReal uc.2).sum * c

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.sum_lt_of_forall
statement:
lemma sum_lt_of_forall {c : ℝ} (ν : List (ℕ × ZPhi)) (f : ℕ → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ uc ∈ ν, 0 ≤ toReal uc.2 ∧ f uc.1 < c) (hpos : 0 < (ν.map fun uc => toReal uc.2).sum) :
    (ν.map fun uc => toReal uc.2 * f uc.1).sum < (ν.map fun uc => toReal uc.2).sum * c

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.not_argmax_of_certOk
statement:
/-- A pair with a valid certificate is not the set of maximisers of any functional. -/
theorem not_argmax_of_certOk {i j : ℕ} (hc : D.certOk i j = true) {a : R3} {c : ℝ}
    (hle : ∀ u < D.n, ⟪a, D.P u⟫ ≤ c) (hi : ⟪a, D.P i⟫ = c) (hj : ⟪a, D.P j⟫ = c)
    (hother : ∀ u < D.n, u ≠ i → u ≠ j → ⟪a, D.P u⟫ ≠ c) : False

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.exists_three_sorted
statement:
lemma exists_three_sorted {W : Finset ℕ} (h : 2 < W.card) :
    ∃ i ∈ W, ∃ j ∈ W, ∃ k ∈ W, i < j ∧ j < k

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.face_cases
statement:
/-- **The face lattice of an explicit polytope.** If the checker accepts the data, every face
of the body is empty, the body, a single point, a listed edge, or a listed facet. -/
theorem face_cases (h : D.checkAll = true) {F : Set R3} (hF : IsFaceOf D.body F) :
    F = ∅ ∨ F = D.body ∨ (∃ i < D.n, F = D.hull [i]) ∨ (∃ e ∈ D.edges, F = D.hull e) ∨
      (∃ f ∈ D.facets, F = D.hull f)

name: EulersGem.Explicit.sameSet
statement:
/-- The two index lists have the same members. -/
def sameSet (a b : List ℕ) : Bool := a.all b.contains && b.all a.contains

name: EulersGem.Explicit.sub
statement:
/-- `a ⊆ b` as index lists. -/
def sub (a b : List ℕ) : Bool := a.all b.contains

name: EulersGem.Explicit.sub_iff
statement: lemma sub_iff {a b : List ℕ} : sub a b = true ↔ ∀ u ∈ a, u ∈ b

name: EulersGem.Explicit.sameSet_iff
statement: lemma sameSet_iff {a b : List ℕ} : sameSet a b = true ↔ ∀ u, u ∈ a ↔ u ∈ b

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.checkType
statement:
/-- Distinctness of the listed faces, and the face type `{s, m}` with two facets per edge. -/
def checkType (s m : ℕ) : Bool :=
  decide (((List.range D.n).map fun i => [i]).Pairwise fun a b => sameSet a b = false) &&
  decide (D.edges.Pairwise fun a b => sameSet a b = false) &&
  decide (D.facets.Pairwise fun a b => sameSet a b = false) &&
  D.facets.all (fun F => (D.edges.filter fun e => sub e F).length == s) &&
  D.edges.all (fun e => (D.facets.filter fun F => sub e F).length == 2) &&
  (List.range D.n).all (fun i => (D.edges.filter fun e => e.contains i).length == m)

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.hull_congr
statement: lemma hull_congr {S T : List ℕ} (h : ∀ u, u ∈ S ↔ u ∈ T) : D.hull S = D.hull T

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.exposed_edge
statement: theorem exposed_edge (h : D.checkAll = true) {e : List ℕ} (he : e ∈ D.edges) : D.Exposed e

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.exposed_facet'
statement:
theorem exposed_facet' (h : D.checkAll = true) {f : List ℕ} (hf : f ∈ D.facets) :
    D.Exposed f

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.affDim_edge'
statement:
lemma affDim_edge' (h : D.checkAll = true) {e : List ℕ} (he : e ∈ D.edges) :
    affDim (D.hull e) = 1

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.affDim_facet'
statement:
lemma affDim_facet' (h : D.checkAll = true) {f : List ℕ} (hf : f ∈ D.facets) :
    affDim (D.hull f) = 2

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.affDim_vertex
statement: lemma affDim_vertex (i : ℕ) : affDim (D.hull [i]) = 0

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.facesOfDim_eq
statement:
/-- The faces of each dimension. -/
theorem facesOfDim_eq (h : D.checkAll = true) :
    facesOfDim D.body 0 = {x | ∃ S ∈ (List.range D.n).map (fun i => [i]), x = D.hull S} ∧
    facesOfDim D.body 1 = {x | ∃ S ∈ D.edges, x = D.hull S} ∧
    facesOfDim D.body 2 = {x | ∃ S ∈ D.facets, x = D.hull S}

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.ncard_hulls
statement:
/-- Distinct exposed index sets give distinct faces, so a family of them has as many faces as
list entries. -/
theorem ncard_hulls (L : List (List ℕ)) (hexp : ∀ S ∈ L, D.Exposed S)
    (hpw : L.Pairwise fun a b => sameSet a b = false) :
    {x | ∃ S ∈ L, x = D.hull S}.ncard = L.length

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.setOf_filter
EulersGem.Explicit.Data.counts_and_type
statement:
/-- **Counts and face type.** -/
theorem counts_and_type (h : D.checkAll = true) {s m : ℕ} (ht : D.checkType s m = true) :
    (facesOfDim D.body 0).ncard = D.n ∧ (facesOfDim D.body 1).ncard = D.edges.length ∧
    (facesOfDim D.body 2).ncard = D.facets.length ∧
    (∀ f ∈ facesOfDim D.body 2, {e ∈ facesOfDim D.body 1 | e ⊆ f}.ncard = s) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ facesOfDim D.body 1, {f ∈ facesOfDim D.body 2 | e ⊆ f}.ncard = 2) ∧
    (∀ v ∈ facesOfDim D.body 0, {e ∈ facesOfDim D.body 1 | v ⊆ e}.ncard = m)

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.reflMap
statement:
/-- Reflection in the plane through the origin orthogonal to `w` (the identity if `w = 0`). -/
noncomputable def reflMap (w x : R3) : R3 := x - (2 * ⟪w, x⟫ / ⟪w, w⟫) • w

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.inner_reflMap
statement: lemma inner_reflMap (w x : R3) : ⟪w, reflMap w x⟫ = -⟪w, x⟫

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.reflMap_reflMap
statement: lemma reflMap_reflMap (w x : R3) : reflMap w (reflMap w x) = x

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.norm_reflMap
statement: lemma norm_reflMap (w x : R3) : ‖reflMap w x‖ = ‖x‖

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.refl
statement:
/-- The reflection as a linear isometry equivalence. -/
noncomputable def refl (w : R3) : R3 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] R3 where
  toFun := reflMap w
  invFun := reflMap w
  map_add' x y := by
    simp only [reflMap, inner_add_right, add_div, mul_add, add_smul]; abel
  map_smul' c x := by
    simp only [reflMap, inner_smul_right, RingHom.id_apply, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    congr 1; congr 1; ring
  left_inv x := reflMap_reflMap w x
  right_inv x := reflMap_reflMap w x
  norm_map' x := norm_reflMap w x

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.refl_apply
statement: lemma refl_apply (w x : R3) : refl w x = reflMap w x

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym
statement:
/-- Reflection generators (normals and the permutations of the points they induce), a base
flag `(vertex, edge index, facet index)`, and for each flag a word in the generators
carrying the base flag to it. -/
structure Sym where
  gens : List V
  perms : List (List ℕ)
  base : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ
  table : List ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × List ℕ)

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.gen
statement:
/-- The `t`-th normal. -/
def gen (t : ℕ) : V := G.gens.getD t 0

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.perm
statement:
/-- The `t`-th permutation. -/
def perm (t u : ℕ) : ℕ := (G.perms.getD t []).getD u 0

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.permWord
statement:
/-- The permutation of a word, rightmost letter first. -/
def permWord : List ℕ → ℕ → ℕ
  | [], u => u
  | t :: w, u => G.perm t (permWord w u)

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.genOk
statement:
/-- Generator `t` is a reflection permuting the points as `perm t`. -/
def genOk (D : Data) (t : ℕ) : Bool :=
  sgn (V.dot (G.gen t) (G.gen t)) == 1 &&
    (List.range D.n).all fun u => decide (G.perm t u < D.n) &&
      V.smul (V.dot (G.gen t) (G.gen t)) (D.pt (G.perm t u) - D.pt u) ==
        V.smul (ofInt (-2) * V.dot (G.gen t) (D.pt u)) (G.gen t)

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.checkFlags
statement:
/-- Every flag has a word. -/
def checkFlags (D : Data) : Bool :=
  decide (G.base.1 < D.n) && (List.range G.gens.length).all (G.genOk D) &&
  (List.range D.edges.length).all fun eI => (List.range D.facets.length).all fun fI =>
    !sub (D.edges.getD eI []) (D.facets.getD fI []) ||
      (D.edges.getD eI []).all fun i =>
        match G.table.lookup (i, eI, fI) with
        | none => false
        | some w => w.all (fun t => decide (t < G.gens.length)) &&
            G.permWord w G.base.1 == i &&
            sameSet ((D.edges.getD G.base.2.1 []).map (G.permWord w)) (D.edges.getD eI []) &&
            sameSet ((D.facets.getD G.base.2.2 []).map (G.permWord w)) (D.facets.getD fI [])

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.iso
statement:
/-- The isometry of a word. -/
noncomputable def iso : List ℕ → R3 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] R3
  | [] => LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ R3
  | t :: w => (iso w).trans (refl (G.gen t).toR3)

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.genOk_spec
statement:
lemma genOk_spec {t : ℕ} (h : G.genOk D t = true) {u : ℕ} (hu : u < D.n) :
    G.perm t u < D.n ∧ refl (G.gen t).toR3 (D.P u) = D.P (G.perm t u)

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.iso_spec
statement:
lemma iso_spec (hg : ∀ t < G.gens.length, G.genOk D t = true) :
    ∀ w : List ℕ, (∀ t ∈ w, t < G.gens.length) → ∀ u < D.n,
      G.permWord w u < D.n ∧ G.iso w (D.P u) = D.P (G.permWord w u)

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.image_hull
EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.image_verts
statement:
lemma image_verts (hg : ∀ t < G.gens.length, G.genOk D t = true) {w : List ℕ}
    (hw : ∀ t ∈ w, t < G.gens.length) : G.iso w '' D.verts = D.verts

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.image_body
statement:
lemma image_body (hg : ∀ t < G.gens.length, G.genOk D t = true) {w : List ℕ}
    (hw : ∀ t ∈ w, t < G.gens.length) : G.iso w '' D.body = D.body

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.getD_of_lt
statement:
lemma getD_of_lt {α : Type*} {l : List α} {k : ℕ} (hk : k < l.length) (d : α) :
    l.getD k d = l[k]

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.getD_of_ge
statement:
lemma getD_of_ge {α : Type*} {l : List α} {k : ℕ} (hk : l.length ≤ k) (d : α) :
    l.getD k d = d

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.lie_symm_image_image
statement: lemma lie_symm_image_image (g : R3 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] R3) (s : Set R3) : g.symm '' (g '' s) = s

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.getD_edges_lt
statement: lemma getD_edges_lt (h : D.checkAll = true) (k : ℕ) : ∀ u ∈ D.edges.getD k [], u < D.n

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.getD_facets_lt
statement: lemma getD_facets_lt (h : D.checkAll = true) (k : ℕ) : ∀ u ∈ D.facets.getD k [], u < D.n

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.baseV
statement:
/-- The base flag, as sets. -/
noncomputable def baseV (G : Sym) (D : Data) : Set R3 := D.hull [G.base.1]

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.baseE
statement: noncomputable def baseE (G : Sym) (D : Data) : Set R3 := D.hull (D.edges.getD G.base.2.1 [])

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.baseF
statement: noncomputable def baseF (G : Sym) (D : Data) : Set R3 := D.hull (D.facets.getD G.base.2.2 [])

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.exists_sym_of_flag
statement:
/-- Every flag is the image of the base flag under a symmetry. -/
theorem exists_sym_of_flag (h : D.checkAll = true) (hf : G.checkFlags D = true)
    {v e f : Set R3} (hfl : IsFlag D.body v e f) :
    ∃ g : R3 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] R3, g '' D.body = D.body ∧ g '' baseV G D = v ∧ g '' baseE G D = e ∧
      g '' baseF G D = f

name: EulersGem.Explicit.Data.Sym.isRegularPolyhedron
statement:
/-- **The body is a regular polyhedron.** -/
theorem isRegularPolyhedron (h : D.checkAll = true) (hf : G.checkFlags D = true) :
    IsRegularPolyhedron D.body

name: EulersGem.IsPolytope.exposed_of_isFaceOf
EulersGem.face_eq_convexHull_argmax
statement:
/-- **Faces of a V-polytope are hulls of maximisers.** Every nonempty face of
`convexHull ℝ V` (`V` finite) is `convexHull ℝ {v ∈ V | ⟪a, v⟫ = c}` for some `a`, `c` with
`⟪a, ·⟫ ≤ c` on `V`. -/
theorem face_eq_convexHull_argmax [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {V : Set E} (hV : V.Finite)
    {F : Set E} (hF : IsFaceOf (convexHull ℝ V) F) (hne : F.Nonempty) :
    ∃ a : E, ∃ c : ℝ, (∀ v ∈ V, ⟪a, v⟫ ≤ c) ∧
      F = convexHull ℝ {v ∈ V | ⟪a, v⟫ = c}

name: EulersGem.isFaceOf_coe_affineSubspace
statement:
/-- Faces of the carrier of an affine subspace are empty or the whole carrier.
Isabelle: `face_of_affine_trivial`. -/
lemma isFaceOf_coe_affineSubspace {T : AffineSubspace ℝ E} {F : Set E}
    (hF : IsFaceOf (T : Set E) F) (hne : F.Nonempty) : F = (T : Set E)

name: EulersGem.interior_closedHalfspace_zero
statement:
lemma interior_closedHalfspace_zero {a : E} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    interior (closedHalfspace a 0) = {x : E | ⟪a, x⟫ < 0}

name: EulersGem.affineSpan_closedHalfspace_zero
statement:
lemma affineSpan_closedHalfspace_zero [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {a : E} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    affineSpan ℝ (closedHalfspace a 0) = ⊤

name: EulersGem.affDim_closedHalfspace_zero
statement:
lemma affDim_closedHalfspace_zero [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {a : E} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    affDim (closedHalfspace a 0) = Module.finrank ℝ E

name: EulersGem.closedHalfspace_ne_hyperplane
statement:
lemma closedHalfspace_ne_hyperplane {a : E} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    closedHalfspace a 0 ≠ {x : E | ⟪a, x⟫ = 0}

name: EulersGem.affDim_openHalfspace_lt
statement:
lemma affDim_openHalfspace_lt [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {a : E} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    affDim {x : E | ⟪a, x⟫ < 0} = Module.finrank ℝ E

name: EulersGem.cells_subset_closedHalfspace_zero
statement:
/-- Arrangement cells contained in the closed halfspace (nontrivial case). -/
lemma cells_subset_closedHalfspace_zero {a : E} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    {C : Set E | IsHyperplaneCell {(a, (0 : ℝ))} C ∧ C ⊆ closedHalfspace a 0} =
      ({{x : E | ⟪a, x⟫ < 0}, {x : E | ⟪a, x⟫ = 0}} : Set (Set E))

name: EulersGem.isFaceOf_closedHalfspace_of_mem_open
statement:
/-- A face that meets the open halfspace equals the whole closed halfspace. -/
lemma isFaceOf_closedHalfspace_of_mem_open {a : E} (ha : a ≠ 0) {F : Set E}
    (hF : IsFaceOf (closedHalfspace a 0) F)
    (hmeet : (F ∩ {x : E | ⟪a, x⟫ < 0}).Nonempty) :
    F = closedHalfspace a 0

name: EulersGem.isFaceOf_closedHalfspace_zero_eq

name: EulersGem.faceCount
