name: EulersGem.Simplex.faceEulerSum_body_eq_one
statement:
/-- **Euler–Poincaré for a geometric simplex.** The alternating face-count sum is `1`,
obtained from `Euler_Poincare_full` applied to the H-representation of the simplex. -/
theorem faceEulerSum_body_eq_one (hn : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E) :
    faceEulerSum (body b) (Module.finrank ℝ E) = 1
variables: variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : AffineBasis ι ℝ E)

name: EulersGem.Simplex.facesOfDim_body
statement:
lemma facesOfDim_body (d : ℤ) :
    facesOfDim (body b) d = face b '' {S : Finset ι | (S.card : ℤ) = d + 1}
variables: variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : AffineBasis ι ℝ E)

name: EulersGem.Simplex.ncard_facesOfDim_body
statement:
lemma ncard_facesOfDim_body (d : ℤ) :
    (facesOfDim (body b) d).ncard = {S : Finset ι | (S.card : ℤ) = d + 1}.ncard
variables: variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : AffineBasis ι ℝ E)

name: EulersGem.Simplex.ncard_facesOfDim_subset
statement:
/-- Faces of dimension `d` contained in a given subsimplex correspond to vertex subsets of
the right size inside its index set. -/
lemma ncard_facesOfDim_subset (d : ℤ) (T : Finset ι) :
    {e ∈ facesOfDim (body b) d | e ⊆ face b T}.ncard =
      {S : Finset ι | (S.card : ℤ) = d + 1 ∧ S ⊆ T}.ncard
variables: variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : AffineBasis ι ℝ E)

name: EulersGem.Simplex.ncard_facesOfDim_superset
statement:
/-- Faces of dimension `d` containing a given subsimplex correspond to vertex subsets of
the right size containing its index set. -/
lemma ncard_facesOfDim_superset (d : ℤ) (T : Finset ι) :
    {e ∈ facesOfDim (body b) d | face b T ⊆ e}.ncard =
      {S : Finset ι | (S.card : ℤ) = d + 1 ∧ T ⊆ S}.ncard
variables: variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : AffineBasis ι ℝ E)

name: EulersGem.Simplex.ncard_setOf_finset
statement:
/-- Bridge from a set of `Finset`s to a `Finset` of `Finset`s, so counts can be decided. -/
lemma ncard_setOf_finset {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (p : Finset α → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] :
    {S : Finset α | p S}.ncard =
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (Finset α)).filter p).card

name: EulersGem.Simplex.affDim_body_tetra
statement:
/-- A geometric tetrahedron is a full-dimensional convex 3-polytope. -/
lemma affDim_body_tetra (hE : Module.finrank ℝ E = 3) : affDim (body b) = 3

name: EulersGem.Simplex.tetrahedron_face_counts
statement:
/-- **Face counts of a geometric tetrahedron: `V = 4`, `E = 6`, `F = 4`.**
These count *geometric* faces (`IsFaceOf` + `affDim`), obtained from the simplex face
lattice, not postulated. -/
theorem tetrahedron_face_counts :
    (facesOfDim (body b) 0).ncard = 4 ∧
      (facesOfDim (body b) 1).ncard = 6 ∧
      (facesOfDim (body b) 2).ncard = 4

name: EulersGem.Simplex.tetrahedron_euler_relation
statement:
/-- **Euler's relation for a geometric tetrahedron, discharged from Euler–Poincaré.**
`V − E + F = 2` is obtained from `euler_relation_convex_3polytope`, never assumed. -/
theorem tetrahedron_euler_relation (hE : Module.finrank ℝ E = 3) :
    ((facesOfDim (body b) 0).ncard : ℤ) - (facesOfDim (body b) 1).ncard
      + (facesOfDim (body b) 2).ncard = 2

name: EulersGem.Simplex.tetrahedron_euler_counts
statement:
/-- Sanity cross-check: the geometric face counts satisfy the Euler relation numerically,
i.e. `4 − 6 + 4 = 2`. Both sides are independently derived (counts from the face lattice,
the relation from EP). -/
theorem tetrahedron_euler_counts : (4 : ℤ) - 6 + 4 = 2

name: EulersGem.Simplex.tetrahedron_incidence
statement:
/-- **The four incidence counts of a geometric tetrahedron, proved from its face lattice.**
Every 2-face has `3` edges, every edge lies in `2` 2-faces, every vertex meets `3` edges,
every edge has `2` vertices. These are exactly the hypotheses of
`schlafli_pair_mem_of_regular_polytope`, so they are not vacuous. -/
theorem tetrahedron_incidence :
    (∀ f ∈ facesOfDim (body b) 2, {e ∈ facesOfDim (body b) 1 | e ⊆ f}.ncard = 3) ∧
      (∀ e ∈ facesOfDim (body b) 1, {f ∈ facesOfDim (body b) 2 | e ⊆ f}.ncard = 2) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ facesOfDim (body b) 0, {e ∈ facesOfDim (body b) 1 | v ⊆ e}.ncard = 3) ∧
      (∀ e ∈ facesOfDim (body b) 1, {v ∈ facesOfDim (body b) 0 | v ⊆ e}.ncard = 2)

name: EulersGem.Simplex.tetrahedron_platonic
statement:
/-- **A geometric tetrahedron is Platonic `{3,3}` on the Euler–Poincaré spine.**

For any tetrahedron (hull of four affinely independent points in a 3-dimensional inner
product space) the geometric face counts satisfy the two Platonic double-counting
identities with `(s, m) = (3, 3)`, satisfy Euler's relation, and `(3, 3)` is one of the
five classical Schläfli pairs.

Provenance of each conjunct:
* the double-counting identities come from `Platonic.regular_polytope_counts`, i.e. from
  face-lattice incidence via `ncard_mul_eq_ncard_mul`, using `tetrahedron_incidence`;
* Euler's relation comes from `euler_relation_convex_3polytope` = `Euler_Poincare_full`;
* the Schläfli membership comes from `schlafli_pair_mem_of_regular_polytope`.

Nothing in this chain assumes `V − E + F = 2`. -/
theorem tetrahedron_platonic (hE : Module.finrank ℝ E = 3) :
    3 * (facesOfDim (body b) 2).ncard = 2 * (facesOfDim (body b) 1).ncard ∧
      3 * (facesOfDim (body b) 0).ncard = 2 * (facesOfDim (body b) 1).ncard ∧
      ((facesOfDim (body b) 0).ncard : ℤ) - (facesOfDim (body b) 1).ncard
        + (facesOfDim (body b) 2).ncard = 2 ∧
      ((3 : ℕ), (3 : ℕ)) ∈ schlafliPairs

name: EulersGem.Simplex.ncard_setOf_card_eq
statement:
/-- The `(d+1)`-element subsets of the vertex index set are counted by a binomial
coefficient. -/
lemma ncard_setOf_card_eq (k : ℕ) :
    {S : Finset ι | S.card = k}.ncard = (Fintype.card ι).choose k
variables: variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : AffineBasis ι ℝ E)

name: EulersGem.Simplex.ncard_facesOfDim_body_eq_choose
statement:
/-- **The number of `d`-faces of a geometric simplex is `C(n+1, d+1)`.**
`Fintype.card ι = n + 1` vertices, so the geometric face counts of the simplex match the
combinatorial face counts of the abstract `n`-simplex. -/
theorem ncard_facesOfDim_body_eq_choose (d : ℕ) :
    (facesOfDim (body b) (d : ℤ)).ncard = (Fintype.card ι).choose (d + 1)
variables: variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : AffineBasis ι ℝ E)

name: EulersGem.Simplex.geometric_simplex_euler_poincare
statement:
/-- **Euler–Poincaré for a geometric simplex, in binomial form.** For a geometric
`n`-simplex the alternating sum of its *geometric* face counts is `1`, and each count is the
binomial coefficient of the abstract `n`-simplex. -/
theorem geometric_simplex_euler_poincare {n : ℕ} (b : AffineBasis (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ E) :
    (∀ d : ℕ, (facesOfDim (body b) (d : ℤ)).ncard = (n + 1).choose (d + 1)) ∧
      ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ d * ((facesOfDim (body b) (d : ℤ)).ncard : ℤ) = 1
variables: variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : AffineBasis ι ℝ E)

name: EulersGem.Simplex.exists_tetrahedron
statement:
/-- Every 3-dimensional real inner product space contains a geometric tetrahedron, so the
statements above are about a nonempty class of solids. -/
theorem exists_tetrahedron {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (hE : Module.finrank ℝ E = 3) :
    Nonempty (AffineBasis (Fin 4) ℝ E)

name: EulersGem.Hyperplane
statement:
/-- An affine hyperplane given in H-description by `⟪a, x⟫ = b`.
Degenerate when `a = 0` (matches Paulson: the whole space or empty, via `sgn`). -/
abbrev Hyperplane (E : Type*) := E × ℝ

name: EulersGem.hyperplaneSide
statement:
/-- Which side of the hyperplane `(a, b)` the point `x` lies on:
`sign (⟪a, x⟫ − b) ∈ {−1, 0, 1}`. Isabelle: `hyperplane_side`. -/
noncomputable def hyperplaneSide (h : Hyperplane E) (x : E) : SignType :=
  SignType.sign (⟪h.1, x⟫ - h.2)

name: EulersGem.HyperplaneEquiv
statement:
/-- Points equivalent under arrangement `A`: same side of every hyperplane in `A`.
Isabelle: `hyperplane_equiv`. -/
def HyperplaneEquiv (A : Set (Hyperplane E)) (x y : E) : Prop :=
  ∀ h ∈ A, hyperplaneSide h x = hyperplaneSide h y

name: EulersGem.hyperplaneEquiv_refl
statement:
lemma hyperplaneEquiv_refl (A : Set (Hyperplane E)) (x : E) :
    HyperplaneEquiv A x x

name: EulersGem.hyperplaneEquiv_symm
statement:
lemma hyperplaneEquiv_symm {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {x y : E}
    (h : HyperplaneEquiv A x y) : HyperplaneEquiv A y x

name: EulersGem.hyperplaneEquiv_trans
EulersGem.hyperplaneEquiv_union
statement:
lemma hyperplaneEquiv_union (A B : Set (Hyperplane E)) (x y : E) :
    HyperplaneEquiv (A ∪ B) x y ↔ HyperplaneEquiv A x y ∧ HyperplaneEquiv B x y

name: EulersGem.IsHyperplaneCell
EulersGem.isHyperplaneCell_iff
statement:
lemma isHyperplaneCell_iff (A : Set (Hyperplane E)) (C : Set E) :
    IsHyperplaneCell A C ↔ ∃ x, C = {y | HyperplaneEquiv A x y}

name: EulersGem.not_isHyperplaneCell_empty
statement:
lemma not_isHyperplaneCell_empty (A : Set (Hyperplane E)) :
    ¬ IsHyperplaneCell A (∅ : Set E)

name: EulersGem.nonempty_isHyperplaneCell
statement:
lemma nonempty_isHyperplaneCell {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {C : Set E}
    (h : IsHyperplaneCell A C) : C.Nonempty

name: EulersGem.iUnion_isHyperplaneCell
statement:
lemma iUnion_isHyperplaneCell (A : Set (Hyperplane E)) :
    ⋃₀ {C | IsHyperplaneCell A C} = univ

name: EulersGem.disjoint_isHyperplaneCell
EulersGem.isHyperplaneCell_empty_arrangement
statement:
lemma isHyperplaneCell_empty_arrangement (C : Set E) :
    IsHyperplaneCell (∅ : Set (Hyperplane E)) C ↔ C = univ

name: EulersGem.isLinearMap_inner
statement:
/-- Linear map `x ↦ ⟪a, x⟫`. -/
lemma isLinearMap_inner (a : E) : IsLinearMap ℝ (fun x : E => ⟪a, x⟫) where
  map_add

name: EulersGem.hyperplaneSide_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma hyperplaneSide_eq_zero_iff (a : E) (b : ℝ) (x : E) :
    hyperplaneSide (a, b) x = 0 ↔ ⟪a, x⟫ = b

name: EulersGem.hyperplaneSide_eq_one_iff
statement:
lemma hyperplaneSide_eq_one_iff (a : E) (b : ℝ) (x : E) :
    hyperplaneSide (a, b) x = 1 ↔ b < ⟪a, x⟫

name: EulersGem.hyperplaneSide_eq_neg_one_iff
statement:
lemma hyperplaneSide_eq_neg_one_iff (a : E) (b : ℝ) (x : E) :
    hyperplaneSide (a, b) x = -1 ↔ ⟪a, x⟫ < b

name: EulersGem.convex_hyperplaneSide_eq
statement:
/-- Fixed hyperplane `(a,b)`: the set of points with a given side is a hyperplane
or an open half-space (hence convex). -/
lemma convex_hyperplaneSide_eq (a : E) (b : ℝ) (s : SignType) :
    Convex ℝ {y : E | hyperplaneSide (a, b) y = s}

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCell_singleton_cases
EulersGem.isHyperplaneCell_convex
EulersGem.IsHyperplaneCellComplex
statement:
/-- Cell complex: a union of cells of arrangement `A`.
Isabelle: `hyperplane_cellcomplex`. -/
def IsHyperplaneCellComplex (A : Set (Hyperplane E)) (S : Set E) : Prop :=
  ∃ 𝒯 : Set (Set E), (∀ C ∈ 𝒯, IsHyperplaneCell A C) ∧ S = ⋃₀ 𝒯

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCellComplex_empty
statement:
lemma isHyperplaneCellComplex_empty (A : Set (Hyperplane E)) :
    IsHyperplaneCellComplex A (∅ : Set E)

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCell_cellComplex
statement:
lemma isHyperplaneCell_cellComplex {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {C : Set E}
    (h : IsHyperplaneCell A C) : IsHyperplaneCellComplex A C

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCellComplex_univ
statement:
lemma isHyperplaneCellComplex_univ (A : Set (Hyperplane E)) :
    IsHyperplaneCellComplex A (univ : Set E)

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCellComplex_sUnion
EulersGem.isHyperplaneCellComplex_union
EulersGem.isHyperplaneCell_union
statement:
/-- Cells of a union arrangement are nonempty intersections of an `A`-cell and a `B`-cell.
Isabelle: `hyperplane_cell_Un`. -/
lemma isHyperplaneCell_union (A B : Set (Hyperplane E)) (C : Set E) :
    IsHyperplaneCell (A ∪ B) C ↔
      C.Nonempty ∧
        ∃ C1 C2, IsHyperplaneCell A C1 ∧ IsHyperplaneCell B C2 ∧ C = C1 ∩ C2

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCell_singleton_subset
EulersGem.finite_isHyperplaneCell_singleton
statement:
lemma finite_isHyperplaneCell_singleton (h : Hyperplane E) :
    {C : Set E | IsHyperplaneCell {h} C}.Finite

name: EulersGem.finite_isHyperplaneCell
statement:
/-- A finite arrangement has finitely many cells. Isabelle: `finite_hyperplane_cells`. -/
lemma finite_isHyperplaneCell {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} (hA : A.Finite) :
    {C : Set E | IsHyperplaneCell A C}.Finite

name: EulersGem.finite_isHyperplaneCell_restrict
statement:
lemma finite_isHyperplaneCell_restrict {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} (hA : A.Finite)
    (P : Set E → Prop) :
    {C : Set E | IsHyperplaneCell A C ∧ P C}.Finite

name: EulersGem.pairwise_disjoint_isHyperplaneCell
EulersGem.isHyperplaneCell_inter
statement:
/-- Intersection of two cells of the same arrangement is a cell when nonempty. -/
lemma isHyperplaneCell_inter {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {S T : Set E}
    (hS : IsHyperplaneCell A S) (hT : IsHyperplaneCell A T) (hne : (S ∩ T).Nonempty) :
    IsHyperplaneCell A (S ∩ T)

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCellComplex_inter
statement:
/-- Cell complexes are closed under binary intersection. -/
lemma isHyperplaneCellComplex_inter {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {S T : Set E}
    (hS : IsHyperplaneCellComplex A S) (hT : IsHyperplaneCellComplex A T) :
    IsHyperplaneCellComplex A (S ∩ T)

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCell_cellComplex_of_subset
statement:
/-- An `A`-cell is a `B`-cell-complex whenever `A ⊆ B`. -/
lemma isHyperplaneCell_cellComplex_of_subset {A B : Set (Hyperplane E)} {C : Set E}
    (hC : IsHyperplaneCell A C) (hAB : A ⊆ B) :
    IsHyperplaneCellComplex B C

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCellComplex_mono
statement:
/-- Cell complexes are monotonic in the arrangement. -/
lemma isHyperplaneCellComplex_mono {A B : Set (Hyperplane E)} {S : Set E}
    (hS : IsHyperplaneCellComplex A S) (hAB : A ⊆ B) :
    IsHyperplaneCellComplex B S

name: EulersGem.cell_subset_cellcomplex
statement:
/-- A cell meets a cell complex iff it is contained in it. -/
lemma cell_subset_cellcomplex {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {C S : Set E}
    (hC : IsHyperplaneCell A C) (hS : IsHyperplaneCellComplex A S) :
    C ⊆ S ↔ (C ∩ S).Nonempty

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCellComplex_compl_cell
statement:
/-- Complement of a single cell is a cell complex. -/
lemma isHyperplaneCellComplex_compl_cell {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {C : Set E}
    (hC : IsHyperplaneCell A C) :
    IsHyperplaneCellComplex A (Cᶜ : Set E)

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCellComplex_compl
statement:
/-- Complement of a cell complex is a cell complex.
Isabelle: `hyperplane_cellcomplex_Compl`. -/
lemma isHyperplaneCellComplex_compl {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {S : Set E}
    (hS : IsHyperplaneCellComplex A S) :
    IsHyperplaneCellComplex A (Sᶜ : Set E)

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCellComplex_diff
statement:
/-- Difference of cell complexes is a cell complex.
Isabelle: `hyperplane_cellcomplex_diff`. -/
lemma isHyperplaneCellComplex_diff {A : Set (Hyperplane E)} {S T : Set E}
    (hS : IsHyperplaneCellComplex A S) (hT : IsHyperplaneCellComplex A T) :
    IsHyperplaneCellComplex A (S \ T)

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCellComplex_finset_inf
statement:
/-- Finite intersection of cell complexes (by induction on a finset). -/
lemma isHyperplaneCellComplex_finset_inf {A : Set (Hyperplane E)}
    (Ss : Finset (Set E))
    (h : ∀ S ∈ Ss, IsHyperplaneCellComplex A S) :
    IsHyperplaneCellComplex A (Ss.inf id)

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCellComplex_finset_sup
statement:
/-- Finite union of cell complexes (by induction on a finset). -/
lemma isHyperplaneCellComplex_finset_sup {A : Set (Hyperplane E)}
    (Ss : Finset (Set E))
    (h : ∀ S ∈ Ss, IsHyperplaneCellComplex A S) :
    IsHyperplaneCellComplex A (Ss.sup id)

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCellComplex_biUnion_finset
statement:
/-- Indexed finite union of cell complexes. -/
lemma isHyperplaneCellComplex_biUnion_finset {ι : Type*} {A : Set (Hyperplane E)}
    (s : Finset ι) (S : ι → Set E)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, IsHyperplaneCellComplex A (S i)) :
    IsHyperplaneCellComplex A (⋃ i ∈ s, S i)

name: EulersGem.isHyperplaneCellComplex_biInter_finset
statement:
/-- Indexed finite intersection of cell complexes. -/
lemma isHyperplaneCellComplex_biInter_finset {ι : Type*} {A : Set (Hyperplane E)}
    (s : Finset ι) (S : ι → Set E)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, IsHyperplaneCellComplex A (S i)) :
    IsHyperplaneCellComplex A (⋂ i ∈ s, S i)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.V
statement: abbrev V := ℝ × ℝ

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.parallelepiped_finTwoProd
statement:
lemma parallelepiped_finTwoProd :
    (↑(Basis.finTwoProd ℝ).parallelepiped : Set V) =
      Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.finTwoProd_addHaar_eq_volume
statement:
lemma finTwoProd_addHaar_eq_volume :
    (Basis.finTwoProd ℝ).addHaar = (volume : Measure V)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.finTwoProd_det
statement:
lemma finTwoProd_det (u v : V) :
    (Basis.finTwoProd ℝ).det ![u, v] = u.1 * v.2 - u.2 * v.1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.volume_parallelepiped_eq_ofReal_abs_det
statement:
theorem volume_parallelepiped_eq_ofReal_abs_det (u v : V) :
    volume (parallelepiped ![u, v]) = ENNReal.ofReal |u.1 * v.2 - u.2 * v.1|

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.unitTriangleCoords
statement:
def unitTriangleCoords : Set V :=
  {p | 0 ≤ p.1 ∧ 0 ≤ p.2 ∧ p.1 + p.2 ≤ 1}

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.measurableSet_unitTriangleCoords
statement: lemma measurableSet_unitTriangleCoords : MeasurableSet unitTriangleCoords

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.volume_fiber_unitTriangleCoords
statement:
lemma volume_fiber_unitTriangleCoords (x : ℝ) :
    volume (Prod.mk x ⁻¹' unitTriangleCoords) =
      if 0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 1 then ENNReal.ofReal (1 - x) else 0

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.volume_unitTriangleCoords
statement:
theorem volume_unitTriangleCoords :
    volume unitTriangleCoords = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.unitTriangle
statement:
def unitTriangle : Set V :=
  convexHull ℝ ({(0 : V), (1, 0), (0, 1)} : Set V)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.mem_unitTriangle_iff
statement:
lemma mem_unitTriangle_iff (p : V) :
    p ∈ unitTriangle ↔ 0 ≤ p.1 ∧ 0 ≤ p.2 ∧ p.1 + p.2 ≤ 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.unitTriangle_eq_coords
statement: lemma unitTriangle_eq_coords : unitTriangle = unitTriangleCoords

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.volume_unitTriangle
statement:
theorem volume_unitTriangle :
    volume unitTriangle = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.basisMap
statement:
def basisMap (u v : V) : V →ₗ[ℝ] V :=
  (Basis.finTwoProd ℝ).constr ℕ ![u, v]

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.det_basisMap_eq_finTwoProd_det
statement:
lemma det_basisMap_eq_finTwoProd_det (u v : V) :
    LinearMap.det (basisMap u v) = (Basis.finTwoProd ℝ).det ![u, v]

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.image_basisMap_unitPts
statement:
lemma image_basisMap_unitPts (u v : V) :
    basisMap u v '' ({(0 : V), (1, 0), (0, 1)} : Set V) =
      ({(0 : V), u, v} : Set V)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.image_basisMap_unitTriangle
statement:
lemma image_basisMap_unitTriangle (u v : V) :
    basisMap u v '' unitTriangle =
      convexHull ℝ ({(0 : V), u, v} : Set V)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.volume_convexHull_origin_triangle
statement:
/-- Origin-triangle Haar volume equals `|det(u,v)|/2`. -/
theorem volume_convexHull_origin_triangle (u v : V) :
    volume (convexHull ℝ ({(0 : V), u, v} : Set V)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (|u.1 * v.2 - u.2 * v.1| / 2)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.toReal_sub
statement: lemma toReal_sub (p q : ℤ × ℤ) : toReal (p - q) = toReal p - toReal q

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.latticeDet_coe_eq_real_cross
statement:
lemma latticeDet_coe_eq_real_cross (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (latticeDet a b c : ℝ) =
      (toReal (b - a)).1 * (toReal (c - a)).2 -
        (toReal (b - a)).2 * (toReal (c - a)).1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.triangleShoelace_coe_eq_abs_det_div_two
statement:
/-- Combinatorial shoelace `ℚ` coerces to `|latticeDet|/2` as `ℝ`. -/
theorem triangleShoelace_coe_eq_abs_det_div_two (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (triangleShoelace a b c : ℝ) = |(latticeDet a b c : ℝ)| / 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.triangleShoelace_nonneg
statement:
lemma triangleShoelace_nonneg (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    0 ≤ (triangleShoelace a b c : ℝ)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.ofReal_triangleShoelace_eq_ofReal_abs_det_div_two
statement:
lemma ofReal_triangleShoelace_eq_ofReal_abs_det_div_two (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (triangleShoelace a b c) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (|(latticeDet a b c : ℝ)| / 2)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.vadd_neg_triangle_pts
statement:
lemma vadd_neg_triangle_pts (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (-toReal a) +ᵥ ({toReal a, toReal b, toReal c} : Set V) =
      ({(0 : V), toReal (b - a), toReal (c - a)} : Set V)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.convexHull_triangle_translate
statement:
lemma convexHull_triangle_translate (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (-toReal a) +ᵥ convexHull ℝ ({toReal a, toReal b, toReal c} : Set V) =
      convexHull ℝ ({(0 : V), toReal (b - a), toReal (c - a)} : Set V)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.volume_vadd
statement:
/-- Translation invariance of Lebesgue measure on `ℝ × ℝ`. -/
lemma volume_vadd (x : V) (s : Set V) :
    volume (x +ᵥ s) = volume s

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.volume_convexHull_lattice_triangle
statement:
/-- Arbitrary lattice triangle Haar volume equals combinatorial shoelace. -/
theorem volume_convexHull_lattice_triangle (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    volume (convexHull ℝ ({toReal a, toReal b, toReal c} : Set V)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (triangleShoelace a b c)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.shoelace_trianglePolygon_eq_triangleShoelace
statement:
lemma shoelace_trianglePolygon_eq_triangleShoelace (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (trianglePolygon a b c).shoelace = triangleShoelace a b c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.volume_convexHull_trianglePolygon
statement:
/-- `trianglePolygon` convex hull has Haar volume equal to its combinatorial shoelace. -/
theorem volume_convexHull_trianglePolygon (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    volume (trianglePolygon a b c).convexHullRegion =
      ENNReal.ofReal (trianglePolygon a b c).shoelace

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.shoelace_coe_eq_abs_shoelaceSum_div_two
statement:
theorem shoelace_coe_eq_abs_shoelaceSum_div_two (P : LatticePolygon) :
    (P.shoelace : ℝ) = |(P.shoelaceSum : ℝ)| / 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.volume_fanTriangle
statement:
lemma volume_fanTriangle (P : LatticePolygon) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < P.nVertices - 2) :
    volume (convexHull ℝ
        ({toReal (fanTriangle P i hi).a,
          toReal (fanTriangle P i hi).b,
          toReal (fanTriangle P i hi).c} : Set V)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (fanTriangle P i hi).shoelace

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.sum_volume_fanTriangles_eq_ofReal_shoelace
statement:
/-- Under nonneg fan dets, summed fan-ear Haar volumes equal `ofReal(P.shoelace)`.

Does **not** yet identify `volume(P.convexHullRegion)` with this sum — hull-union
almost-disjointness remains open. -/
theorem sum_volume_fanTriangles_eq_ofReal_shoelace
    (P : LatticePolygon) (hnn : FanDetsNonneg P)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex) :
    (∑ t ∈ fanTriangles P,
        volume (convexHull ℝ ({toReal t.a, toReal t.b, toReal t.c} : Set V))) =
      ENNReal.ofReal P.shoelace

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.volume_eq_ofReal_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_shoelace
statement:
/-- Conditional compose: if polygon Haar equals shoelace, combinatorial Pick-form
lifts to a volume identity. Not classical Pick (hyp `hvol` / EP open). -/
theorem volume_eq_ofReal_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_shoelace
    (P : LatticePolygon) (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hvol : volume P.convexHullRegion = ENNReal.ofReal P.shoelace)
    (hcomb : P.shoelace = (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1) :
    volume P.convexHullRegion =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.fanTriangleRegion
statement:
/-- Euclidean region of fan ear `i`. -/
def fanTriangleRegion (P : LatticePolygon) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < P.nVertices - 2) : Set V :=
  convexHull ℝ
    ({toReal (fanTriangle P i hi).a,
      toReal (fanTriangle P i hi).b,
      toReal (fanTriangle P i hi).c} : Set V)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.fanTriangleRegion_eq_convexHull_trianglePolygon
statement:
lemma fanTriangleRegion_eq_convexHull_trianglePolygon
    (P : LatticePolygon) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < P.nVertices - 2) :
    fanTriangleRegion P i hi =
      (trianglePolygon (fanTriangle P i hi).a (fanTriangle P i hi).b
        (fanTriangle P i hi).c).convexHullRegion

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.fanTriangleRegion_subset_convexHullRegion
statement:
/-- Each fan-ear region sits inside the polygon convex hull. -/
theorem fanTriangleRegion_subset_convexHullRegion
    (P : LatticePolygon) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < P.nVertices - 2) :
    fanTriangleRegion P i hi ⊆ P.convexHullRegion

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.detR_area_sum
statement:
lemma detR_area_sum (a b c p : V) :
    detR a b c = detR b c p + detR a p c + detR a b p

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.detR_swap_right'
statement: lemma detR_swap_right' (a b c : V) : detR a b c = -detR a c b

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.detR_cycle
statement: lemma detR_cycle (a b c : V) : detR a b c = detR b c a

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.detR_swap_first
statement: lemma detR_swap_first (a b c : V) : detR a b c = -detR b a c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.detR_barycentric_x
statement:
lemma detR_barycentric_x (a b c p : V) :
    detR a b c * p.1 =
      detR b c p * a.1 + detR a p c * b.1 + detR a b p * c.1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.detR_barycentric_y
statement:
lemma detR_barycentric_y (a b c p : V) :
    detR a b c * p.2 =
      detR b c p * a.2 + detR a p c * b.2 + detR a b p * c.2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.mem_convexHull_of_detR_nonneg
statement:
/-- Oriented areas nonneg ⇒ point lies in the Euclidean triangle. -/
theorem mem_convexHull_of_detR_nonneg (a b c p : V)
    (hD : 0 < detR a b c)
    (hα : 0 ≤ detR b c p)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ detR a p c)
    (hγ : 0 ≤ detR a b p) :
    p ∈ convexHull ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set V)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.detR_edge_nonneg_of_ConvexCCW_of_mem_hull
statement:
/-- Hull points lie weakly left of every directed edge (real form). -/
theorem detR_edge_nonneg_of_ConvexCCW_of_mem_hull
    (P : LatticePolygon) (h : ConvexCCW P) {p : V}
    (hp : p ∈ P.convexHullRegion) (i : Fin P.nVertices) :
    0 ≤ detR (toReal (P.vertex i)) (toReal (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))) p

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.mem_segment_of_detR_eq_zero_of_mem_hull
statement:
/-- Collinear hull point on a polygon edge lies on that edge segment. -/
theorem mem_segment_of_detR_eq_zero_of_mem_hull
    (P : LatticePolygon) (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P)
    (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex) {p : V}
    (hp : p ∈ P.convexHullRegion) (i : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hdet : detR (toReal (P.vertex i)) (toReal (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))) p = 0) :
    p ∈ segment ℝ (toReal (P.vertex i)) (toReal (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.exists_mem_fanTriangleRegion_of_mem_hull
statement:
/-- Every hull point lies in some apex-`v₀` fan-ear region. -/
theorem exists_mem_fanTriangleRegion_of_mem_hull
    (P : LatticePolygon) (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P)
    (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex) {p : V}
    (hp : p ∈ P.convexHullRegion) :
    ∃ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < P.nVertices - 2), p ∈ fanTriangleRegion P i hi

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.convexHullRegion_eq_iUnion_fanTriangleRegion
statement:
/-- Under `StrictlyConvexCCW` + injective vertices, the polygon hull equals the
union of apex-`v₀` fan-ear regions. -/
theorem convexHullRegion_eq_iUnion_fanTriangleRegion
    (P : LatticePolygon) (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P)
    (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex) :
    P.convexHullRegion =
      ⋃ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < P.nVertices - 2), fanTriangleRegion P i hi

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.detR_plucker
statement:
lemma detR_plucker (q a b c r : V) :
    detR q a b * detR q c r - detR q a c * detR q b r + detR q a r * detR q b c = 0

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.detR_linear_of_affine_combo
statement:
lemma detR_linear_of_affine_combo {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (u v : V) (w : ι → ℝ) (z : ι → V) (hw1 : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (p : V) (hp : p = ∑ i, w i • z i) :
    detR u v p = ∑ i, w i * detR u v (z i)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.detR_nonneg_of_mem_convexHull_of_pos
statement:
/-- Oriented-area weights are nonnegative on a positively oriented Euclidean triangle. -/
theorem detR_nonneg_of_mem_convexHull_of_pos (a b c p : V)
    (hD : 0 < detR a b c) (hp : p ∈ convexHull ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set V)) :
    0 ≤ detR b c p ∧ 0 ≤ detR a p c ∧ 0 ≤ detR a b p

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.volume_segment_eq_zero
statement:
/-- Segments are Haar-null in `ℝ × ℝ`. -/
theorem volume_segment_eq_zero (a b : V) :
    volume (segment ℝ a b) = 0

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.volume_singleton_eq_zero
statement: theorem volume_singleton_eq_zero (a : V) : volume ({a} : Set V) = 0

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.fan_chord_detR_pos
statement:
/-- Fan chord from apex `v₀` through listed vertices is positively oriented. -/
theorem fan_chord_detR_pos
    (P : LatticePolygon) (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P)
    (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (r s : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hr : 1 ≤ r.val) (hrs : r.val < s.val) :
    0 < detR (toReal (P.vertex ⟨0, P.nVertices_pos⟩))
      (toReal (P.vertex r)) (toReal (P.vertex s))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.mem_segment_of_mem_convexHull_of_detR_AC_eq_zero
statement:
/-- Point of a CCW triangle on the AC line lies on segment AC. -/
lemma mem_segment_of_mem_convexHull_of_detR_AC_eq_zero
    (a b c p : V) (hD : 0 < detR a b c)
    (hp : p ∈ convexHull ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set V))
    (hAC : detR a c p = 0) :
    p ∈ segment ℝ a c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.inter_fanTriangleRegion_adjacent_subset_spoke
statement:
/-- Adjacent fan ears meet only on the shared spoke from the apex. -/
theorem inter_fanTriangleRegion_adjacent_subset_spoke
    (P : LatticePolygon) (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P)
    (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 < P.nVertices - 2) :
    fanTriangleRegion P i (by omega) ∩ fanTriangleRegion P (i + 1) hi ⊆
      segment ℝ (toReal (P.vertex ⟨0, P.nVertices_pos⟩))
        (toReal (P.vertex ⟨i + 2, by omega⟩))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.inter_fanTriangleRegion_nonadjacent_subset_apex
statement:
/-- Non-adjacent fan ears meet only at the apex. -/
theorem inter_fanTriangleRegion_nonadjacent_subset_apex
    (P : LatticePolygon) (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P)
    (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < P.nVertices - 2) (hj : j < P.nVertices - 2)
    (hij : i + 1 < j) :
    fanTriangleRegion P i hi ∩ fanTriangleRegion P j hj ⊆
      ({toReal (P.vertex ⟨0, P.nVertices_pos⟩)} : Set V)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.pairwise_AEDisjoint_fanTriangleRegion
statement:
/-- Pairwise AEDisjoint of apex-`v₀` fan-ear regions under `StrictlyConvexCCW`. -/
theorem pairwise_AEDisjoint_fanTriangleRegion
    (P : LatticePolygon) (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P)
    (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex) :
    Pairwise fun (i j : Fin (P.nVertices - 2)) =>
      volume (fanTriangleRegion P i.val i.isLt ∩
        fanTriangleRegion P j.val j.isLt) = 0

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.volume_convexHullRegion_eq_sum_volume_fanTriangleRegion
statement:
/-- Polygon hull Haar equals the sum of fan-ear volumes. -/
theorem volume_convexHullRegion_eq_sum_volume_fanTriangleRegion
    (P : LatticePolygon) (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P)
    (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex) :
    volume P.convexHullRegion =
      ∑ i : Fin (P.nVertices - 2),
        volume (fanTriangleRegion P i.val i.isLt)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.volume_convexHullRegion_eq_ofReal_shoelace
statement:
/-- Under `StrictlyConvexCCW` + injective vertices, polygon Haar equals
`ofReal(P.shoelace)`. Discharges the `hvol` hyp of the conditional compose. -/
theorem volume_convexHullRegion_eq_ofReal_shoelace
    (P : LatticePolygon) (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P)
    (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex) :
    volume P.convexHullRegion = ENNReal.ofReal P.shoelace

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.volume_eq_ofReal_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one
statement:
/-- Geometric volume Pick-form: Haar = `ofReal(#I + B/2 − 1)` under
`StrictlyConvexCCW` + injective + `PrimitiveEdges` + combinatorial interior Finset.
Not classical Pick (EP→planar / triangulation existence still open). -/
theorem volume_eq_ofReal_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one
    (P : LatticePolygon) (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) :
    volume P.convexHullRegion =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeArea.volume_eq_ofReal_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_no_pe
statement:
/-- Geometric volume Pick-form without `PrimitiveEdges`: Haar =
`ofReal(#I + B/2 − 1)` under `StrictlyConvexCCW` + injective + combinatorial
interior Finset. Composes PE-free Haar(=shoelace) with PE-free combinatorial
Pick-form. Not classical Pick (finiteness / simple nonconvex still open). -/
theorem volume_eq_ofReal_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_no_pe
    (P : LatticePolygon) (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) :
    volume P.convexHullRegion =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.cross
statement: def cross (p q : ℤ × ℤ) : ℤ := p.1 * q.2 - p.2 * q.1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.latticeDet_eq_cross_cycle
statement:
lemma latticeDet_eq_cross_cycle (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    latticeDet a b c = cross a b + cross b c + cross c a

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.cross_anticomm
statement: lemma cross_anticomm (p q : ℤ × ℤ) : cross p q = -cross q p

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.cross_self
statement: lemma cross_self (p : ℤ × ℤ) : cross p p = 0

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.latDet
statement:
/-- Oriented fan-triangle content as a cross-cycle (equals `latticeDet`). -/
def latDet (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) : ℤ := cross a b + cross b c + cross c a

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.latDet_eq_latticeDet
statement: lemma latDet_eq_latticeDet (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) : latDet a b c = latticeDet a b c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.fan_shoelace_identity
statement:
/-- **Abstract algebraic fan identity** (Nat-indexed vertices). -/
theorem fan_shoelace_identity (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (v : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, cross (v i) (v ((i + 1) % n)) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 2), latDet (v 0) (v (i + 1)) (v (i + 2))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.detR_toReal
statement:
lemma detR_toReal (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    detR (toReal a) (toReal b) (toReal c) = (latticeDet a b c : ℝ)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.exists_smul_of_cross_eq_zero
statement:
lemma exists_smul_of_cross_eq_zero (u w : ℝ × ℝ) (hu : u ≠ 0)
    (h : u.1 * w.2 - u.2 * w.1 = 0) : ∃ t : ℝ, w = t • u

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.detR_sum_smul
statement:
lemma detR_sum_smul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (a b : ℝ × ℝ) (w : ι → ℝ) (z : ι → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hw1 : ∑ i, w i = 1) :
    detR a b (∑ i, w i • z i) = ∑ i, w i * detR a b (z i)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.vertNat
statement:
def vertNat (k : ℕ) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  if h : k < P.nVertices then P.vertex ⟨k, h⟩ else (0, 0)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.fanTriangle
statement:
def fanTriangle (i : ℕ) (hi : i < P.nVertices - 2) : Triangle :=
  ⟨P.vertex ⟨0, P.nVertices_pos⟩,
    P.vertex ⟨i + 1, by have := P.length_ge; omega⟩,
    P.vertex ⟨i + 2, by have := P.length_ge; omega⟩⟩

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.fanDet
statement:
def fanDet (i : ℕ) (hi : i < P.nVertices - 2) : ℤ :=
  (fanTriangle P i hi).det

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.fanDetNat
statement:
def fanDetNat (i : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  if h : i < P.nVertices - 2 then fanDet P i h else 0

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.sumFanDet
statement:
def sumFanDet : ℤ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (P.nVertices - 2), fanDetNat P i

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.fanTriangles
statement:
def fanTriangles : Finset Triangle := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.range (P.nVertices - 2)).attach.image fun i =>
    fanTriangle P i.1 (Finset.mem_range.mp i.2)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.mem_fanTriangles
statement:
lemma mem_fanTriangles {t : Triangle} :
    t ∈ fanTriangles P ↔
      ∃ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < P.nVertices - 2), t = fanTriangle P i hi

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.fanTriangle_eq_of_eq
statement:
lemma fanTriangle_eq_of_eq {i j : ℕ}
    (hi : i < P.nVertices - 2) (hj : j < P.nVertices - 2)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (h : fanTriangle P i hi = fanTriangle P j hj) : i = j

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.card_fanTriangles
statement:
lemma card_fanTriangles (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex) :
    (fanTriangles P).card = P.nVertices - 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.shoelaceSum_eq_sum_cross
statement:
lemma shoelaceSum_eq_sum_cross :
    P.shoelaceSum =
      ∑ i : Fin P.nVertices, cross (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.shoelaceSum_as_nat_sum
statement:
lemma shoelaceSum_as_nat_sum :
    P.shoelaceSum =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range P.nVertices,
        cross (vertNat P i) (vertNat P ((i + 1) % P.nVertices))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.fanDetNat_eq_latDet
statement:
lemma fanDetNat_eq_latDet (i : ℕ) (hi : i ∈ Finset.range (P.nVertices - 2)) :
    fanDetNat P i =
      latDet (vertNat P 0) (vertNat P (i + 1)) (vertNat P (i + 2))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.shoelaceSum_eq_sumFanDet
statement:
/-- **Polygon algebraic fan identity.** -/
theorem shoelaceSum_eq_sumFanDet : P.shoelaceSum = sumFanDet P

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.FanDetsNonneg
statement:
def FanDetsNonneg : Prop :=
  ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < P.nVertices - 2), 0 ≤ fanDet P i hi

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.FanDetPrimitive
EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.sumFanDet_eq_sum_natAbs_of_nonneg
statement:
lemma sumFanDet_eq_sum_natAbs_of_nonneg (hnn : FanDetsNonneg P) :
    sumFanDet P =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (P.nVertices - 2), (Int.natAbs (fanDetNat P i) : ℤ)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.shoelace_eq_sum_fan_shoelace
statement:
theorem shoelace_eq_sum_fan_shoelace
    (hnn : FanDetsNonneg P) (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex) :
    P.shoelace = ∑ t ∈ fanTriangles P, t.shoelace

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.shoelace_eq_n_sub_two_div_two
statement:
theorem shoelace_eq_n_sub_two_div_two
    (hnn : FanDetsNonneg P) (hprim : FanDetPrimitive P)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex) :
    P.shoelace = ((P.nVertices - 2 : ℕ) : ℚ) / 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.PrimitiveEdges
statement:
def PrimitiveEdges : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Fin P.nVertices, edgeGcd (P.edgePair i).1 (P.edgePair i).2 = 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.B_eq_nVertices_of_primitive_edges
statement:
theorem B_eq_nVertices_of_primitive_edges
    (hprim : PrimitiveEdges P) (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex) :
    P.B = P.nVertices

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.shoelace_eq_B_div_two_sub_one_of_primitive_fan
statement:
/-- **Empty-interior shoelace identity** under primitive fan + primitive edges
(not classical Pick). -/
theorem shoelace_eq_B_div_two_sub_one_of_primitive_fan
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hnn : FanDetsNonneg P)
    (hprim : FanDetPrimitive P) :
    P.shoelace = (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.shoelace_pick_form_empty_interior_of_primitive_fan
statement:
theorem shoelace_pick_form_empty_interior_of_primitive_fan
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hnn : FanDetsNonneg P)
    (hprim : FanDetPrimitive P) :
    P.shoelace = (0 : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.FanTrianglesEmpty
statement:
/-- Each fan triangle contains no lattice points other than its three vertices. -/
def FanTrianglesEmpty : Prop :=
  ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < P.nVertices - 2),
    ∀ p, MemClosedTriangle (fanTriangle P i hi).a (fanTriangle P i hi).b
        (fanTriangle P i hi).c p →
      p = (fanTriangle P i hi).a ∨ p = (fanTriangle P i hi).b ∨
        p = (fanTriangle P i hi).c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.FanDetsPos
EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.FanDetsNonneg_of_pos
statement: lemma FanDetsNonneg_of_pos (h : FanDetsPos P) : FanDetsNonneg P

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.FanDetPrimitive_of_empty_fan_triangles
statement:
/-- **Discharge fan-primitivity** from empty fan ears + nondegeneracy.
Uses `natAbs_det_eq_one_of_memClosedTriangle_eq_vertices`. -/
theorem FanDetPrimitive_of_empty_fan_triangles
    (hpos : FanDetsPos P) (hempty : FanTrianglesEmpty P) :
    FanDetPrimitive P

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.shoelace_eq_B_div_two_sub_one_of_empty_fan
statement:
/-- Empty-interior shoelace Pick-form with `FanDetPrimitive` discharged from
empty fan triangles (not classical Pick). -/
theorem shoelace_eq_B_div_two_sub_one_of_empty_fan
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hpos : FanDetsPos P)
    (hempty : FanTrianglesEmpty P) :
    P.shoelace = (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.EmptyInterior
statement:
/-- Geometric empty-interior: no lattice points in the convex hull off the cyclic boundary.
Matches classical Pick `I = 0` when the polygon is convex (listed vertices extreme). -/
def EmptyInterior : Prop := P.interiorLatticePoints = ∅

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.VerticesExtreme
statement:
/-- Every listed vertex is extreme in the convex hull of the vertex set.
True for convex lattice polygons in vertex order; rules out “foreign” vertices
inside fan ears. (`toReal` = `LatticeTriangle.toReal` = polygon embedding.) -/
def VerticesExtreme : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Fin P.nVertices,
    toReal (P.vertex i) ∉
      convexHull ℝ (toReal '' ((P.vertexFinset.erase (P.vertex i) : Set (ℤ × ℤ))))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.vertexFinset_eq_univ_image
statement:
lemma vertexFinset_eq_univ_image :
    P.vertexFinset = (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.nVertices)).image P.vertex

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.boundaryLatticePoints_eq_vertexFinset
statement:
/-- Primitive edges + distinct vertices ⇒ constructive boundary equals the vertex set. -/
theorem boundaryLatticePoints_eq_vertexFinset
    (hprim : PrimitiveEdges P) (_hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex) :
    P.boundaryLatticePoints = P.vertexFinset

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.fanTriangle_vertices_mem_vertexFinset
statement:
/-- Fan-triangle vertices lie among the polygon vertices. -/
lemma fanTriangle_vertices_mem_vertexFinset
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i < P.nVertices - 2) :
    (fanTriangle P i hi).a ∈ P.vertexFinset ∧
      (fanTriangle P i hi).b ∈ P.vertexFinset ∧
        (fanTriangle P i hi).c ∈ P.vertexFinset

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.mem_convexHullRegion_of_memClosedTriangle_fan
statement:
/-- Closed fan triangle (barycentric) sits inside the polygon convex hull. -/
theorem mem_convexHullRegion_of_memClosedTriangle_fan
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i < P.nVertices - 2) {p : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hp : MemClosedTriangle (fanTriangle P i hi).a (fanTriangle P i hi).b
      (fanTriangle P i hi).c p) :
    toReal p ∈ P.convexHullRegion

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.FanTrianglesEmpty_of_empty_interior
statement:
/-- **Prize (partial):** empty interior + primitive edges + extreme vertices ⇒
each fan ear meets lattice points only at its three vertices.

Key geometry: fan triangles ⊂ convex hull; with `PrimitiveEdges` the constructive
boundary is exactly the vertex set, so `I = ∅` leaves only listed vertices as
candidate lattice points in the hull; extremality rules out foreign vertices in
an ear. Not classical Pick (no Haar; triangulation existence still open). -/
theorem FanTrianglesEmpty_of_empty_interior
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hI : EmptyInterior P)
    (hext : VerticesExtreme P) :
    FanTrianglesEmpty P

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.shoelace_eq_B_div_two_sub_one_of_empty_interior
statement:
/-- Empty-interior shoelace Pick-form under CCW fan + primitive edges + extreme
vertices (discharges `FanTrianglesEmpty` / fan-primitivity). Not classical Pick. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_B_div_two_sub_one_of_empty_interior
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hpos : FanDetsPos P)
    (hI : EmptyInterior P)
    (hext : VerticesExtreme P) :
    P.shoelace = (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.ConvexCCW
statement:
/-- Every listed vertex lies weakly left of every directed edge (CCW convex). -/
def ConvexCCW : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : Fin P.nVertices,
    0 ≤ latticeDet (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) (P.vertex j)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.LocalCCWTurns
statement:
/-- Strict local left turn at every vertex (no three consecutive collinear). -/
def LocalCCWTurns : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Fin P.nVertices,
    0 < latticeDet (P.vertex (P.prevIdx i)) (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.StrictlyConvexCCW
statement:
/-- Strict CCW convexity: edge half-plane conditions + strict local turns. -/
def StrictlyConvexCCW : Prop := ConvexCCW P ∧ LocalCCWTurns P

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.det_nonneg_prev_of_ConvexCCW
statement:
lemma det_nonneg_prev_of_ConvexCCW (h : ConvexCCW P) (i j : Fin P.nVertices) :
    0 ≤ latticeDet (P.vertex (P.prevIdx i)) (P.vertex i) (P.vertex j)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.VerticesExtreme_of_strictlyConvexCCW
statement:
/-- **Discharge:** strict CCW convexity ⇒ every listed vertex is extreme in the
vertex convex hull. -/
theorem VerticesExtreme_of_strictlyConvexCCW
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (_hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex) :
    VerticesExtreme P

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.FanDetsNonneg_of_ConvexCCW
statement:
/-- Fan dets are nonnegative for a CCW-convex polygon. -/
theorem FanDetsNonneg_of_ConvexCCW (h : ConvexCCW P) : FanDetsNonneg P

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.exists_mem_segment_of_detR_eq_zero
statement:
/-- Three distinct collinear points in `ℝ × ℝ`: one lies on the segment of the other two. -/
lemma exists_mem_segment_of_detR_eq_zero
    (A B C : ℝ × ℝ) (hAB : A ≠ B) (hAC : A ≠ C) (hBC : B ≠ C)
    (hdet : detR A B C = 0) :
    C ∈ segment ℝ A B ∨ A ∈ segment ℝ B C ∨ B ∈ segment ℝ A C

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.not_collinear_of_VerticesExtreme
statement:
/-- Distinct collinear listed vertices contradict `VerticesExtreme`. -/
theorem not_collinear_of_VerticesExtreme
    (hext : VerticesExtreme P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (i j k : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k)
    (hdet : latticeDet (P.vertex i) (P.vertex j) (P.vertex k) = 0) :
    False

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.FanDetsPos_of_strictlyConvexCCW
statement:
/-- **Discharge:** strict CCW convexity + injective vertices ⇒ positively oriented fan. -/
theorem FanDetsPos_of_strictlyConvexCCW
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex) :
    FanDetsPos P

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.shoelace_eq_B_div_two_sub_one_of_empty_interior_convex
statement:
/-- Empty-interior shoelace Pick-form with `VerticesExtreme` and `FanDetsPos`
discharged from `StrictlyConvexCCW` (not classical Pick). -/
theorem shoelace_eq_B_div_two_sub_one_of_empty_interior_convex
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hI : EmptyInterior P)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) :
    P.shoelace = (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_le_two
statement:
/-- **I ∈ {0,1,2} shoelace Pick-form** (not classical Pick).

Hyps: `↑S = interiorLatticePoints`, `S.card ≤ 2`, injective vertices, primitive
edges, `StrictlyConvexCCW`. Concludes `shoelace = #S + B/2 − 1`.

* `#S ≤ 1` ⇒ `shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_le_one`
* `#S = 2` ⇒ `TwoInterior` + unified Off/on-spoke I=2 Pick-form

Still shoelace ≠ Haar; classical Pick FAIL. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_le_two
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hcard : S.card ≤ 2)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) :
    P.shoelace = (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.ThreeInterior
statement:
/-- Exactly three distinct interior lattice points (set form). -/
def ThreeInterior (q r s : ℤ × ℤ) : Prop :=
  q ≠ r ∧ q ≠ s ∧ r ≠ s ∧
    P.interiorLatticePoints = ({q, r, s} : Set (ℤ × ℤ))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.mem_interior_of_threeInterior_apex
statement:
theorem mem_interior_of_threeInterior_apex {q r s : ℤ × ℤ}

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.mem_interior_of_threeInterior_left
statement:
theorem mem_interior_of_threeInterior_left {q r s : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h : ThreeInterior P q r s) : r ∈ P.interiorLatticePoints

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.mem_interior_of_threeInterior_right
statement:
theorem mem_interior_of_threeInterior_right {q r s : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h : ThreeInterior P q r s) : s ∈ P.interiorLatticePoints

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.InteriorFanDetsPos_of_threeInterior
statement:
/-- Fan orientation from the apex of a three-point interior. -/
theorem InteriorFanDetsPos_of_threeInterior
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q r s : ℤ × ℤ}

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.threeInterior_of_finset_card_three
statement:
/-- Finset form of `ThreeInterior` (API for inductive general-`I`). -/
theorem threeInterior_of_finset_card_three
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hcard : S.card = 3) :
    ∃ q r s, ThreeInterior P q r s ∧ S = {q, r, s}

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.exists_mem_interiorFanTriangle_of_threeInterior_left
statement:
/-- Covering ear for either non-apex interior point of `ThreeInterior`. -/
theorem exists_mem_interiorFanTriangle_of_threeInterior_left
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.exists_mem_interiorFanTriangle_of_threeInterior_right
statement:
theorem exists_mem_interiorFanTriangle_of_threeInterior_right
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.IsDetPrimitive_interiorFan_of_no_other_interior
statement:
/-- Empty (of other interior points) interior-fan ears are det-primitive. -/
theorem IsDetPrimitive_interiorFan_of_no_other_interior
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hq : q ∈ P.interiorLatticePoints) (i : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hempty : ∀ p ∈ P.interiorLatticePoints, p ≠ q →

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.interiorFanDet_eq_one_of_no_other_interior
statement:
/-- Empty (of other interior points) ears have determinant exactly `1`. -/
theorem interiorFanDet_eq_one_of_no_other_interior
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hq : q ∈ P.interiorLatticePoints) (i : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hempty : ∀ p ∈ P.interiorLatticePoints, p ≠ q →
      ¬ MemClosedTriangle (interiorFanTriangle P q i).a

    interiorFanDet P q i = 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.interiorFanDet_eq_three_of_threeInterior_occupied
statement:

    (h : ThreeInterior P q r s) (k m : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hr : r ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex k))
    (hs : s ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex m))
    (hne_rq : r ≠ q) (hne_rv : r ≠ P.vertex k)
    (hne_sq : s ≠ q) (hne_sv : s ≠ P.vertex m)
    (hne_rs : r ≠ s)
    (hm : m = P.nextIdx k) :
    interiorFanDet P q (P.prevIdx k) = 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.interiorFanDet_eq_one_of_threeInterior_twoSpoke_adjacent_next_foreign
statement:
/-- Foreign ear `det = 1` under adjacent two-spoke next (vacuous under
`PrimitiveEdges`). -/
theorem interiorFanDet_eq_one_of_threeInterior_twoSpoke_adjacent_next_foreign
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q r s : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h : ThreeInterior P q r s) (k m j : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hr : r ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex k))
    (hs : s ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex m))
    (hne_rq : r ≠ q) (hne_rv : r ≠ P.vertex k)
    (hne_sq : s ≠ q) (hne_sv : s ≠ P.vertex m)
    (hne_rs : r ≠ s)
    (hm : m = P.nextIdx k)
    (_hne_jk : j ≠ k) (_hne_jp : j ≠ P.prevIdx k) (_hne_jm : j ≠ m) :
    interiorFanDet P q j = 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_three_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_threeInterior_twoSpoke_adjacent
statement:
/-- **I = 3 shoelace Pick-form** under adjacent two-spoke (not classical Pick).

Vacuous under `PrimitiveEdges`: shared-base midpoint contradicts edge primitivity.
Geometrically would give shared `det = 4`, outer `det = 2`, foreign `det = 1`.
Shoelace ≠ Haar. Classical Pick FAIL. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_three_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_threeInterior_twoSpoke_adjacent
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q r s : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h : ThreeInterior P q r s) (k m : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hr : r ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex k))
    (hs : s ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex m))
    (hne_rq : r ≠ q) (hne_rv : r ≠ P.vertex k)
    (hne_sq : s ≠ q) (hne_sv : s ≠ P.vertex m)
    (hne_rs : r ≠ s)
    (hm : m = P.nextIdx k ∨ m = P.prevIdx k) :
    P.shoelace = (3 : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.ThreeInteriorCovered
statement:
/-- Covered I=3 configurations from apex `q` that already have Pick-form.

Includes Off (same/two-ear), onSpoke+Off (nonadj / adj-left / adj-right) and the
Off+onSpoke duals, sameSpoke, and twoSpoke (nonadj / adj). -/
def ThreeInteriorCovered (q r s : ℤ × ℤ) : Prop

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_eq_three_covered
statement:
/-- **I = 3 shoelace Pick-form** under covered configurations (not classical Pick).

Finset `card = 3` when the three interior points form a `ThreeInteriorCovered`
configuration (Off / on-spoke+Off-nonadjacent / Off-adjacent-left/right /
same-spoke / two-spoke-nonadjacent / two-spoke-adjacent). Two-spoke-adjacent is
vacuous under `PrimitiveEdges`. Shoelace ≠ Haar. Classical Pick FAIL. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_eq_three_covered
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (_hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P)
    (hcov : ∃ q r s : ℤ × ℤ, S = {q, r, s} ∧ ThreeInteriorCovered P q r s) :
    P.shoelace = (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.exists_onSpoke_of_covering_class
statement:
/-- Normalize a covering-ear on-spoke witness to `edgeLatticePoints q (vertex k)`. -/
lemma exists_onSpoke_of_covering_class {q r : ℤ × ℤ} (i : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hclass :
      OffTriangleBoundary q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) r ∨
        r ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex i) ∨
          r ∈ edgeLatticePoints (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) q)
    (hoff : ¬ OffTriangleBoundary q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) r) :
    ∃ k : Fin P.nVertices, r ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex k) ∧
      (k = i ∨ k = P.nextIdx i)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.off_ear_rel_of_spoke
statement:
/-- Classify Off ear index relative to spoke `k`: adj-left / adj-right / nonadj. -/
lemma off_ear_rel_of_spoke (k j : Fin P.nVertices) :
    j = k ∨ j = P.prevIdx k ∨ (j ≠ k ∧ j ≠ P.prevIdx k)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.ThreeInteriorCovered_of_threeInterior
statement:
/-- **Every `ThreeInterior` is `ThreeInteriorCovered`** (not classical Pick).

Hyps: `StrictlyConvexCCW`, injective vertices, `PrimitiveEdges`, fan from apex `q`.
Covering ears + Off/on-spoke exhaustion fills all Covered disjuncts (including
Off+onSpoke duals). Shoelace ≠ Haar. Classical Pick FAIL. -/
theorem ThreeInteriorCovered_of_threeInterior
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q r s : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h : ThreeInterior P q r s) :
    ThreeInteriorCovered P q r s

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_eq_three
statement:
/-- **Finset `card = 3` shoelace Pick-form** from geometric hyps only
(not classical Pick).

Hyps: `↑S = interiorLatticePoints`, `S.card = 3`, injective vertices, primitive
edges, `StrictlyConvexCCW`. No Off-apex / Covered witness required: every
`ThreeInterior` is Covered. Shoelace ≠ Haar. Classical Pick FAIL. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_eq_three
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) :
    P.shoelace = (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_le_three
statement:
/-- **I ∈ {0,1,2,3} shoelace Pick-form** (not classical Pick).

Hyps: `↑S = interiorLatticePoints`, `S.card ≤ 3`, injective vertices, primitive
edges, `StrictlyConvexCCW`. Concludes `shoelace = #S + B/2 − 1`.

* `#S ≤ 2` ⇒ `shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_le_two`
* `#S = 3` ⇒ geometric `shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_eq_three`

Still shoelace ≠ Haar; classical Pick FAIL. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_le_three
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hcard : S.card ≤ 3)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) :
    P.shoelace = (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.earOffInterior
statement:
/-- Off-interior points of `S` strictly inside fan ear `i` (not on ear edges). -/
noncomputable def earOffInterior (q : ℤ × ℤ) (i : Fin P.nVertices) (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := by
  classical
  exact S.filter (fun p =>
    p ≠ q ∧
      MemClosedTriangle q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) p ∧
        OffTriangleBoundary q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) p)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.spokeInterior
statement:
/-- Spoke-interior points of `S` on the open segment `q -- vertex k`. -/
noncomputable def spokeInterior (q : ℤ × ℤ) (k : Fin P.nVertices) (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := by
  classical
  exact S.filter (fun p =>
    p ≠ q ∧ p ≠ P.vertex k ∧ p ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex k))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.earOffInterior_subset
statement:
/-- Ear Off-interior is a subset of `S`. -/
lemma earOffInterior_subset (q : ℤ × ℤ) (i : Fin P.nVertices) (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    earOffInterior P q i S ⊆ S

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.spokeInterior_subset
statement:
/-- Spoke interior is a subset of `S`. -/
lemma spokeInterior_subset (q : ℤ × ℤ) (k : Fin P.nVertices) (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    spokeInterior P q k S ⊆ S

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.not_mem_earOffInterior_apex
statement:
/-- Apex is excluded from every ear Off-interior. -/
lemma not_mem_earOffInterior_apex (q : ℤ × ℤ) (i : Fin P.nVertices)
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) : q ∉ earOffInterior P q i S

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.card_earOffInterior_lt
statement:
/-- **Strict card decrease for ear Off-interiors** (induction fuel).

If `q ∈ S` then `#(earOffInterior q i S) < #S`. -/
theorem card_earOffInterior_lt (q : ℤ × ℤ) (i : Fin P.nVertices)
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (hq : q ∈ S) :
    (earOffInterior P q i S).card < S.card

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.exists_offBoundary_or_onSpoke_covering_of_mem_interior
statement:
/-- Covering ear for any non-apex interior point: Off or on-spoke. -/
theorem exists_offBoundary_or_onSpoke_covering_of_mem_interior
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q p : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hq : q ∈ P.interiorLatticePoints) (hp : p ∈ P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (_hne : p ≠ q) :
    ∃ i : Fin P.nVertices,
      MemClosedTriangle q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) p ∧
        (OffTriangleBoundary q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) p ∨
          p ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex i) ∨
            p ∈ edgeLatticePoints (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) q)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.exists_offBoundary_or_onSpoke_covering_of_mem_finset
statement:
/-- Finset form: every non-apex point of `S` has an Off/on-spoke covering ear. -/
theorem exists_offBoundary_or_onSpoke_covering_of_mem_finset
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q p : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hq : q ∈ S) (hp : p ∈ S) (hne : p ≠ q) :
    ∃ i : Fin P.nVertices,
      MemClosedTriangle q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) p ∧
        (OffTriangleBoundary q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) p ∨
          p ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex i) ∨
            p ∈ edgeLatticePoints (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) q)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_trianglePolygon_eq_half_natAbs_det
statement:
/-- Triangle-polygon shoelace equals `|latticeDet|/2`. -/
lemma shoelace_trianglePolygon_eq_half_natAbs_det (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (trianglePolygon a b c).shoelace =
      (Int.natAbs (latticeDet a b c) : ℚ) / 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.sum_ear_shoelace_eq_shoelace
statement:
/-- **Fan ear areas sum to polygon shoelace** under positive interior-fan dets.

`∑ᵢ (trianglePolygon q vᵢ vᵢ₊₁).shoelace = P.shoelace`. Not classical Pick. -/
theorem sum_ear_shoelace_eq_shoelace
    {q : ℤ × ℤ} (hpos : InteriorFanDetsPos P q) :
    (∑ i : Fin P.nVertices,
        (trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).shoelace) =
      P.shoelace

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.pick_form_of_sum_ear_pick_forms
statement:
/-- Pure ℚ bookkeeping for the fan induction step.

If each ear contributes `Iᵢ + Bᵢ/2 − 1` and the sum of those contributions equals
`#S + B/2 − 1`, the polygon Pick-form follows from area additivity alone. -/
theorem pick_form_of_sum_ear_pick_forms
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (q : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hsum : (∑ i : Fin P.nVertices,
        (trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).shoelace) =
      P.shoelace)
    (hIH : ∀ i : Fin P.nVertices,
      (trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).shoelace =
        ((earOffInterior P q i S).card : ℚ) +
          ((trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).B : ℚ) / 2 - 1)
    (hbook :
      (∑ i : Fin P.nVertices,
          (((earOffInterior P q i S).card : ℚ) +
            ((trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).B : ℚ) / 2 - 1)) =
        (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1) :
    P.shoelace = (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_fan_ear_IH
statement:
/-- **Conditional fan-ear induction step** (not classical Pick).

Hyps: geometric polygon (`StrictlyConvexCCW`, injective, `PrimitiveEdges`), interior
Finset `S` with apex `q ∈ S`, every fan ear satisfies shoelace Pick-form for its
`earOffInterior` (strictly smaller card — induction fuel), and the B/I
bookkeeping identity `∑ᵢ (Iᵢ + Bᵢ/2 − 1) = #S + B/2 − 1`.

Concludes `P.shoelace = #S + B/2 − 1`. Discharging `hIH` for general ears and
proving `hbook` from spoke/gcd arithmetic are the remaining induction gaps.
Shoelace ≠ Haar. Classical Pick FAIL. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_fan_ear_IH
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (q : ℤ × ℤ) (hq : q ∈ S)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P)
    (hIH : ∀ i : Fin P.nVertices,
      (trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).shoelace =
        ((earOffInterior P q i S).card : ℚ) +
          ((trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).B : ℚ) / 2 - 1)
    (hbook :
      (∑ i : Fin P.nVertices,
          (((earOffInterior P q i S).card : ℚ) +
            ((trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).B : ℚ) / 2 - 1)) =
        (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1) :
    P.shoelace = (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_le_three_induction_base
statement:
/-- **I ≤ 3 as base of fan-ear induction** (not classical Pick).

Specializes the geometric Finset Pick-form to `card ≤ 3`, the largest range
already discharged without ear IH. For `card ≥ 4`, apply
`shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_fan_ear_IH` with IH on smaller ears.
Shoelace ≠ Haar. Classical Pick FAIL. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_le_three_induction_base
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hcard : S.card ≤ 3)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) :
    P.shoelace = (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.cross_eq_zero_of_cross_eq_zero_both
statement:
/-- 2D cross-product: if `w ≠ 0` and both `u`, `v` are parallel to `w`, then
`u` is parallel to `v`. -/
lemma cross_eq_zero_of_cross_eq_zero_both
    (u v w : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hu : u.1 * w.2 - u.2 * w.1 = 0)
    (hv : v.1 * w.2 - v.2 * w.1 = 0)
    (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    u.1 * v.2 - u.2 * v.1 = 0

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.boundaryLatticePoints_trianglePolygon
statement:
/-- Boundary of `trianglePolygon` is the union of its three edge lattice sets. -/
lemma boundaryLatticePoints_trianglePolygon (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (trianglePolygon a b c).boundaryLatticePoints =
      edgeLatticePoints a b ∪ edgeLatticePoints b c ∪ edgeLatticePoints c a

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.edgeLatticePoints_ab_inter_bc
EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.edgeLatticePoints_bc_inter_ca
EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.edgeLatticePoints_ca_inter_ab
EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.B_trianglePolygon_eq_sum_edgeGcd
statement:
/-- **Triangle B = sum of edge gcds** (not classical Pick). -/
theorem B_trianglePolygon_eq_sum_edgeGcd
    (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) (hne : latticeDet a b c ≠ 0) :
    (trianglePolygon a b c).B =
      edgeGcd a b + edgeGcd b c + edgeGcd c a

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.B_trianglePolygon_ear_of_primitive_base
statement:
/-- Ear triangle B under parent `PrimitiveEdges`:
`B = edgeGcd(q,vᵢ) + edgeGcd(vᵢ₊₁,q) + 1`. -/
theorem B_trianglePolygon_ear_of_primitive_base
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) (q : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hq : q ∈ P.interiorLatticePoints) (i : Fin P.nVertices) :
    (trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).B =
      edgeGcd q (P.vertex i) + edgeGcd (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) q + 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.hbook_of_partition_and_spokeGcd
statement:
/-- Pure ℚ identity: partition + spoke-gcd cards + ear B formula + primitive
`B = n` imply the fan-ear hbook equation. -/
theorem hbook_of_partition_and_spokeGcd
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (q : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hpart :
      (S.card : ℚ) =
        1 + (∑ i : Fin P.nVertices, ((earOffInterior P q i S).card : ℚ)) +
          (∑ k : Fin P.nVertices, ((spokeInterior P q k S).card : ℚ)))
    (hspoke :
      ∀ k : Fin P.nVertices,
        ((spokeInterior P q k S).card : ℚ) = (edgeGcd q (P.vertex k) : ℚ) - 1)
    (hBear :
      ∀ i : Fin P.nVertices,
        ((trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).B : ℚ) =
          (edgeGcd q (P.vertex i) : ℚ) +
            (edgeGcd q (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) : ℚ) + 1) :
    (∑ i : Fin P.nVertices,
        (((earOffInterior P q i S).card : ℚ) +
          ((trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).B : ℚ) / 2 -
            1)) =
      (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.hbook_of_fan_ear_partition
statement:
/-- **Conditional hbook** from geometric ear B + partition + spoke cards
(not classical Pick). -/
theorem hbook_of_fan_ear_partition
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (q : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) (hq : q ∈ P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hpart :
      (S.card : ℚ) =
        1 + (∑ i : Fin P.nVertices, ((earOffInterior P q i S).card : ℚ)) +
          (∑ k : Fin P.nVertices, ((spokeInterior P q k S).card : ℚ)))
    (hspoke :
      ∀ k : Fin P.nVertices,
        ((spokeInterior P q k S).card : ℚ) = (edgeGcd q (P.vertex k) : ℚ) - 1) :
    (∑ i : Fin P.nVertices,
        (((earOffInterior P q i S).card : ℚ) +
          ((trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).B : ℚ) / 2 -
            1)) =
      (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.mem_interiorLatticePoints_of_mem_open_spoke
statement:
/-- Open lattice points on spoke `q -- vₖ` are polygon-interior. -/
theorem mem_interiorLatticePoints_of_mem_open_spoke
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hq : q ∈ P.interiorLatticePoints) (k : Fin P.nVertices) {p : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hp : p ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex k))
    (hne_q : p ≠ q) (hne_v : p ≠ P.vertex k) :
    p ∈ P.interiorLatticePoints

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.ne_vertex_of_mem_interior
statement:
/-- Apex is never a listed vertex. -/
lemma ne_vertex_of_mem_interior
    (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.card_spokeInterior_eq_edgeGcd_sub_one

theorem card_spokeInterior_eq_edgeGcd_sub_one

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.hspoke_of_interior_finset

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.false_of_mem_earOffInterior_of_mem_spokeInterior

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.card_eq_one_add_earOff_add_spoke
statement:
/-- **hpart (ℕ):** card partition of the interior Finset about apex `q`. -/
theorem card_eq_one_add_earOff_add_spoke
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hq : q ∈ S) :
    S.card =
      1 + (∑ i : Fin P.nVertices, (earOffInterior P q i S).card) +
        (∑ k : Fin P.nVertices, (spokeInterior P q k S).card)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.hpart_of_interior_finset
statement:
/-- **hpart (ℚ)** for `hbook_of_fan_ear_partition`. -/
theorem hpart_of_interior_finset
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hq : q ∈ S) :
    (S.card : ℚ) =
      1 + (∑ i : Fin P.nVertices, ((earOffInterior P q i S).card : ℚ)) +
        (∑ k : Fin P.nVertices, ((spokeInterior P q k S).card : ℚ))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.hbook_of_fan_ear_partition_of_interior
statement:
/-- Conditional hbook discharged for interior Finsets (hpart + hspoke). -/
theorem hbook_of_fan_ear_partition_of_interior
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hq : q ∈ S) :
    (∑ i : Fin P.nVertices,
        (((earOffInterior P q i S).card : ℚ) +
          ((trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).B : ℚ) / 2 -
            1)) =
      (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.mem_interiorLatticePoints_trianglePolygon_iff
statement:
/-- Closed-triangle Off points are exactly the interior lattice points of
`trianglePolygon`. -/
lemma mem_interiorLatticePoints_trianglePolygon_iff (a b c p : ℤ × ℤ) :
    p ∈ (trianglePolygon a b c).interiorLatticePoints ↔
      MemClosedTriangle a b c p ∧ OffTriangleBoundary a b c p

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.coe_earOffInterior_eq_interiorLatticePoints_trianglePolygon
statement:
/-- **`earOffInterior` equals the ear triangle's interior lattice set**
(not classical Pick). -/
theorem coe_earOffInterior_eq_interiorLatticePoints_trianglePolygon

    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hq : q ∈ S) (i : Fin P.nVertices) :
    (earOffInterior P q i S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) =

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.edgeGcd_eq_one_of_spokeInterior_empty
statement:

theorem edgeGcd_eq_one_of_spokeInterior_empty

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.PrimitiveEdges_trianglePolygon_ear_of_spokeInterior_empty
statement:
/-- Ear inherits `PrimitiveEdges` when both adjacent spokes are empty
(not classical Pick). -/
theorem PrimitiveEdges_trianglePolygon_ear_of_spokeInterior_empty
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hq : q ∈ S) (i : Fin P.nVertices)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_trianglePolygon_ear_eq_card_earOff_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_le_three
statement:
/-- Ear Pick-form under empty adjacent spokes and `#earOff ≤ 3`
(not classical Pick). -/
theorem shoelace_trianglePolygon_ear_eq_card_earOff_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_le_three
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hq : q ∈ S) (i : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hL : spokeInterior P q i S = ∅)
    (hR : spokeInterior P q (P.nextIdx i) S = ∅)
    (hcard : (earOffInterior P q i S).card ≤ 3) :
    (trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).shoelace =
      ((earOffInterior P q i S).card : ℚ) +
        ((trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_eq_four_of_spokes_empty
statement:
/-- **I = 4 shoelace Pick-form under empty spokes from apex** (not classical Pick).

Hyps: geometric polygon, `#S = 4`, apex `q ∈ S` with every `spokeInterior` empty.
Each ear then has `#earOff ≤ 3` and inherits `PrimitiveEdges`, so I ≤ 3 applies on
ears; discharged hbook closes the fan-ear IH step. Shoelace ≠ Haar. Classical Pick
FAIL. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_eq_four_of_spokes_empty
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hcard : S.card = 4)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P)
    (q : ℤ × ℤ) (hq : q ∈ S)
    (hspokeEmpty : ∀ k : Fin P.nVertices, spokeInterior P q k S = ∅) :
    P.shoelace = (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_le_four_of_spokes_empty
statement:
/-- **I ≤ 4 shoelace Pick-form under empty-spokes apex when `#S = 4`**
(not classical Pick).

Combines geometric I ≤ 3 with the spokes-empty I = 4 case. Full I = 4 without the
spokes-empty hyp (non-primitive ear sides) remains open. Shoelace ≠ Haar.
Classical Pick FAIL. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_le_four_of_spokes_empty
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hcard : S.card ≤ 4)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P)
    (hfour :
      S.card = 4 →
        ∃ q ∈ S, ∀ k : Fin P.nVertices, spokeInterior P q k S = ∅) :
    P.shoelace = (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.edgeLatticePoints_adjacent_inter_eq_singleton
statement:
/-- Adjacent closed edges meet only at the shared vertex (local CCW turn). -/
theorem edgeLatticePoints_adjacent_inter_eq_singleton

    (i : Fin P.nVertices) :
    edgeLatticePoints (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) ∩
        edgeLatticePoints (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))
          (P.vertex (P.nextIdx (P.nextIdx i))) =

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.edgeLatticePoints_nonadjacent_disjoint
statement:

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.B_eq_sum_edgeGcd
statement:
/-- **B = ∑ edgeGcd** under strict CCW convexity (not classical Pick). -/
theorem B_eq_sum_edgeGcd
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex) :
    P.B =
      ∑ i : Fin P.nVertices,
        edgeGcd (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.B_trianglePolygon_ear
statement:
/-- Ear triangle B without parent `PrimitiveEdges`:
`B = edgeGcd(q,vᵢ) + edgeGcd(vᵢ,vᵢ₊₁) + edgeGcd(vᵢ₊₁,q)`. -/
theorem B_trianglePolygon_ear
    (q : ℤ × ℤ) (i : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hpos : InteriorFanDetsPos P q) :
    (trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).B =
      edgeGcd q (P.vertex i) +
        edgeGcd (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) +
          edgeGcd (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) q

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.hbook_of_partition_and_spokeGcd_general
statement:
/-- Pure ℚ identity: partition + spoke-gcd cards + general ear B + `B = ∑ edgeGcd`
imply the fan-ear hbook equation (no `PrimitiveEdges`). -/
theorem hbook_of_partition_and_spokeGcd_general
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (q : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hpart :
      (S.card : ℚ) =
        1 + (∑ i : Fin P.nVertices, ((earOffInterior P q i S).card : ℚ)) +
          (∑ k : Fin P.nVertices, ((spokeInterior P q k S).card : ℚ)))
    (hspoke :
      ∀ k : Fin P.nVertices,
        ((spokeInterior P q k S).card : ℚ) = (edgeGcd q (P.vertex k) : ℚ) - 1)
    (hBear :
      ∀ i : Fin P.nVertices,
        ((trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).B : ℚ) =
          (edgeGcd q (P.vertex i) : ℚ) +
            (edgeGcd (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) : ℚ) +
              (edgeGcd q (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) : ℚ)) :
    (∑ i : Fin P.nVertices,
        (((earOffInterior P q i S).card : ℚ) +
          ((trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).B : ℚ) / 2 -
            1)) =
      (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1
