name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.card_eq_one_add_earOff_add_spoke_no_pe
statement:
theorem card_eq_one_add_earOff_add_spoke_no_pe
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex) {q : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hq : q ∈ S) :
    S.card =
      1 + (∑ i : Fin P.nVertices, (earOffInterior P q i S).card) +
        (∑ k : Fin P.nVertices, (spokeInterior P q k S).card)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.hpart_of_interior_finset_no_pe
statement:
theorem hpart_of_interior_finset_no_pe
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    {q : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hq : q ∈ S) :
    (S.card : ℚ) =
      1 + (∑ i : Fin P.nVertices, ((earOffInterior P q i S).card : ℚ)) +
        (∑ k : Fin P.nVertices, ((spokeInterior P q k S).card : ℚ))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.hbook_of_fan_ear_partition_of_interior_no_pe
statement:
theorem hbook_of_fan_ear_partition_of_interior_no_pe
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    {q : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hq : q ∈ S) :
    (∑ i : Fin P.nVertices,
        (((earOffInterior P q i S).card : ℚ) +
          ((trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).B : ℚ) / 2 -
            1)) =
      (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.mem_interiorLatticePoints_of_memClosedTriangle_off_ear_no_pe
statement:
/-- Off-boundary lattice point in an interior-fan ear lies in `P.interiorLatticePoints`,
without `PrimitiveEdges`. Affine half-planes: positive barycentric weights + apex left of
every edge ⇒ positive edge dets at `p` ⇒ not on constructive boundary. -/
theorem mem_interiorLatticePoints_of_memClosedTriangle_off_ear_no_pe
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    {q : ℤ × ℤ} (hq : q ∈ P.interiorLatticePoints) (i : Fin P.nVertices)
    {p : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hmem : MemClosedTriangle q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) p)
    (hoff : OffTriangleBoundary q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) p) :
    p ∈ P.interiorLatticePoints

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.coe_earOffInterior_eq_interiorLatticePoints_trianglePolygon_no_pe
statement:
/-- **`earOffInterior` equals the ear triangle interior**, without `PrimitiveEdges`. -/
theorem coe_earOffInterior_eq_interiorLatticePoints_trianglePolygon_no_pe
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    {q : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hq : q ∈ S) (i : Fin P.nVertices) :
    (earOffInterior P q i S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) =
      (trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).interiorLatticePoints

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_fan_ear_IH_no_pe
statement:
/-- **Conditional fan-ear induction step without `PrimitiveEdges`** (not classical Pick).

Hyps: geometric polygon (`StrictlyConvexCCW`, injective), interior Finset `S`
with apex `q ∈ S`, every fan ear satisfies shoelace Pick-form for its
`earOffInterior`, and the B/I bookkeeping identity
`∑ᵢ (Iᵢ + Bᵢ/2 − 1) = #S + B/2 − 1`.

Concludes `P.shoelace = #S + B/2 − 1`. Shoelace ≠ Haar. Classical Pick FAIL. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_fan_ear_IH_no_pe
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (q : ℤ × ℤ) (hq : q ∈ S)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P)
    (hIH : ∀ i : Fin P.nVertices,
      (trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).shoelace =
        ((earOffInterior P q i S).card : ℚ) +
          ((trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).B : ℚ) / 2 - 1)
    (hbook :
      (∑ i : Fin P.nVertices,
          (((earOffInterior P q i S).card : ℚ) +
            ((trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).B : ℚ) / 2 - 1)) =
        (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1) :
    P.shoelace = (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_one_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_interior_fan
statement:
/-- **I = 1 shoelace Pick-form** under interior-fan primitivity hyps
(not classical Pick).

Given unique-interior bookkeeping `I = 1` (via the identity `1 + B/2 − 1 = B/2`),
primitive edges (`B = n`), and an empty positively oriented fan from an
interior apex: `shoelace = 1 + B/2 − 1`. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_one_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_interior_fan

    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hpos : InteriorFanDetsPos P q)
    (hempty : InteriorFanTrianglesEmpty P q) :
    P.shoelace = (1 : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.InteriorFanTrianglesEmpty_of_uniqueInterior
statement:
/-- **Prize:** unique interior + strict CCW + primitive edges ⇒ each interior-fan
ear meets lattice points only at its three vertices.

Geometry: ear ⊂ hull; non-boundary points equal the unique apex; boundary points
are listed vertices (`PrimitiveEdges`); a foreign vertex in the ear would be a
convex combination involving `q`, contradicting the supporting half-plane at that
vertex (CCW functional vanishes at the vertex and is strictly positive at `q`). -/
theorem InteriorFanTrianglesEmpty_of_uniqueInterior
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hU : UniqueInterior P q) :
    InteriorFanTrianglesEmpty P q

statement:
/-- **I = 1 shoelace Pick-form** with `InteriorFanDetsPos` discharged from
`UniqueInterior` + `StrictlyConvexCCW` (not classical Pick).

Still takes `InteriorFanTrianglesEmpty` as an optional alternate hyp; prefer the
fully geometric form below. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_I_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_uniqueInterior_of_empty
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P)
    {q : ℤ × ℤ} (hU : UniqueInterior P q)
    (hempty : InteriorFanTrianglesEmpty P q) :
    P.shoelace = (1 : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_I_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_uniqueInterior
statement:
/-- **I = 1 shoelace Pick-form** with fan emptiness discharged from geometric hyps
(not classical Pick).

Hyps: injective vertices, primitive edges, `StrictlyConvexCCW`, unique interior
lattice point. Concludes `shoelace = 1 + B/2 − 1`. No `InteriorFanTrianglesEmpty`
hyp. Still shoelace ≠ Haar; classical Pick FAIL. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_I_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_uniqueInterior
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P)
    {q : ℤ × ℤ} (hU : UniqueInterior P q) :
    P.shoelace = (1 : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_le_one
statement:
/-- **I ∈ {0,1} shoelace Pick-form** (not classical Pick).

Hyps: `↑S = interiorLatticePoints`, `S.card ≤ 1`, injective vertices, primitive
edges, `StrictlyConvexCCW`. Concludes `shoelace = #S + B/2 − 1`.

* `#S = 0` ⇒ empty-interior convex discharge.
* `#S = 1` ⇒ unique-interior fan discharge.

Still shoelace ≠ Haar/Lebesgue; classical Pick FAIL. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_I_le_one
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hcard : S.card ≤ 1)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) :
    P.shoelace = (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

statement:
theorem exists_mem_interiorFanTriangle_of_mem_hull
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P)
    {q : ℤ × ℤ} (hpos : InteriorFanDetsPos P q)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.trianglePolygon
statement:
/-- Three-vertex lattice polygon on vertices `a, b, c` (cyclic). -/
def trianglePolygon (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) : LatticePolygon where
  vertices := [a, b, c]
  length_ge := by simp

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.trianglePolygon_nVertices
statement:
@[simp] lemma trianglePolygon_nVertices (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (trianglePolygon a b c).nVertices = 3

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.trianglePolygon_vertex_zero
statement:
lemma trianglePolygon_vertex_zero (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (trianglePolygon a b c).vertex ⟨0, by simp [trianglePolygon_nVertices]⟩ = a

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.trianglePolygon_vertex_one
statement:
lemma trianglePolygon_vertex_one (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (trianglePolygon a b c).vertex ⟨1, by simp [trianglePolygon_nVertices]⟩ = b

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.trianglePolygon_vertex_two
statement:
lemma trianglePolygon_vertex_two (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (trianglePolygon a b c).vertex ⟨2, by simp [trianglePolygon_nVertices]⟩ = c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.trianglePolygon_convexHullRegion
statement:
/-- Convex hull of a triangle polygon equals the convex hull of its three vertices. -/
lemma trianglePolygon_convexHullRegion (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (trianglePolygon a b c).convexHullRegion =
      convexHull ℝ ({toReal a, toReal b, toReal c} : Set (ℝ × ℝ))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.OffTriangleBoundary
statement:
/-- `r` lies on none of the three edges of △`(a,b,c)`. -/
def OffTriangleBoundary (a b c r : ℤ × ℤ) : Prop :=
  r ∉ edgeLatticePoints a b ∧
    r ∉ edgeLatticePoints b c ∧
      r ∉ edgeLatticePoints c a

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.memClosedTriangle_of_mem_convexHull
statement:
/-- Barycentric closed-triangle membership from Euclidean convex-hull membership. -/
lemma memClosedTriangle_of_mem_convexHull
    (a b c p : ℤ × ℤ)
    (h : toReal p ∈ convexHull ℝ ({toReal a, toReal b, toReal c} : Set (ℝ × ℝ))) :
    MemClosedTriangle a b c p

statement:
lemma not_mem_boundary_trianglePolygon_of_OffTriangleBoundary

    r ∉ (trianglePolygon a b c).boundaryLatticePoints

statement:
/-- Occupied ear △`(q,vᵢ,vᵢ₊₁)` with `r` off the ear boundary has unique interior
lattice point `r` (not classical Pick). -/
theorem UniqueInterior_trianglePolygon_of_twoInterior_occupied

    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q r : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h : TwoInterior P q r) (i : Fin P.nVertices)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.edgeGcd_eq_one_of_subset_four_off_ab
statement:
/-- Edge `a--b` is primitive when closed-triangle lattice points lie in `{a,b,c,r}`
and `r` is off that edge (not classical Pick). -/
theorem edgeGcd_eq_one_of_subset_four_off_ab
    (a b c r : ℤ × ℤ) (hD : latticeDet a b c ≠ 0)
    (hsub : ∀ p, MemClosedTriangle a b c p → p = a ∨ p = b ∨ p = c ∨ p = r)
    (hoff : r ∉ edgeLatticePoints a b) :
    edgeGcd a b = 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.edgeGcd_eq_one_of_subset_four_off_bc
statement:
/-- Edge `b--c` primitivity under the same four-point / off-boundary package. -/
theorem edgeGcd_eq_one_of_subset_four_off_bc
    (a b c r : ℤ × ℤ) (hD : latticeDet a b c ≠ 0)
    (hsub : ∀ p, MemClosedTriangle a b c p → p = a ∨ p = b ∨ p = c ∨ p = r)
    (hoff : r ∉ edgeLatticePoints b c) :
    edgeGcd b c = 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.edgeGcd_eq_one_of_subset_four_off_ca
statement:
/-- Edge `c--a` primitivity under the same four-point / off-boundary package. -/
theorem edgeGcd_eq_one_of_subset_four_off_ca
    (a b c r : ℤ × ℤ) (hD : latticeDet a b c ≠ 0)
    (hsub : ∀ p, MemClosedTriangle a b c p → p = a ∨ p = b ∨ p = c ∨ p = r)
    (hoff : r ∉ edgeLatticePoints c a) :
    edgeGcd c a = 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.PrimitiveEdges_trianglePolygon_of_subset_four_off
statement:
/-- `PrimitiveEdges` for a triangle whose closed lattice points are among four
points with the fourth off every edge (not classical Pick). -/
theorem PrimitiveEdges_trianglePolygon_of_subset_four_off
    (a b c r : ℤ × ℤ) (hD : latticeDet a b c ≠ 0)
    (hsub : ∀ p, MemClosedTriangle a b c p → p = a ∨ p = b ∨ p = c ∨ p = r)
    (hoff : OffTriangleBoundary a b c r) :
    PrimitiveEdges (trianglePolygon a b c)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelaceSum_trianglePolygon
statement:
lemma shoelaceSum_trianglePolygon (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (trianglePolygon a b c).shoelaceSum = latticeDet a b c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.latticeDet_eq_three_of_subset_four_off
statement:
/-- Closed triangle with exactly one Off interior lattice point has `det = 3`
(I=1 shoelace on `trianglePolygon`; not classical Pick). -/
theorem latticeDet_eq_three_of_subset_four_off
    (a b c s : ℤ × ℤ) (hD : 0 < latticeDet a b c)
    (hsub : ∀ p, MemClosedTriangle a b c p → p = a ∨ p = b ∨ p = c ∨ p = s)
    (hoff : OffTriangleBoundary a b c s)
    (hs_mem : MemClosedTriangle a b c s) :
    latticeDet a b c = 3

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.StrictlyConvexCCW_PrimitiveEdges_trianglePolygon_of_twoInterior_occupied
statement:
/-- Occupied ear with `OffTriangleBoundary` has `StrictlyConvexCCW` and
`PrimitiveEdges` as a `trianglePolygon` (not classical Pick). -/
theorem StrictlyConvexCCW_PrimitiveEdges_trianglePolygon_of_twoInterior_occupied
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q r : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h : TwoInterior P q r) (i : Fin P.nVertices)
    (_hr : MemClosedTriangle q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) r)
    (hoff : OffTriangleBoundary q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) r) :
    StrictlyConvexCCW (trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))) ∧
      PrimitiveEdges (trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))) ∧
        Function.Injective (trianglePolygon q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))).vertex

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.interiorFanDet_eq_three_of_twoInterior_occupied
statement:
/-- Occupied off-boundary ear has determinant exactly `3` (I=1 on the ear
triangle; not classical Pick). -/
theorem interiorFanDet_eq_three_of_twoInterior_occupied
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q r : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h : TwoInterior P q r) (i : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hr : MemClosedTriangle q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) r)
    (hoff : OffTriangleBoundary q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) r) :
    interiorFanDet P q i = 3

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_two_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_twoInterior_occupied
statement:
/-- **I = 2 shoelace Pick-form** under a unique off-boundary occupied ear
(not classical Pick).

Hyps: injective / primitive / `StrictlyConvexCCW` / `TwoInterior`, an occupied
ear with `OffTriangleBoundary`, and `∀ j, MemClosedTriangle earⱼ r → j = i`.
Empty ears ⇒ `det=1`; occupied ⇒ `det=3`; fan sum `n+2`; `B=n` ⇒
`shoelace = 2 + B/2 − 1`.

Ear-uniqueness discharged under OffTriangleBoundary; on-spoke det bookkeeping open.
Shoelace ≠ Haar. Classical Pick FAIL. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_two_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_twoInterior_occupied
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q r : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h : TwoInterior P q r) (i : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hr : MemClosedTriangle q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) r)
    (hoff : OffTriangleBoundary q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) r)
    (huniq : ∀ j : Fin P.nVertices,
      MemClosedTriangle q (P.vertex j) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx j)) r → j = i) :
    P.shoelace = (2 : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.edgeStep
statement:
/-- First open lattice point on `a—b` (`k = 1` in the edge parametrization). -/
def edgeStep (a b : ℤ × ℤ) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  (a.1 + (b.1 - a.1) / (edgeGcd a b : ℤ),
   a.2 + (b.2 - a.2) / (edgeGcd a b : ℤ))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.edgeStep_mem_edgeLatticePoints
statement:
lemma edgeStep_mem_edgeLatticePoints (a b : ℤ × ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ edgeGcd a b) :
    edgeStep a b ∈ edgeLatticePoints a b

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.edgeStep_ne_left
statement:
lemma edgeStep_ne_left (a b : ℤ × ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ edgeGcd a b) :
    edgeStep a b ≠ a

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.edgeStep_ne_right
statement:
lemma edgeStep_ne_right (a b : ℤ × ℤ) (hd : 2 ≤ edgeGcd a b) :
    edgeStep a b ≠ b

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.edgeGcd_edgeStep_left
statement:
/-- Left half of the edge step is primitive. -/
lemma edgeGcd_edgeStep_left (a b : ℤ × ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ edgeGcd a b) :
    edgeGcd a (edgeStep a b) = 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.edgeGcd_edgeStep_right
statement:
/-- Right residual content after the edge step. -/
lemma edgeGcd_edgeStep_right (a b : ℤ × ℤ) (hd : 2 ≤ edgeGcd a b) :
    edgeGcd (edgeStep a b) b = edgeGcd a b - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.latticeDet_edgeStep_mul
statement:
/-- `det(a, edgeStep, c) * edgeGcd = det(a,b,c)`. -/
lemma latticeDet_edgeStep_mul (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) (_hd : 1 ≤ edgeGcd a b) :
    latticeDet a (edgeStep a b) c * (edgeGcd a b : ℤ) = latticeDet a b c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.latticeDet_edgeStep_pos
statement:
lemma latticeDet_edgeStep_pos (a b c : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hD : 0 < latticeDet a b c) (hd : 1 ≤ edgeGcd a b) :
    0 < latticeDet a (edgeStep a b) c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.latticeDet_edgeStep_right_pos
statement:
lemma latticeDet_edgeStep_right_pos (a b c : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hD : 0 < latticeDet a b c) (hd : 2 ≤ edgeGcd a b) :
    0 < latticeDet (edgeStep a b) b c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_add_of_edgeStep
statement:
lemma shoelace_add_of_edgeStep (a b c : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hD : 0 < latticeDet a b c) (hd : 2 ≤ edgeGcd a b) :
    (trianglePolygon a b c).shoelace =
      (trianglePolygon a (edgeStep a b) c).shoelace +
        (trianglePolygon (edgeStep a b) b c).shoelace

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.B_add_of_edgeStep
statement:
/-- B-additivity across an edge-step split (not classical Pick). -/
lemma B_add_of_edgeStep (a b c : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hD : 0 < latticeDet a b c) (hd : 2 ≤ edgeGcd a b)
    (hpc : edgeGcd (edgeStep a b) c = 1) :
    (trianglePolygon a (edgeStep a b) c).B + (trianglePolygon (edgeStep a b) b c).B =
      (trianglePolygon a b c).B + 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.detR_segment
statement:
/-- Real expansion of `detR` along `(1-t)•p + t•c`. -/
lemma detR_segment (a b p c : ℝ × ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    detR a b ((1 - t) • p + t • c) =
      (1 - t) * detR a b p + t * detR a b c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.latticeDet_ab_of_segment_from_edge
statement:
/-- `latticeDet a b` along a segment from an `ab`-collinear point to `c`. -/
lemma latticeDet_ab_of_segment_from_edge
    (a b c p r : ℤ × ℤ) (t : ℝ)
    (hp0 : latticeDet a b p = 0)
    (hr_eq : (1 - t) • toReal p + t • toReal c = toReal r) :
    (latticeDet a b r : ℝ) = t * (latticeDet a b c : ℝ)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.edgeGcd_eq_one_of_empty_interior_edgeStep

theorem shoelace_eq_B_div_two_sub_one_of_empty_interior_triangle_of_edgeStep_ab
    (a b c : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hD : 0 < latticeDet a b c) (hd : 2 ≤ edgeGcd a b)

    (ih : ∀ a' b' c' : ℤ × ℤ,
      0 < latticeDet a' b' c' →

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.B_add_of_edgeStep_of_gcd
statement:

lemma B_add_of_edgeStep_of_gcd (a b c : ℤ × ℤ)

    (trianglePolygon a (edgeStep a b) c).B + (trianglePolygon (edgeStep a b) b c).B =
      (trianglePolygon a b c).B + 2 * edgeGcd (edgeStep a b) c

statement:
/-- **B-telescope**: `∑ᵢ B(earᵢ) = B(P) + 2(n−3)` under EmptyInterior.
Audit name `sum_B_fan_ears_eq_B_add_two_mul_n_sub_three`. -/
theorem sum_B_fan_ears_eq_B_add_two_mul_n_sub_three
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hI : EmptyInterior P) :
    (∑ i : Fin (P.nVertices - 2),
        (trianglePolygon (fanTriangle P i.val i.isLt).a
          (fanTriangle P i.val i.isLt).b
          (fanTriangle P i.val i.isLt).c).B) =
      P.B + 2 * (P.nVertices - 3)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.sum_B_div_two_sub_one_fan_ears_eq_B_div_two_sub_one
statement:
/-- From B-telescope: `∑(Bᵢ/2 − 1) = B/2 − 1`. -/
theorem sum_B_div_two_sub_one_fan_ears_eq_B_div_two_sub_one
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hI : EmptyInterior P) :
    (∑ i : Fin (P.nVertices - 2),
        (((trianglePolygon (fanTriangle P i.val i.isLt).a
            (fanTriangle P i.val i.isLt).b
            (fanTriangle P i.val i.isLt).c).B : ℚ) / 2 - 1)) =
      (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_B_div_two_sub_one_of_empty_interior_no_pe
statement:
theorem shoelace_eq_B_div_two_sub_one_of_empty_interior_no_pe
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hI : EmptyInterior P) :
    P.shoelace = (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_no_pe
statement:
/-- **Geometric Finset shoelace Pick-form without `PrimitiveEdges`** (not classical Pick).

Hyps: `StrictlyConvexCCW`, injective vertices, `S` exactly the interior lattice
points. Concludes `P.shoelace = #S + B/2 − 1`. No `PrimitiveEdges`.
Empty base + fan-ear step with all-I triangle ears. Shoelace ≠ Haar.
Classical Pick FAIL. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_no_pe
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) :
    P.shoelace = (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_strictlyConvexCCW
statement:
/-- Alias: StrictlyConvexCCW packaging of PE-free Finset shoelace Pick-form. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_cardI_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_strictlyConvexCCW
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) :
    P.shoelace = (S.card : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.toReal
statement:
/-- Embed a lattice point into the Euclidean plane.
Alias of `LatticeTriangle.toReal` so polygon hull and triangle barycentric
membership share one embedding. -/
abbrev toReal := LatticeTriangle.toReal

name: EulersGem.Picks.toReal_injective
statement: lemma toReal_injective : Function.Injective toReal

name: EulersGem.Picks.edgeLatticePoints
statement:
/-- Lattice points on the closed segment from `p` to `q`, built from `edgeGcd`.
When `p = q` the set is `{p}`. Otherwise there are `edgeGcd p q + 1` points. -/
def edgeLatticePoints (p q : ℤ × ℤ) : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) :=
  let d := edgeGcd p q
  if d = 0 then
    {p}
  else
    (Finset.range (d + 1)).image fun k : ℕ =>
      (p.1 + (k : ℤ) * ((q.1 - p.1) / (d : ℤ)),
       p.2 + (k : ℤ) * ((q.2 - p.2) / (d : ℤ)))

name: EulersGem.Picks.edgeGcd_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma edgeGcd_eq_zero_iff (p q : ℤ × ℤ) :
    edgeGcd p q = 0 ↔ p = q

name: EulersGem.Picks.self_mem_edgeLatticePoints
statement:
lemma self_mem_edgeLatticePoints (p q : ℤ × ℤ) :
    p ∈ edgeLatticePoints p q

name: EulersGem.Picks.other_mem_edgeLatticePoints
statement:
lemma other_mem_edgeLatticePoints (p q : ℤ × ℤ) :
    q ∈ edgeLatticePoints p q

name: EulersGem.Picks.card_edgeLatticePoints
statement:
/-- Card of edge lattice points equals `edgeGcd + 1` (including endpoints). -/
theorem card_edgeLatticePoints (p q : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (edgeLatticePoints p q).card = edgeGcd p q + 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon
statement:
/-- A cyclic list of lattice vertices of length at least 3.
Does **not** assert simplicity (no self-intersections) or convexity; those are
left to witnesses / future predicates with honest names. -/
structure LatticePolygon where
  /-- Vertices in cyclic boundary order. -/
  vertices : List (ℤ × ℤ)
  /-- At least a triangle. -/
  length_ge : 3 ≤ vertices.length

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.nVertices
statement:
/-- Number of listed vertices. -/
def nVertices : ℕ := P.vertices.length

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.nVertices_pos
statement: lemma nVertices_pos : 0 < P.nVertices

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.vertex
EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.nextIdx
statement:
/-- Next index in the cycle. -/
def nextIdx (i : Fin P.nVertices) : Fin P.nVertices :=
  ⟨(i.1 + 1) % P.nVertices, Nat.mod_lt _ (by
    have : 3 ≤ P.nVertices := P.length_ge; omega)⟩

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.prevIdx
statement:
/-- Previous index in the cycle. -/
def prevIdx (i : Fin P.nVertices) : Fin P.nVertices :=
  ⟨(i.1 + P.nVertices - 1) % P.nVertices, Nat.mod_lt _ (by
    have : 3 ≤ P.nVertices := P.length_ge; omega)⟩

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.nextIdx_prevIdx
statement: lemma nextIdx_prevIdx (i : Fin P.nVertices) : P.nextIdx (P.prevIdx i) = i

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.prevIdx_nextIdx
statement: lemma prevIdx_nextIdx (i : Fin P.nVertices) : P.prevIdx (P.nextIdx i) = i

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.edgePair
statement:
/-- Consecutive edge pairs via indices `0..n-1`, each `(vertex i, vertex (i+1))`
with modular wrap-around for the closing edge. -/
def edgePair (i : Fin P.nVertices) : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) :=
  (P.vertex i, P.vertex (P.nextIdx i))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.boundaryLatticePoints
statement:
/-- Constructive boundary lattice points: union of edge lattice points over the
cycle. -/
def boundaryLatticePoints : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.nVertices)).biUnion fun i =>
    edgeLatticePoints (P.edgePair i).1 (P.edgePair i).2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.B
statement:
/-- Geometric **B**: cardinality of boundary lattice points. -/
def B : ℕ := P.boundaryLatticePoints.card

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.vertexFinset
statement:
/-- Vertex set as a `Finset`. -/
def vertexFinset : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := P.vertices.toFinset

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.convexHullRegion
statement:
/-- Convex hull of the vertices in `ℝ × ℝ`.
For a **convex** lattice polygon this is the filled region; for non-convex
simple polygons it is typically larger than the polygonal region. -/
def convexHullRegion : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  convexHull ℝ (toReal '' (P.vertexFinset : Set (ℤ × ℤ)))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.latticePointsInConvexHull
EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.interiorLatticePoints
statement:
/-- Geometric **I** (convex-hull interpretation): lattice points in the convex
hull that are not on the cyclic boundary.

**Not** classical Pick `I` unless the polygon is convex (or the filled region
is otherwise identified with this hull). Left as a `Set` — finiteness of
lattice points in a bounded convex set is not discharged here. -/
def interiorLatticePoints : Set (ℤ × ℤ) :=
  { p | toReal p ∈ P.convexHullRegion ∧ p ∉ P.boundaryLatticePoints }

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.shoelaceSum
statement:
/-- Oriented shoelace sum `∑ (xᵢ yᵢ₊₁ − xᵢ₊₁ yᵢ)` over the cycle. -/
def shoelaceSum : ℤ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ i : Fin P.nVertices,
    let e := P.edgePair i
    e.1.1 * e.2.2 - e.2.1 * e.1.2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.shoelace
statement:
/-- Polygon shoelace area `|∑|/2` as a rational.
Not identified with Haar/Lebesgue measure. -/
def shoelace : ℚ := (Int.natAbs P.shoelaceSum : ℚ) / 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.mem_boundaryLatticePoints_iff
statement:
/-- A lattice point is on the polygon boundary iff it lies on some cyclic edge. -/
theorem mem_boundaryLatticePoints_iff (p : ℤ × ℤ) :
    p ∈ P.boundaryLatticePoints ↔
      ∃ i : Fin P.nVertices, p ∈ edgeLatticePoints (P.edgePair i).1 (P.edgePair i).2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.exists_edge_of_mem_vertices
statement:
/-- Every listed vertex appears as the start of some cyclic edge. -/
lemma exists_edge_of_mem_vertices {v : ℤ × ℤ} (hv : v ∈ P.vertices) :
    ∃ i : Fin P.nVertices, P.vertex i = v

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.vertices_mem_boundary
statement:
/-- Every polygon vertex lies on the constructive boundary. -/
theorem vertices_mem_boundary {v : ℤ × ℤ} (hv : v ∈ P.vertices) :
    v ∈ P.boundaryLatticePoints

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticePolygon.mem_latticePointsInConvexHull_of_mem_vertices
statement:
/-- Every listed vertex lies in the convex-hull lattice-point set.
Uses `subset_convexHull` — not Haar, not Pick. -/
theorem mem_latticePointsInConvexHull_of_mem_vertices {v : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hv : v ∈ P.vertices) : v ∈ P.latticePointsInConvexHull

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.latticeDet
EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.triangleShoelace
EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.latticeDet_translate
statement:
lemma latticeDet_translate (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    latticeDet a b c = latticeDet (0, 0) (b - a) (c - a)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.triangleShoelace_translate
statement:
lemma triangleShoelace_translate (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    triangleShoelace a b c = triangleShoelace (0, 0) (b - a) (c - a)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.triangleShoelace_eq_half_of_natAbs_det_eq_one
statement:
/-- If `|det| = 1`, the shoelace rational equals `1/2`.

This is arithmetic on the shoelace definition, **not** a Haar-measure volume
theorem. Claude audit: do not cite this alone as “primitive triangle area”. -/
theorem triangleShoelace_eq_half_of_natAbs_det_eq_one
    (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) (h : Int.natAbs (latticeDet a b c) = 1) :
    triangleShoelace a b c = 1 / 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.latticeDet_origin_eq_matrix_det
statement:
lemma latticeDet_origin_eq_matrix_det (u v : ℤ × ℤ) :
    latticeDet (0, 0) u v = Matrix.det !![u.1, v.1; u.2, v.2]

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.edgeGcd
EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.edgeGcd_dvd_latticeDet_left
statement:
lemma edgeGcd_dvd_latticeDet_left (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (edgeGcd a b : ℤ) ∣ latticeDet a b c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.latticeDet_swap_sign
statement:
lemma latticeDet_swap_sign (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    latticeDet a c b = -latticeDet a b c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.edgeGcd_dvd_latticeDet_right
statement:
lemma edgeGcd_dvd_latticeDet_right (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (edgeGcd a c : ℤ) ∣ latticeDet a b c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.edgeGcd_dvd_latticeDet_bc
statement:
lemma edgeGcd_dvd_latticeDet_bc (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (edgeGcd b c : ℤ) ∣ latticeDet a b c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.edgeGcd_eq_one_of_natAbs_det_eq_one
statement:
/-- `|det| = 1` ⇒ every edge is primitive (`edgeGcd = 1`). -/
theorem edgeGcd_eq_one_of_natAbs_det_eq_one
    (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) (h : Int.natAbs (latticeDet a b c) = 1) :
    edgeGcd a b = 1 ∧ edgeGcd a c = 1 ∧ edgeGcd b c = 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.cramerα
statement: def cramerα (_u v p : ℤ × ℤ) : ℤ := v.2 * p.1 - v.1 * p.2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.cramerβ
statement: def cramerβ (u _v p : ℤ × ℤ) : ℤ := u.1 * p.2 - u.2 * p.1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.cramer_mul_det
statement:
lemma cramer_mul_det (u v p : ℤ × ℤ) :
    u.1 * cramerα u v p + v.1 * cramerβ u v p =
      latticeDet (0, 0) u v * p.1 ∧
    u.2 * cramerα u v p + v.2 * cramerβ u v p =
      latticeDet (0, 0) u v * p.2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.exists_coords_of_natAbs_det_eq_one
statement:
/-- If `|det(u,v)| = 1`, every lattice point is an integer linear combination of `u,v`. -/
theorem exists_coords_of_natAbs_det_eq_one
    (u v p : ℤ × ℤ) (h : Int.natAbs (latticeDet (0, 0) u v) = 1) :
    ∃ α β : ℤ, α * u.1 + β * v.1 = p.1 ∧ α * u.2 + β * v.2 = p.2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.coords_unique_of_natAbs_det_eq_one
statement:
lemma coords_unique_of_natAbs_det_eq_one
    (u v : ℤ × ℤ) (h : Int.natAbs (latticeDet (0, 0) u v) = 1)
    {α β α' β' : ℤ}
    (eq1 : α * u.1 + β * v.1 = α' * u.1 + β' * v.1)
    (eq2 : α * u.2 + β * v.2 = α' * u.2 + β' * v.2) :
    α = α' ∧ β = β'

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.IsIntegerBarycentric
EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.integerBarycentric_eq_vertices
statement:
/-- The only integer barycentric cells in the origin triangle are the three vertices.
Together with Cramer uniqueness, this is the algebraic half of “`|det|=1` ⇒ no
other lattice points”; the remaining half is identifying geometric convex-hull
membership with these coordinates (still open here — not Haar / not Pick). -/
theorem integerBarycentric_eq_vertices {α β : ℤ}
    (h : IsIntegerBarycentric α β) :
    (α = 0 ∧ β = 0) ∨ (α = 1 ∧ β = 0) ∨ (α = 0 ∧ β = 1)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.Triangle
statement:
/-- Three lattice vertices. -/
structure Triangle where
  a : ℤ × ℤ
  b : ℤ × ℤ
  c : ℤ × ℤ
  deriving DecidableEq

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.instDecidableEqTriangle.decEq
statement: deriving DecidableEq

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.instDecidableEqTriangle
statement: deriving DecidableEq

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.Triangle.det
statement: def det (t : Triangle) : ℤ := latticeDet t.a t.b t.c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.Triangle.shoelace
statement: def shoelace (t : Triangle) : ℚ := triangleShoelace t.a t.b t.c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.Triangle.IsDetPrimitive
statement: def IsDetPrimitive (t : Triangle) : Prop := Int.natAbs t.det = 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.Triangle.shoelace_eq_half_of_isDetPrimitive
statement:
theorem shoelace_eq_half_of_isDetPrimitive (t : Triangle) (h : t.IsDetPrimitive) :
    t.shoelace = 1 / 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.sum_shoelace_eq_card_div_two
statement:
/-- Sum of shoelaces of det-primitive triangles equals `#triangles / 2`.

Does **not** prove area additivity of a geometric polygon — only the rational
sum identity for the shoelace values on the listed triangles. -/
theorem sum_shoelace_eq_card_div_two
    (S : Finset Triangle) (h : ∀ t ∈ S, t.IsDetPrimitive) :
    (∑ t ∈ S, t.shoelace) = (S.card : ℚ) / 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.toReal
statement: def toReal (p : ℤ × ℤ) : ℝ × ℝ := (↑p.1, ↑p.2)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.toReal_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma toReal_zero : toReal (0, 0) = (0, 0)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.toReal_add
statement: lemma toReal_add (p q : ℤ × ℤ) : toReal (p + q) = toReal p + toReal q

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.toReal_smul
statement: lemma toReal_smul (n : ℤ) (p : ℤ × ℤ) : toReal (n • p) = (n : ℝ) • toReal p

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.MemClosedTriangle
EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.coords_unique_real
statement:
lemma coords_unique_real (u v : ℤ × ℤ) (h : latticeDet (0, 0) u v ≠ 0)
    {β γ β' γ' : ℝ}
    (eq1 : (β : ℝ) * (u.1 : ℝ) + γ * (v.1 : ℝ) = β' * (u.1 : ℝ) + γ' * (v.1 : ℝ))
    (eq2 : (β : ℝ) * (u.2 : ℝ) + γ * (v.2 : ℝ) = β' * (u.2 : ℝ) + γ' * (v.2 : ℝ)) :
    β = β' ∧ γ = γ'

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.memClosedTriangle_origin_eq_vertices
statement:
theorem memClosedTriangle_origin_eq_vertices
    (u v p : ℤ × ℤ) (h : Int.natAbs (latticeDet (0, 0) u v) = 1)
    (hp : MemClosedTriangle (0, 0) u v p) :
    p = (0, 0) ∨ p = u ∨ p = v

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.memClosedTriangle_translate_of_mem
statement:
/-- Helper: barycentric equality at a,b,c implies translated equality at 0,b-a,c-a. -/
lemma memClosedTriangle_translate_of_mem
    {a b c p : ℤ × ℤ} {α β γ : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hsum : α + β + γ = 1)
    (heq : α • toReal a + β • toReal b + γ • toReal c = toReal p) :
    MemClosedTriangle (0, 0) (b - a) (c - a) (p - a)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.memClosedTriangle_eq_vertices_of_natAbs_det_eq_one
statement:
theorem memClosedTriangle_eq_vertices_of_natAbs_det_eq_one
    (a b c p : ℤ × ℤ) (h : Int.natAbs (latticeDet a b c) = 1)
    (hp : MemClosedTriangle a b c p) :
    p = a ∨ p = b ∨ p = c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.mem_convexHull_of_memClosedTriangle
statement:
/-- Barycentric closed-triangle membership implies membership in the Euclidean
convex hull of the three vertices. Bridge to `LatticePolygon.convexHullRegion`. -/
theorem mem_convexHull_of_memClosedTriangle
    (a b c p : ℤ × ℤ) (h : MemClosedTriangle a b c p) :
    toReal p ∈ convexHull ℝ ({toReal a, toReal b, toReal c} : Set (ℝ × ℝ))

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.latticeDet_orientedCompanion
EulersGem.Picks.LatticeTriangle.exists_extra_lattice_point_of_natAbs_det_ge_two_origin

name: EulersGem.IsPolyhedral
statement:
/-- A set has a finite halfspace presentation by linear functionals over `𝕜`. -/
def IsPolyhedral (𝕜 : Type*) [Semiring 𝕜] [LE 𝕜]
    {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] [Module 𝕜 E] (s : Set E) : Prop :=
  ∃ S : Finset ((E →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) × 𝕜), s = {x | ∀ q ∈ S, q.1 x ≤ q.2}

name: EulersGem.IsPolyhedral.halfspace
variables: variable [Semiring 𝕜] [LE 𝕜] [AddCommMonoid E] [Module 𝕜 E]

name: EulersGem.IsPolyhedral.univ
statement:
/-- The whole space is the intersection of an empty family of halfspaces. -/
theorem IsPolyhedral.univ : IsPolyhedral 𝕜 (univ : Set E)
variables: variable [Semiring 𝕜] [LE 𝕜] [AddCommMonoid E] [Module 𝕜 E]

name: EulersGem.IsPolyhedral.of_finite
statement:
/-- Finite families of linear inequalities are polyhedral. -/
theorem IsPolyhedral.of_finite {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (L : ι → E →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (b : ι → 𝕜) :
    IsPolyhedral 𝕜 {x | ∀ i, L i x ≤ b i}
variables: variable [Semiring 𝕜] [LE 𝕜] [AddCommMonoid E] [Module 𝕜 E]

name: EulersGem.IsPolyhedral.preimage
statement:
/-- Linear inverse images preserve finite halfspace presentations. -/
theorem IsPolyhedral.preimage {F : Type*} [AddCommGroup F] [Module 𝕜 F]
    {s : Set E} (hs : IsPolyhedral 𝕜 s) (f : F →ₗ[𝕜] E) :
    IsPolyhedral 𝕜 (f ⁻¹' s)
variables: variable [Semiring 𝕜] [LE 𝕜] [AddCommMonoid E] [Module 𝕜 E]

name: EulersGem.IsPolyhedral.inter
statement:
/-- Intersections preserve finite halfspace presentations. -/
theorem IsPolyhedral.inter {s t : Set E} (hs : IsPolyhedral 𝕜 s) (ht : IsPolyhedral 𝕜 t) :
    IsPolyhedral 𝕜 (s ∩ t)
variables: variable [Semiring 𝕜] [LE 𝕜] [AddCommMonoid E] [Module 𝕜 E]

name: EulersGem.IsPolyhedral.iInter
variables: variable [Semiring 𝕜] [LE 𝕜] [AddCommMonoid E] [Module 𝕜 E]

EulersGem.exists_forall_mul_le_iff
statement:
/-- Eliminate one unknown over a linearly ordered field from finitely many scalar inequalities. -/
theorem exists_forall_mul_le_iff {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a b : ι → 𝕜) :
    (∃ t : 𝕜, ∀ i ∈ s, a i * t ≤ b i) ↔
      (∀ i ∈ s, a i = 0 → 0 ≤ b i) ∧
      (∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, a i < 0 → 0 < a j →
        a i * b j ≤ a j * b i)

name: EulersGem.IsPolyhedral.project
statement:
/-- The projection of a finite system of inequalities along one scalar coordinate
is another finite system of inequalities. -/
theorem IsPolyhedral.project {s : Set (𝕜 × E)} (hs : IsPolyhedral 𝕜 s) :
    IsPolyhedral 𝕜 {x | ∃ t : 𝕜, (t, x) ∈ s}

statement:
/-- Covering ear for an interior lattice point `r` is `OffTriangleBoundary` or
on-spoke. Base edge is impossible for interior points. Right-spoke uses edge
orientation `(vᵢ₊₁, q)` matching `OffTriangleBoundary`. -/
theorem offBoundary_or_onSpoke_of_mem_interiorFan
    {q r : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hr_int : r ∈ P.interiorLatticePoints) (i : Fin P.nVertices)
    (_hr : MemClosedTriangle q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) r) :
    OffTriangleBoundary q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) r ∨
      r ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex i) ∨
        r ∈ edgeLatticePoints (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) q

    (h : TwoInterior P q r) (i : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hr : MemClosedTriangle q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) r) :
    OffTriangleBoundary q (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) r ∨
      r ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex i) ∨
        r ∈ edgeLatticePoints (P.vertex (P.nextIdx i)) q

statement:
/-- Left half-ear is det-primitive: `|det(q,r,w)| = 1`. -/
theorem natAbs_latticeDet_eq_one_of_onSpoke_left

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.interiorFanDet_eq_two_of_onSpoke_left
statement:
/-- Left-adjacent on-spoke ear has `interiorFanDet = 2`. -/
theorem interiorFanDet_eq_two_of_onSpoke_left
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q r : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h : TwoInterior P q r) (k : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hs : r ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex k))
    (hne_q : r ≠ q) (hne_v : r ≠ P.vertex k) :
    interiorFanDet P q k = 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.interiorFanDet_eq_two_of_onSpoke_right
statement:
/-- Right-adjacent on-spoke ear has `interiorFanDet = 2`. -/
theorem interiorFanDet_eq_two_of_onSpoke_right
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q r : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h : TwoInterior P q r) (k : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hs : r ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex k))
    (hne_q : r ≠ q) (hne_v : r ≠ P.vertex k) :
    interiorFanDet P q (P.prevIdx k) = 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.OffTriangleBoundary_of_mem_interiorFan_of_onSpoke_ne_adjacent
statement:
/-- Foreign ear containing on-spoke `r` is `OffTriangleBoundary` (spokes force
adjacency). -/
lemma OffTriangleBoundary_of_mem_interiorFan_of_onSpoke_ne_adjacent
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q r : ℤ × ℤ}

    (hs : r ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex k))
    (hne_q : r ≠ q) (hne_v : r ≠ P.vertex k)
    (_hrj : MemClosedTriangle q (P.vertex j) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx j)) r)
    (hne_k : j ≠ k) (hne_prev : j ≠ P.prevIdx k) :
    OffTriangleBoundary q (P.vertex j) (P.vertex (P.nextIdx j)) r

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.interiorFanDet_eq_one_of_onSpoke_not_adjacent
statement:
/-- Non-adjacent on-spoke ears have `interiorFanDet = 1`. -/
theorem interiorFanDet_eq_one_of_onSpoke_not_adjacent
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q r : ℤ × ℤ}

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_two_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_twoInterior_onSpoke
statement:
/-- **I = 2 shoelace Pick-form** under on-spoke occupation (not classical Pick).

Adjacent ears contribute `det = 2`; all others `det = 1`; fan sum `n + 2`;
`B = n` ⇒ `shoelace = 2 + B/2 − 1`. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_two_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_twoInterior_onSpoke
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q r : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h : TwoInterior P q r) (k : Fin P.nVertices)
    (hs : r ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex k))
    (hne_q : r ≠ q) (hne_v : r ≠ P.vertex k) :
    P.shoelace = (2 : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.ne_endpoints_of_twoInterior_onSpoke
statement:
/-- Strict on-spoke endpoints: interior point ≠ apex / vertex. -/
lemma ne_endpoints_of_twoInterior_onSpoke
    {q r : ℤ × ℤ} (h : TwoInterior P q r) (k : Fin P.nVertices)
    (_hs : r ∈ edgeLatticePoints q (P.vertex k)) :
    r ≠ q ∧ r ≠ P.vertex k

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.shoelace_eq_two_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_twoInterior
statement:
/-- **Unified I = 2 shoelace Pick-form** (Off or on-spoke; not classical Pick).

Covering ear is OffTriangleBoundary or on-spoke; both paths give
`shoelace = 2 + B/2 − 1`. Still **not** classical Pick (no Haar; EP→planar open). -/
theorem shoelace_eq_two_add_B_div_two_sub_one_of_twoInterior
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) (hinj : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P) {q r : ℤ × ℤ}
    (h : TwoInterior P q r) :
    P.shoelace = (2 : ℚ) + (P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.latticeDet_eq_three_mul_of_three_mul_sub
statement:
/-- Determinant triples along an `edgeGcd = 3` spoke at a point `r` with
`3 · (r - a) = b - a`. -/
lemma latticeDet_eq_three_mul_of_three_mul_sub
    (a b c r : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hx : (3 : ℤ) * (r.1 - a.1) = b.1 - a.1)
    (hy : (3 : ℤ) * (r.2 - a.2) = b.2 - a.2) :
    latticeDet a b c = 3 * latticeDet a r c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.latticeDet_eq_three_mul_of_edgeGcd_eq_three_step_one
statement:
lemma latticeDet_eq_three_mul_of_edgeGcd_eq_three_step_one

    latticeDet a b c =
      3 * latticeDet a (a.1 + (b.1 - a.1) / 3, a.2 + (b.2 - a.2) / 3) c

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.latticeDet_eq_three_mul_ac_of_three_mul_sub
statement:
lemma latticeDet_eq_three_mul_ac_of_three_mul_sub
    (a b c r : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hx : (3 : ℤ) * (r.1 - a.1) = c.1 - a.1)
    (hy : (3 : ℤ) * (r.2 - a.2) = c.2 - a.2) :
    latticeDet a b c = 3 * latticeDet a b r

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.latticeDet_eq_three_mul_ac_of_edgeGcd_eq_three_step_one
statement:
lemma latticeDet_eq_three_mul_ac_of_edgeGcd_eq_three_step_one

      3 * latticeDet a b (a.1 + (c.1 - a.1) / 3, a.2 + (c.2 - a.2) / 3)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.InteriorFan.step_one_mem_edgeLatticePoints_of_edgeGcd_eq_three

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.concatFin
statement:
/-- Concatenate a `Fin n`-indexed family of lists, `0` first. -/
def concatFin {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → List α) : List α :=
  match n with
  | 0 => []
  | _ + 1 => f 0 ++ concatFin (fun i => f i.succ)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.concatFin_zero
statement: lemma concatFin_zero (f : Fin 0 → List α) : concatFin f = []

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.concatFin_succ
statement:
lemma concatFin_succ {n : ℕ} (f : Fin (n + 1) → List α) :
    concatFin f = f 0 ++ concatFin (fun i => f i.succ)

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.concatFin_length
statement:
lemma concatFin_length {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → List α) :
    (concatFin f).length = ∑ i, (f i).length

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.concatFin_sum_map
EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.forall_mem_concatFin
statement:
lemma forall_mem_concatFin {p : α → Prop} {n : ℕ} {f : Fin n → List α}
    (h : ∀ i, ∀ a ∈ f i, p a) : ∀ a ∈ concatFin f, p a

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.list_shoelace_eq_length_div_two
statement:
lemma list_shoelace_eq_length_div_two (ts : List Triangle)
    (h : ∀ t ∈ ts, t.IsDetPrimitive) :
    (ts.map Triangle.shoelace).sum = (ts.length : ℚ) / 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.nVertices_le_B
statement:
/-- Listed vertices are boundary lattice points, so `n ≤ B`. -/
theorem nVertices_le_B (P : LatticePolygon) (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex) :
    P.nVertices ≤ P.B

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.sum_sub_const
statement:
lemma sum_sub_const {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ℕ) (c : ℕ) (hf : ∀ i, c ≤ f i) :
    ∑ i, (f i - c) = (∑ i, f i) - c * n

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.length_of_interior_fan
statement:
/-- Triangle count across an interior fan: each ear contributes
`2 Iₑ + Bₑ − 2`, spokes contribute `gcd − 1` interior points of the parent,
and `∑ Bₑ = 2 ∑ gcd + B`. -/
lemma length_of_interior_fan {n : ℕ} (I B : ℕ) (Iear Bear gcdS : Fin n → ℕ)
    (hI : I = 1 + (∑ i, Iear i) + (∑ i, (gcdS i - 1)))
    (hg : ∀ i, 1 ≤ gcdS i)
    (hBearSum : ∑ i, Bear i = 2 * (∑ i, gcdS i) + B)
    (hB2 : ∀ i, 2 ≤ Bear i)
    (hBB : 2 ≤ 2 * I + B) :
    ∑ i, (2 * Iear i + Bear i - 2) = 2 * I + B - 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.edgeStep_length
statement:
lemma edgeStep_length (I IL IR g BL BR B : ℕ)
    (hg : 1 ≤ g) (hI : I = IL + IR + (g - 1))
    (hB : BL + BR = B + 2 * g)
    (hBL : 2 ≤ BL) (hBR : 2 ≤ BR) (hBB : 2 ≤ 2 * I + B) :
    (2 * IL + BL - 2) + (2 * IR + BR - 2) = 2 * I + B - 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.B_triangle_ge_three
statement:
lemma B_triangle_ge_three (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) (hD : latticeDet a b c ≠ 0) :
    3 ≤ (trianglePolygon a b c).B

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.sum_fanTriangle_shoelace
statement:
lemma sum_fanTriangle_shoelace (P : LatticePolygon)
    (hnn : FanDetsNonneg P) (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex) :
    P.shoelace =
      ∑ i : Fin (P.nVertices - 2), (fanTriangle P i.val i.isLt).shoelace

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.trianglePolygon_shoelace_eq_triangle
statement:
lemma trianglePolygon_shoelace_eq_triangle (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (trianglePolygon a b c).shoelace = (⟨a, b, c⟩ : Triangle).shoelace

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.mem_parent_interior_edgeStep_left
statement:
lemma mem_parent_interior_edgeStep_left (a b c : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hD : 0 < latticeDet a b c) (hd : 2 ≤ edgeGcd a b) {r : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hr : r ∈ (trianglePolygon a (edgeStep a b) c).interiorLatticePoints) :
    r ∈ (trianglePolygon a b c).interiorLatticePoints

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.mem_parent_interior_edgeStep_right
statement:
lemma mem_parent_interior_edgeStep_right (a b c : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hD : 0 < latticeDet a b c) (hd : 2 ≤ edgeGcd a b) {r : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hr : r ∈ (trianglePolygon (edgeStep a b) b c).interiorLatticePoints) :
    r ∈ (trianglePolygon a b c).interiorLatticePoints

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.exists_primitive_triangle_list_of_edgeStep
statement:
/-- Split one non-primitive edge. Both halves have smaller `|det|`, so the
induction hypothesis supplies their primitive triangulations. -/
lemma exists_primitive_triangle_list_of_edgeStep (n : ℕ)
    (ih : ∀ m, m < n → ∀ a' b' c' (S' : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)),
      0 < latticeDet a' b' c' →
      (S' : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = (trianglePolygon a' b' c').interiorLatticePoints →
      Int.natAbs (latticeDet a' b' c') = m →
      ∃ ts : List Triangle,
        (∀ t ∈ ts, t.IsDetPrimitive) ∧
        ts.length = 2 * S'.card + (trianglePolygon a' b' c').B - 2 ∧
        (trianglePolygon a' b' c').shoelace = (ts.map Triangle.shoelace).sum)
    (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) (hD : 0 < latticeDet a b c) (hd : 2 ≤ edgeGcd a b)
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = (trianglePolygon a b c).interiorLatticePoints)
    (hn : Int.natAbs (latticeDet a b c) = n) :
    ∃ ts : List Triangle,
      (∀ t ∈ ts, t.IsDetPrimitive) ∧
      ts.length = 2 * S.card + (trianglePolygon a b c).B - 2 ∧
      (trianglePolygon a b c).shoelace = (ts.map Triangle.shoelace).sum

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.exists_primitive_triangle_list
statement:
/-- Every positively oriented lattice triangle has a det-primitive triangulation
of length `2I + B − 2` whose shoelaces sum to the triangle shoelace.
Induction is on `|det|`. -/
theorem exists_primitive_triangle_list (a b c : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hD : 0 < latticeDet a b c) (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = (trianglePolygon a b c).interiorLatticePoints) :
    ∃ ts : List Triangle,
      (∀ t ∈ ts, t.IsDetPrimitive) ∧
      ts.length = 2 * S.card + (trianglePolygon a b c).B - 2 ∧
      (trianglePolygon a b c).shoelace = (ts.map Triangle.shoelace).sum

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.exists_primitive_polygon_list
statement:
/-- A strictly convex lattice polygon has a det-primitive triangulation of
length `2I + B − 2`. Empty polygons use the corner fan; a polygon with an
interior point is fanned from that point, and each ear is a triangle. -/
theorem exists_primitive_polygon_list (P : LatticePolygon) (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex) (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) :
    ∃ ts : List Triangle,
      (∀ t ∈ ts, t.IsDetPrimitive) ∧
      ts.length = 2 * S.card + P.B - 2 ∧
      P.shoelace = (ts.map Triangle.shoelace).sum

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.shoelace_eq_two_cardI_add_B_sub_two_div_two
statement:
/-- **Shoelace is half the primitive-triangle count.** The count `2I + B − 2`
is the length of the triangulation above, not the ear-induction Pick formula. -/
theorem shoelace_eq_two_cardI_add_B_sub_two_div_two (P : LatticePolygon)
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hS : (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) = P.interiorLatticePoints)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex) (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P) :
    P.shoelace = ((2 * S.card + P.B - 2 : ℕ) : ℚ) / 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.LatticeFan.volume_pick_of_empty_primitive_from_characteristic
statement:
/-- **Pick for an empty primitive polygon, from the characteristic.**
`I = 0`, so the triangulation has length `B − 2` and shoelace `(B − 2)/2`.
`pick_count_of_disk_from_characteristic` turns that into `B/2 − 1`. -/
theorem volume_pick_of_empty_primitive_from_characteristic
    (P : LatticePolygon)
    (hverts : Function.Injective P.vertex)
    (hedge : PrimitiveEdges P)
    (hsc : StrictlyConvexCCW P)
    (hI : EmptyInterior P) :
    MeasureTheory.volume P.convexHullRegion =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((P.B : ℚ) / 2 - 1)

name: EulersGem.Picks.funkenbusch_identity
statement:
/-- **Funkenbusch count identity** (Poly100 algebraic shape; not geometric Pick).

Given Euler, `V = I + B`, Funkenbusch `E = 3I + 2B − 3`, and
`A = (F − 1)/2`, conclude `A = I + B/2 − 1`. -/
theorem funkenbusch_identity
    (I B V E F : ℤ) (A : ℚ)
    (heuler : V - E + F = 2)
    (hverts : V = I + B)
    (hedges : E = 3 * I + 2 * B - 3)
    (harea : A = ((F : ℚ) - 1) / 2) :
    A = (I : ℚ) + (B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.funkenbusch_of_triangulation
statement:
/-- From triangulation handshaking `2 E = 3 T + B` + Euler + `V = I + B` and
`F = T + 1` (one unbounded outer face), derive Funkenbusch's edge count.

The handshaking hypothesis is an assumption here. It is **proved** for
`CombinatorialDiskTriangulation` in `PlanarTriangulation.lean`
(`two_E_eq_three_T_add_B`); pass that theorem when a combinatorial disk
triangulation is available. -/
theorem funkenbusch_of_triangulation
    (I B V E T F : ℤ)
    (hV : V = I + B)
    (hF : F = T + 1)
    (heuler : V - E + F = 2)
    (hshake : 2 * E = 3 * T + B) :
    E = 3 * I + 2 * B - 3

name: EulersGem.Picks.triangulation_count_identity
statement:
/-- **Triangulation count identity** (not geometric Pick).

Assumes `2E = 3T + B`, Euler, `V = I + B`, `F = T + 1`, and `A = T/2`.
Concludes `A = I + B/2 − 1`. Does not construct a triangulation or prove area. -/
theorem triangulation_count_identity
    (I B V E T F : ℤ) (A : ℚ)
    (hV : V = I + B)
    (hF : F = T + 1)
    (heuler : V - E + F = 2)
    (hshake : 2 * E = 3 * T + B)
    (harea : A = (T : ℚ) / 2) :
    A = (I : ℚ) + (B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.triangulation_count_identity_nat
statement:
/-- Same identity with nonnegative `ℕ` counts cast to `ℚ`. -/
theorem triangulation_count_identity_nat
    (I B V E T F : ℕ) (A : ℚ)
    (hV : V = I + B)
    (hF : F = T + 1)
    (heuler : (V : ℤ) - E + F = 2)
    (hshake : 2 * E = 3 * T + B)
    (harea : A = (T : ℚ) / 2) :
    A = (I : ℚ) + (B : ℚ) / 2 - 1

name: EulersGem.Picks.CombinatorialDiskTriangulation
statement:
/-- Combinatorial triangulation of a disk (polygon interior filled by triangles).

Fields encode the classical edge–triangle incidence used in Pick:
each triangle contributes three edges; interior edges meet two triangles;
boundary edges meet one. -/
structure CombinatorialDiskTriangulation (α : Type*) [DecidableEq α] where
  /-- Triangular faces (each a 3-element vertex set). -/
  triangles : Finset (Finset α)
  /-- All edges of the complex (each a 2-element vertex set). -/
  edges : Finset (Finset α)
  /-- Boundary edges (the outer cycle; subset of `edges`). -/
  boundaryEdges : Finset (Finset α)
  /-- Every triangle has exactly three vertices. -/
  triangle_card : ∀ t ∈ triangles, t.card = 3
  /-- Every edge has exactly two vertices. -/
  edge_card : ∀ e ∈ edges, e.card = 2
  /-- Boundary edges are edges. -/
  boundary_subset : boundaryEdges ⊆ edges
  /-- The three 2-subsets of each triangle are edges of the complex. -/
  triangle_edges_mem :
    ∀ t ∈ triangles, t.powersetCard 2 ⊆ edges
  /-- Incidence: boundary edge in exactly one triangle; interior edge in exactly two. -/
  edge_incidence :
    ∀ e ∈ edges,
      (triangles.filter (fun t => e ⊆ t)).card =
        if e ∈ boundaryEdges then 1 else 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.CombinatorialDiskTriangulation.T
statement:
/-- Number of triangles `T`. -/
def T : ℕ := G.triangles.card

name: EulersGem.Picks.CombinatorialDiskTriangulation.E
statement:
/-- Number of edges `E`. -/
def E : ℕ := G.edges.card

name: EulersGem.Picks.CombinatorialDiskTriangulation.B
statement:
/-- Number of boundary edges `B` (equals Pick boundary-vertex count on a simple cycle
when every boundary lattice point is a graph vertex). -/
def B : ℕ := G.boundaryEdges.card

name: EulersGem.Picks.CombinatorialDiskTriangulation.B_le_E
statement: lemma B_le_E : G.B ≤ G.E

name: EulersGem.Picks.CombinatorialDiskTriangulation.card_powersetCard_two_of_mem_triangles
EulersGem.Picks.CombinatorialDiskTriangulation.incidences
EulersGem.Picks.CombinatorialDiskTriangulation.card_incidences_eq_three_T
statement:
/-- Left count: each of `T` triangles contributes three edges ⇒ `|I| = 3T`. -/
theorem card_incidences_eq_three_T : G.incidences.card = 3 * G.T

name: EulersGem.Picks.CombinatorialDiskTriangulation.card_incidences_eq_two_E_sub_B
statement:
/-- Right count: interior edges contribute 2, boundary 1 ⇒ `|I| = 2E − B`. -/
theorem card_incidences_eq_two_E_sub_B : G.incidences.card = 2 * G.E - G.B

name: EulersGem.Picks.CombinatorialDiskTriangulation.two_E_eq_three_T_add_B
statement:
/-- **Handshaking for a combinatorial disk triangulation** (proved from incidence).

`2E = 3T + B` where `B = #boundaryEdges`. This discharges the `hshake` hypothesis
of `triangulation_count_identity` whenever a `CombinatorialDiskTriangulation` is
supplied. -/
theorem two_E_eq_three_T_add_B : 2 * G.E = 3 * G.T + G.B

name: EulersGem.Picks.CombinatorialDiskTriangulation.two_E_eq_three_T_add_B_int
statement:
/-- ℤ form matching `triangulation_count_identity`'s `hshake`. -/
theorem two_E_eq_three_T_add_B_int :
    (2 : ℤ) * G.E = 3 * (G.T : ℤ) + G.B

name: EulersGem.Picks.handshaking_of_combinatorial_disk_triangulation
statement:
/-- Convenience export. -/
theorem handshaking_of_combinatorial_disk_triangulation
    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (G : CombinatorialDiskTriangulation α) :
    2 * G.E = 3 * G.T + G.B

name: EulersGem.Picks.PlanarDiskEulerCounts
statement:
/-- Combinatorial counts for a triangulated polygonal disk (including outer face). -/
structure PlanarDiskEulerCounts where
  V : ℕ
  E : ℕ
  /-- Triangular interior faces. -/
  T : ℕ
  /-- `F = T + 1` (outer face counted). -/
  F : ℕ := T + 1
  hF : F = T + 1 := by rfl

name: EulersGem.Picks.PlanarDiskEulerCounts.eulerChar
EulersGem.Picks.planar_disk_euler_of_EP_bridge
statement:
/-- Open EP→planar bridge: if a planar disk complex is identified with the
boundary-link / stereographic image of a convex 3-polytope face lattice, then
Euler char is 2. **`hEP_bridge` is the remaining discharge** from
`Euler_Poincare_full` / `euler_relation_convex_3polytope` for general complexes.
Fans are discharged in `DiskEuler.lean` (`fan_eulerChar_from_characteristic`):
the triangle is a geometric 2-simplex, and larger fans preserve its disk Euler
number. A triangulation with interior vertices is still open. -/
theorem planar_disk_euler_of_EP_bridge (C : PlanarDiskEulerCounts)
    (hEP_bridge : C.eulerChar = 2) :
    (C.V : ℤ) - C.E + C.F = 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.planar_disk_euler_of_fan_counts
statement:
/-- Fan / empty-interior polygon count identities ⇒ planar Euler.

When a triangulated n-gon has no interior vertices (`V = B = n`) and is a fan
(`T = n − 2`, `E = 2n − 3`), the disk Euler identity holds by arithmetic that
mirrors the EP bookkeeping (`faceEulerSum` / `V−E+F=2`). This is the planar
*combinatorial face* of the same story — not yet a call to
`Euler_Poincare_full`. -/
theorem planar_disk_euler_of_fan_counts
    (n V E T B F : ℕ)
    (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (hV : V = n) (hB : B = n) (hT : T = n - 2)
    (hE : E = 2 * n - 3) (hF : F = T + 1) :
    (V : ℤ) - E + F = 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.PlanarDiskEulerCounts.eulerChar_eq_two_of_fan_counts
statement:
/-- Same conclusion packaged on `PlanarDiskEulerCounts`. -/
theorem PlanarDiskEulerCounts.eulerChar_eq_two_of_fan_counts
    (C : PlanarDiskEulerCounts) (n B : ℕ)
    (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (hV : C.V = n) (hB : B = n) (hT : C.T = n - 2)
    (hE : C.E = 2 * n - 3) :
    C.eulerChar = 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.planar_disk_euler_of_disk_counts
statement:
/-- **Planar Euler from handshaking + classical disk counts** (combinatorial).

Given `2E = 3T + B`, `V = I + B`, `T = 2I + B − 2`, and `F = T + 1`, conclude
`V − E + F = 2`. These count relations are the combinatorial disk axioms used by
Pick bookkeeping; together with proved handshaking they discharge planar Euler
without a free `ℤ` Euler hypothesis and without calling `Euler_Poincare_full`.
**Not** classical Pick (no geometry / measure / existence). -/
theorem planar_disk_euler_of_disk_counts
    (V E T B F I : ℕ)
    (hshake : 2 * E = 3 * T + B)
    (hV : V = I + B)
    (hT : T + 2 = 2 * I + B)
    (hF : F = T + 1) :
    (V : ℤ) - E + F = 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.planar_disk_euler_of_empty_interior_disk_counts
statement:
/-- Empty-interior specialization (`I = 0`): `V = B`, `T = B − 2`. -/
theorem planar_disk_euler_of_empty_interior_disk_counts
    (V E T B F : ℕ)
    (hshake : 2 * E = 3 * T + B)
    (hV : V = B)
    (hT : T + 2 = B)
    (hF : F = T + 1) :
    (V : ℤ) - E + F = 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.CombinatorialDiskTriangulation.vertexSet
statement:
/-- Vertex set recovered as the union of edge endpoints. -/
def vertexSet : Finset α := G.edges.biUnion id

name: EulersGem.Picks.CombinatorialDiskTriangulation.V
statement:
/-- Number of vertices `V` from edge endpoints. -/
def V : ℕ := G.vertexSet.card

name: EulersGem.Picks.CombinatorialDiskTriangulation.planarCounts
statement:
/-- Euler counts with `F = T + 1` and `V` from edge endpoints. -/
def planarCounts : PlanarDiskEulerCounts where
  V := G.V
  E := G.E
  T := G.T

name: EulersGem.Picks.CombinatorialDiskTriangulation.planar_euler_of_disk_counts
statement:
/-- Planar Euler when the triangulation satisfies classical disk counts
`V = I + B` and `T = 2I + B − 2` (handshaking already proved from incidence). -/
theorem planar_euler_of_disk_counts (I : ℕ)
    (hV : G.V = I + G.B)
    (hT : G.T + 2 = 2 * I + G.B) :
    (G.planarCounts).eulerChar = 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.CombinatorialDiskTriangulation.planar_euler_of_empty_interior
statement:
/-- Empty-interior disk: `V = B` and `T = B − 2` ⇒ planar Euler. -/
theorem planar_euler_of_empty_interior
    (hV : G.V = G.B)
    (hT : G.T + 2 = G.B) :
    (G.planarCounts).eulerChar = 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.PlanarDiskEulerCounts.ofTriangulation
statement:
/-- From a combinatorial disk triangulation, Euler counts with `F = T + 1`
and `V = #vertexSet` (edge-endpoint union). -/
def PlanarDiskEulerCounts.ofTriangulation {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (G : CombinatorialDiskTriangulation α) : PlanarDiskEulerCounts :=
  G.planarCounts

name: EulersGem.Picks.UnitSquareTriangulation.v00
statement:
/-- Vertices of the unit square. -/
def v00 : ℤ × ℤ := (0, 0)

name: EulersGem.Picks.UnitSquareTriangulation.tLower
statement:
/-- Lower-right triangle `{(0,0),(1,0),(1,1)}`. -/
def tLower : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := {v00, v10, v11}

name: EulersGem.Picks.UnitSquareTriangulation.tUpper
statement:
/-- Upper-left triangle `{(0,0),(1,1),(0,1)}`. -/
def tUpper : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := {v00, v11, v01}

name: EulersGem.Picks.UnitSquareTriangulation.e_bottom
statement: def e_bottom : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := {v00, v10}

name: EulersGem.Picks.UnitSquareTriangulation.e_right
statement: def e_right : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := {v10, v11}

name: EulersGem.Picks.UnitSquareTriangulation.e_top
statement: def e_top : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := {v11, v01}

name: EulersGem.Picks.UnitSquareTriangulation.e_left
statement: def e_left : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := {v01, v00}

name: EulersGem.Picks.UnitSquareTriangulation.e_diag
statement: def e_diag : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := {v00, v11}

name: EulersGem.Picks.UnitSquareTriangulation.unitSquare
statement:
/-- Combinatorial disk triangulation of the unit square (two triangles, one diagonal). -/
def unitSquare : CombinatorialDiskTriangulation (ℤ × ℤ) where
  triangles := {tLower, tUpper}
  edges := {e_bottom, e_right, e_top, e_left, e_diag}
  boundaryEdges := {e_bottom, e_right, e_top, e_left}
  triangle_card := by
    intro t ht
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at ht
    rcases ht with rfl | rfl
    · exact tLower_card
    · exact tUpper_card
  edge_card := by native_decide
  boundary_subset := by native_decide
  triangle_edges_mem := by
    intro t ht
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at ht
    rcases ht with rfl | rfl <;> native_decide
  edge_incidence := by
    intro e he
    -- Five edges; decide membership and filter card by computation
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at he
    rcases he with h | h | h | h | h <;> subst h <;> native_decide

name: EulersGem.Picks.UnitSquareTriangulation.unitSquare_planar_euler
statement:
/-- **Planar Euler for the unit-square disk triangulation** (proved, not assumed).

`V−E+F = 4−5+3 = 2` with `F = T+1`. This is a concrete planar-disk instance of
the same `V−E+F=2` identity as `euler_relation_convex_3polytope`; the general
EP→planar discharge (`planar_disk_euler_of_EP_bridge`) remains open. -/
theorem unitSquare_planar_euler :
    (unitSquare.planarCounts).eulerChar = 2

name: EulersGem.Picks.UnitSquareTriangulation.unitSquare_fan_counts

name: EulersGem.Picks.UnitSquareTriangulation.unitSquare_planar_euler_of_fan_counts
statement:

theorem unitSquare_planar_euler_of_fan_counts :
    (unitSquare.V : ℤ) - unitSquare.E + (unitSquare.T + 1) = 2

name: EulersGem.Platonic.RegularNumbers
statement:
/-- Double-counting hypotheses for a combinatorially regular 3-polyhedron. -/
structure RegularNumbers where
  V : ℕ
  E : ℕ
  F : ℕ
  s : ℕ
  m : ℕ
  hs : 3 ≤ s
  hm : 3 ≤ m
  hE : 0 < E
  hFace : s * F = 2 * E
  hVert : m * V = 2 * E
  hEuler : (V : ℤ) - E + F = 2

name: EulersGem.Platonic.mul_euler_int
statement:
/-- From Euler + double-counting: `E * (2s + 2m − s*m) = 2*s*m` (as ℤ). -/
theorem mul_euler_int (R : RegularNumbers) :
    (R.E : ℤ) * ((2 * R.s + 2 * R.m : ℤ) - R.s * R.m) = 2 * R.s * R.m

name: EulersGem.Platonic.sub_mul_lt_four
statement:
/-- `(s−2)(m−2) < 4` from the ℤ multiplier identity and `E > 0`. -/
theorem sub_mul_lt_four (R : RegularNumbers) :
    (R.s - 2) * (R.m - 2) < 4

name: EulersGem.Platonic.schlafliPairs
EulersGem.Platonic.schlafli_pair_mem
statement:
/-- **Number of Platonic solids (combinatorial):** any regular Schläfli pair
satisfying Euler + double-counting is one of the five classical pairs. -/
theorem schlafli_pair_mem (R : RegularNumbers) :
    (R.s, R.m) ∈ schlafliPairs

name: EulersGem.Platonic.card_schlafliPairs
statement:
/-- There are exactly five admissible Schläfli pairs. -/
theorem card_schlafliPairs : schlafliPairs.card = 5

name: EulersGem.Platonic.exists_regularNumbers_of_mem_schlafli
statement:
/-- Each of the five classical Schläfli pairs is realized by a combinatorial type. -/
theorem exists_regularNumbers_of_mem_schlafli
    {s m : ℕ} (h : (s, m) ∈ schlafliPairs) :
    ∃ R : RegularNumbers, R.s = s ∧ R.m = m

name: EulersGem.Platonic.five_schlafli_pairs
statement:
/-- The five constructions realize the five distinct Schläfli pairs. -/
theorem five_schlafli_pairs :
    (tetrahedron.s, tetrahedron.m) = (3, 3) ∧
    (octahedron.s, octahedron.m) = (3, 4) ∧
    (icosahedron.s, icosahedron.m) = (3, 5) ∧
    (cube.s, cube.m) = (4, 3) ∧
    (dodecahedron.s, dodecahedron.m) = (5, 3)

name: EulersGem.Platonic.exactly_five_platonic_schlafli
statement:
/-- Summary: exactly five combinatorial types, each realized. -/
theorem exactly_five_platonic_schlafli :
    schlafliPairs.card = 5 ∧
      ∀ p ∈ schlafliPairs, ∃ R : RegularNumbers, (R.s, R.m) = p

name: EulersGem.Platonic.ncard_mul_eq_ncard_mul
statement:
/-- **Double counting** in `Set.ncard` form: if every `a ∈ A` is related to exactly `m`
elements of `B`, and every `b ∈ B` to exactly `n` elements of `A`, then
`|A| · m = |B| · n`. Mathlib's `Finset.card_mul_eq_card_mul` transported to `Set.ncard`. -/
theorem ncard_mul_eq_ncard_mul {α β : Type*} {A : Set α} {B : Set β}
    (r : α → β → Prop) (hA : A.Finite) (hB : B.Finite) {m n : ℕ}
    (hm : ∀ a ∈ A, {b ∈ B | r a b}.ncard = m)
    (hn : ∀ b ∈ B, {a ∈ A | r a b}.ncard = n) :
    A.ncard * m = B.ncard * n

name: EulersGem.Platonic.pos_edges_of_euler
statement:
/-- With `s, m ≥ 3`, double counting plus Euler forces at least one edge.
This lets `RegularNumbers.hE` be discharged instead of assumed. -/
theorem pos_edges_of_euler {V E F s m : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) (hm : 3 ≤ m)
    (hFace : s * F = 2 * E) (hVert : m * V = 2 * E)
    (hEuler : (V : ℤ) - E + F = 2) :
    0 < E

name: EulersGem.Platonic.facesOfDim
EulersGem.Platonic.mem_facesOfDim
statement:
lemma mem_facesOfDim {p f : Set E} {d : ℤ} :
    f ∈ facesOfDim p d ↔ IsFaceOf p f ∧ affDim f = d

name: EulersGem.Platonic.regular_polytope_counts
statement:
/-- **The three Platonic count equations for a geometric regular convex 3-polytope.**

`s·F = 2·E` and `m·V = 2·E` are *proved* by double counting over face-lattice
incidence (`ncard_mul_eq_ncard_mul`); `V − E + F = 2` is *discharged* from the
Euler–Poincaré root `euler_relation_convex_3polytope`.

No bare `V − E + F = 2` hypothesis is taken. -/
theorem regular_polytope_counts
    {H : Set (Hyperplane E)} {p : Set E} {s m : ℕ}
    (hH : H.Finite)
    (hp : p = ⋂ h ∈ H, closedHalfspace h.1 h.2)
    (hP : IsPolytope p)
    (hdim : affDim p = 3)
    (hEdim : Module.finrank ℝ E = 3)
    (hface_edges : ∀ f ∈ facesOfDim p 2, {e ∈ facesOfDim p 1 | e ⊆ f}.ncard = s)
    (hedge_faces : ∀ e ∈ facesOfDim p 1, {f ∈ facesOfDim p 2 | e ⊆ f}.ncard = 2)
    (hvert_edges : ∀ v ∈ facesOfDim p 0, {e ∈ facesOfDim p 1 | v ⊆ e}.ncard = m) :
    s * (facesOfDim p 2).ncard = 2 * (facesOfDim p 1).ncard ∧
      m * (facesOfDim p 0).ncard = 2 * (facesOfDim p 1).ncard ∧
      ((facesOfDim p 0).ncard : ℤ) - (facesOfDim p 1).ncard
        + (facesOfDim p 2).ncard = 2

name: EulersGem.Platonic.schlafli_pair_mem_of_regular_polytope
statement:
/-- **Schläfli classification of geometric regular convex 3-polytopes.**

If a full-dimensional convex 3-polytope in a 3-dimensional inner product space has
every 2-face an `s`-gon and exactly `m` edges at every vertex (`s, m ≥ 3`), then
`(s, m)` is one of the five classical pairs `{(3,3),(3,4),(3,5),(4,3),(5,3)}`.

Euler's relation is **not** assumed: it comes from `euler_relation_convex_3polytope`,
i.e. from `Euler_Poincare_full`. `0 < E` is derived, not assumed. -/
theorem schlafli_pair_mem_of_regular_polytope
    {H : Set (Hyperplane E)} {p : Set E} {s m : ℕ}
    (hH : H.Finite)
    (hp : p = ⋂ h ∈ H, closedHalfspace h.1 h.2)
    (hP : IsPolytope p)
    (hdim : affDim p = 3)
    (hEdim : Module.finrank ℝ E = 3)
    (hs : 3 ≤ s) (hm : 3 ≤ m)
    (hface_edges : ∀ f ∈ facesOfDim p 2, {e ∈ facesOfDim p 1 | e ⊆ f}.ncard = s)
    (hedge_faces : ∀ e ∈ facesOfDim p 1, {f ∈ facesOfDim p 2 | e ⊆ f}.ncard = 2)
    (hvert_edges : ∀ v ∈ facesOfDim p 0, {e ∈ facesOfDim p 1 | v ⊆ e}.ncard = m) :
    (s, m) ∈ schlafliPairs

name: EulersGem.Platonic3.HasFaceData
statement:
/-- The combinatorial data of a polyhedron: `V`, `E`, `F` and face type `{s, m}`. -/
def HasFaceData (P : Set R3) (V E F s m : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (facesOfDim P 0).ncard = V ∧ (facesOfDim P 1).ncard = E ∧ (facesOfDim P 2).ncard = F ∧
    (∀ f ∈ facesOfDim P 2, {e ∈ facesOfDim P 1 | e ⊆ f}.ncard = s) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ facesOfDim P 1, {f ∈ facesOfDim P 2 | e ⊆ f}.ncard = 2) ∧
    (∀ v ∈ facesOfDim P 0, {e ∈ facesOfDim P 1 | v ⊆ e}.ncard = m)

name: EulersGem.Platonic3.five_platonic_solids_exist
statement:
/-- **The five Platonic solids exist.** Each is a regular convex polyhedron in `ℝ³` with the
classical vertex, edge and facet counts and face type. -/
theorem five_platonic_solids_exist :
    (IsRegularPolyhedron tetrahedron ∧ HasFaceData tetrahedron 4 6 4 3 3) ∧
    (IsRegularPolyhedron cube ∧ HasFaceData cube 8 12 6 4 3) ∧
    (IsRegularPolyhedron octahedron ∧ HasFaceData octahedron 6 12 8 3 4) ∧
    (IsRegularPolyhedron dodecahedron ∧ HasFaceData dodecahedron 20 30 12 5 3) ∧
    (IsRegularPolyhedron icosahedron ∧ HasFaceData icosahedron 12 30 20 3 5)

name: EulersGem.IsPolyhedron
statement:
/-- `S` is a polyhedron: finite intersection of closed halfspaces.
Isabelle: `polyhedron` (H-description). -/
def IsPolyhedron (S : Set E) : Prop :=
  ∃ H : Set (Hyperplane E), H.Finite ∧
    S = ⋂ h ∈ H, closedHalfspace h.1 h.2

name: EulersGem.IsPolytope
statement:
/-- `S` is a polytope: convex hull of a finite set (V-description).
Isabelle: `polytope`. -/
def IsPolytope (S : Set E) : Prop :=
  ∃ V : Set E, V.Finite ∧ S = convexHull ℝ V

name: EulersGem.faceEulerSum
statement:
/-- Combinatorial face Euler sum (Paulson left-hand side of Euler–Poincaré). -/
noncomputable def faceEulerSum (S : Set E) (n : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
    (-1 : ℤ) ^ d *
      (Set.ncard {f : Set E | IsFaceOf S f ∧ affDim f = (d : ℤ)} : ℤ)

name: EulersGem.IsConic
statement:
/-- `S` is a cone (conic set): closed under nonnegative scaling.
Isabelle: `conic`. -/
def IsConic (S : Set E) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ S → ∀ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c → c • x ∈ S

EulersGem.cell_subset_polyhedralCone_iff
statement:
/-- A cell of the cone arrangement lies in the polyhedral cone iff its witness has no
positive sides (all `⟪a, x⟫ ≤ 0`). -/
lemma cell_subset_polyhedralCone_iff {As : Set E} {C : Set E}
    (hC : IsHyperplaneCell (coneArrangement As) C) :
    C ⊆ (⋂ a ∈ As, closedHalfspace a 0) ↔
      ∃ x ∈ C, ∀ a ∈ As, ⟪a, x⟫ ≤ 0

name: EulersGem.affDim_eq_finrank_direction
statement:
/-- For a nonempty set, `affDim` is the `finrank` of the direction of its affine span. -/
lemma affDim_eq_finrank_direction {s : Set E} (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    affDim s = (Module.finrank ℝ (affineSpan ℝ s).direction : ℤ)

name: EulersGem.mem_of_pos_weight
statement:
/-- If `F` is extreme in a convex set `A`, and a convex combination `∑ wᵢ • zᵢ` of points
of `A` lies in `F`, then every point with strictly positive weight lies in `F`. -/
theorem mem_of_pos_weight {A F : Set E} (hFext : IsExtreme ℝ A F) (hA : Convex ℝ A)
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {t : Finset ι} {w : ι → ℝ} {z : ι → E}
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ t, 0 ≤ w i) (hsum : ∑ i ∈ t, w i = 1) (hz : ∀ i ∈ t, z i ∈ A)
    (hx : ∑ i ∈ t, w i • z i ∈ F) {j : ι} (hj : j ∈ t) (hwj : 0 < w j) :
    z j ∈ F

name: EulersGem.face_eq_convexHull_inter
statement:
/-- **Faces of a V-polytope are hulls of their vertices.** If `F` is a face of
`convexHull ℝ V` then `F = convexHull ℝ (V ∩ F)`. -/
theorem face_eq_convexHull_inter {V F : Set E}
    (hF : IsFaceOf (convexHull ℝ V) F) :
    F = convexHull ℝ (V ∩ F)

lemma inner_eq_of_mem_convexHull {V : Set E} {a : E} {c : ℝ}

    ∀ x ∈ convexHull ℝ V, ⟪a, x⟫ = c

supporting hyperplane is a face. -/
theorem isFaceOf_convexHull_argmax {V : Set E} {a : E} {c : ℝ}

name: EulersGem.ncard_setOf_fintype
statement:
/-- Counting a decidable subset of a `Fintype` as a `Finset` card, so counts can be decided. -/
lemma ncard_setOf_fintype {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    {x : α | p x}.ncard = ((Finset.univ : Finset α).filter p).card

/-- **The face lattice of a polytope is finite.** `F ↦ V ∩ F` is injective on faces by

theorem faces_finite_of_isPolytope {p : Set E} (hP : IsPolytope p) :
    {f : Set E | IsFaceOf p f}.Finite

name: EulersGem.IsPolyhedral.isPolyhedron
statement:
/-- A finite linear-inequality presentation gives precisely the geometric
halfspaces used in the original Euler proof. -/
theorem IsPolyhedral.isPolyhedron {s : Set E} (hs : IsPolyhedral ℝ s) :
    IsPolyhedron s

name: EulersGem.isPolyhedron_iff_isPolyhedral
